Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$25点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's on the rack next to ice lance, acid lance, and English muffin lance.
Tag.zhCN: 炎枪术，冰枪术，酸枪术……招招克敌，枪枪致命。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When a friendly minion dies, summon a random minion with the same Cost.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当一个友方随从死亡时，随机召唤一个法力值消耗相同的随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的英雄技能会额外造成1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 即便是死后，也要继续发挥余热。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage to a minion. This spell gets double bonus from Spell Damage.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$2点伤害。该法术受到的法术伤害增益效果翻倍。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage to a minion. This spell gets double bonus from Spell Damage.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$2点伤害。该法术受到的法术伤害增益效果翻倍。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Transform a minion into a 4/2 Boar with Charge.
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从变形成为一个4/2并具有冲锋的野猪。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 霍弗终于能稳定出场了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 法术伤害+1 激励：获得法术伤害+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Is he aspiring or inspiring? Make up your mind!
Tag.zhCN: 达拉然的骑士身上也散发着魔法的气息。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Both players get a random spell. Yours costs (2) less.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：双方玩家各获取一张随机法术牌，你获取的那张法力值消耗减少（2）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Does he sling spells, or do his spells linger about. Who can say?
Tag.zhCN: 沉溺于法术而无法自拔的人，都应该送去治疗。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: You can use your Hero Power any number of times.
Tag.zhCN: 你可以使用任意次数的英雄技能。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Grand Tournament has a "No dragons allowed" policy, but it's rarely enforced.
Tag.zhCN: 其实本次大赛明令禁止龙型生物参加，但是没几个人敢去劝阻。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Add 3 copies of Arcane Missiles to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：将三张奥术飞弹置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you have a Beast, summon a random Beast.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你控制任何野兽，则随机召唤一个野兽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Not getting trampled is really the trick here.
Tag.zhCN: 驯养公羊最重要的技巧，就是别被它踩到。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She really likes seeing people get better. That's why she hurts them in the first place.
Tag.zhCN: 她最爱做的事就是先把人打个半死，再帮那人慢慢恢复。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry and Inspire: Deal 4 damage to each hero.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼，激励：对每个英雄造成4点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What did you expect to happen? He's a Spawn. Of Shadows.
Tag.zhCN: 只要跟暗影两字沾边的，多半不是什么好人，也不会有什么好事。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Choose a minion. Whenever it attacks, restore #4 Health to your hero.
Tag.zhCN: 选择一个随从。每当其进行攻击，为你的英雄恢复 #4点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The promise of glory is a powerful tool to get minions to do your bidding. Only slightly less powerful than the promise of an ice cream bar!
Tag.zhCN: 对于一个随从而言，许之以无尚的荣耀，比给家冰淇淋店什么的来得有劲多了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: When this attacks, restore #4 Health to the hero of the player who buffed it.
Tag.zhCN: 当本随从攻击时，为将其强化的英雄恢复#4点生命值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you draw a card, reduce its Cost by (1).
Tag.zhCN: 每当你抽一张牌时，使其法力值消耗减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Hopes to be promoted to "Shadowfriend" someday.
Tag.zhCN: 野百合也会有春天，暗影魔也想要朋友。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Put a copy of an enemy minion into your hand. It costs (1).
Tag.zhCN: 将一个敌方随从的一张复制置入你的手牌。其法力值消耗为（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: “我们这儿提供健全的福利保障……有兴趣吗？！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Swap the Attack and Health of all minions.
Tag.zhCN: 将所有随从的攻击力和生命值 互换。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 有时会发生意想不到的结果！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, gain +1 Attack and Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你的手牌中有龙牌，便获得+1攻击力和嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A result of magical experiments carried out by the Black Dragonflight, it's not his fault that he's a vicious killer.
Tag.zhCN: 作为黑龙军团秘密实验的产物，暮光守护者如此阴狠残忍也就不足为奇了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry and Inspire: Summon a random Legendary minion.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼，激励：随机召唤一个传说随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She sees into your past and makes you face your fears. Most common fear: Getting Majordomo out of Sneed's Old Shredder.
Tag.zhCN: 她能知晓你的过往，并迫使你去直面内心深处的恐惧。一般而言最大众化的恐惧便是：斯尼德的伐木机里蹦出来一个克尔苏加德。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: At the end of the turn, summon a Dreadsteed.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语： 在回合结束时，召唤一匹恐惧战马。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Crescendo himself summoned this steed, riding it to victory in the Grand Tournament. Wherever he rides, an army of riders ride behind him, supporting the legendary champion.
Tag.zhCN: Crescendo召唤出恐惧战马，驾着它冲向赛场。当他纵横驰骋时，总有一群骑手跟在身后，支持这位传奇勇士走向胜利。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summon a Dreadsteed at the end of the turn.
Tag.zhCN: 在回合结束时，召唤一匹恐惧战马。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They were originally called Cuddleguards, but they were not inspiring the proper amount of fear.
Tag.zhCN: 恐怖都写在名字里了，还能有比这更恐怖的家伙吗？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you discard a card, gain +2/+1.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你弃掉一张牌时，便获得+2/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "No, no, no. I asked for a tiny JESTER of evil."
Tag.zhCN: “别看我和我的坐骑个子小，我们坏起来可不比那些大块头们差。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: When you play or discard this, deal $4 damage to a random enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 当你使用或弃掉这张牌时，随机对一个敌人造成$4点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 实际上出拳者并非加拉克苏斯本人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inspire: Destroy a random minion for each player.
Tag.zhCN: 激励：随机消灭每个玩家的一个随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 或许他跟卫斯理笔下的蓝血人有那么点关系。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Very dangerous when attached to a demonbomb.
Tag.zhCN: 摆弄恶魔法术可是一件极其危险的事情。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy 2 random enemy minions. Discard 2 random cards.
Tag.zhCN: 随机消灭两个敌方随从，随机弃两张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A prime example of lose-lose negotiating.
Tag.zhCN: 这是一个典型的“双输”案例。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever this minion takes damage, also deal that amount to your hero.
Tag.zhCN: 每当本随从受到伤害，对你的英雄造成等量的伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: After playing against 5 Annoy-O-Trons, any normal guard will become a Wrathguard.
Tag.zhCN: 在对付完5个吵吵机器人后，是个人都会变成愤怒卫士的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Cards you draw from your Hero Power cost (0).
Tag.zhCN: 你通过英雄技能抽到的卡牌，其法力值消耗为（0）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He can summon anything, even a FEARSOME DOOMGUARD*. *He's pretty sure this is going to work out.
Tag.zhCN: 他能召唤任何东西，甚至是恐怖末日守卫。 他对自己的召唤结果总是充满了信心。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He needed a break after that business in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Naturally, he chose to spend his vacation in an icy snowscape killing monsters.
Tag.zhCN: 在经历完锦绣谷一役后，他决定好好度个假。通常他的避暑方式就是爬到雪山顶上去干掉几个雪人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you equip a weapon, give it +1 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你装备一把武器，使武器获得+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The best part of buccaneering is the pants.
Tag.zhCN: 当海盗最棒的一点就是可以穿灯笼裤。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Almost went to play for Stormwind before signing with Undercity.
Tag.zhCN: 生前是暴风城勇士，死后就成了幽暗城勇士。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever this minion attacks a hero, add the Coin to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 每当本随从攻击英雄时，将幸运币置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He has a giant collection of purses now. One for every outfit!
Tag.zhCN: 他做窃贼可不是为了收集钱袋，而是里面的真金白银！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you have a Pirate, gain +1/+1.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你控制任何海盗，便获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I have great deal for you... for 4 damage to your face!
Tag.zhCN: 我这里有笔好买卖……那就是对你的脸造成4点伤害！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Get 3 random cards (from your opponent's class).
Tag.zhCN: 随机获取3张（你对手职业的）卡牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your Hero Power gives this +1_Attack instead of replacing it.
Tag.zhCN: 你的英雄技能不会取代该武器，改为+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: How much more poisoned can a blade get? The answer is a lot. A lot more poisoned.
Tag.zhCN: 想知道一把浸满毒液的匕首能有多毒吗？找个食人魔捅一下你就知道了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Shuffle 3 Ambushes into your opponent's deck. When drawn, you summon a 4/4 Nerubian.
Tag.zhCN: 将三张伏击牌洗入你对手的牌库。当你的对手抽到该牌，便为你召唤一个4/4的蛛魔。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Can you hold these eggs for just a second? I promise they're not full of giant enraged undead spider things.
Tag.zhCN: 能帮我拿一下这些蛛卵吗？我保证不会有什么奇奇怪怪的东西钻出来。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Casts When Drawn Summon a 4/4 Nerubian for your opponent.
Tag.zhCN: 抽到时施放 为你的对手召唤一个4/4的蛛魔。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Summon a 4/4 Nerubian with "Deathrattle: Summon Anub'arak."
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：召唤一个4/4并具有“亡语：召唤阿努巴拉克”的蛛魔。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Was actually a pretty nice guy before, you know, the whole Lich King thing.
Tag.zhCN: 他以前曾是个好人，直到遇见了巫妖王。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Choose One - Deal $2 damage; or Summon two 1/1 Saplings.
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：造成$2点伤害；或者召唤两个1/1的树苗。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: 2 out of 2 saplings recommend that you summon the saplings.
Tag.zhCN: 两个树苗举手表决，支持你选择召唤树苗。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Gain an empty Mana Crystal. Deathrattle: Lose a Mana Crystal.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：获得一个空的法力水晶。 亡语：失去一个法力水晶。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She loves mana crystals, she hates mana crystals. So fickle!
Tag.zhCN: 她对法力水晶是又爱又恨。女人心，海底针！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inspire: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 激励：在本回合中，使你的英雄获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Maybe if you whistle a tune it will soothe him. Yeah... Try that.
Tag.zhCN: 或许哼个小曲会让他安静下来……不信你试试。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使一个友方野兽获得+3生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She was born to be something. She is just not quite sure what yet...
Tag.zhCN: 她拥有与生俱来的过人之处，只不过她现在还没搞清楚而已。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Costs (1) less for each Beast you've summoned this game.
Tag.zhCN: 在本局对战中，你每召唤过一只野兽，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He gets a discount on the tournament entry fee because he is his own horse.
Tag.zhCN: 他既是骑手又是坐骑，所以入场门票给打了折扣。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：变形成为2/1并具有冲锋；或者变形成为3/2并具有潜行。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: That's saberTEETH, not like curved pirate blades. That's a different kind of druid. Druid of the Curved Pirate Blades.
Tag.zhCN: 刃牙极其锋利，绝非一般的海盗刀剑所能比拟。俗话说牙好胃口就好，吃什么都香。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Gain 10 Mana Crystals. Discard your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 获得十个法力水晶。弃掉 你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Hey! Moon! Can I have some mana crystals?
Tag.zhCN: 伟大的艾露恩，赐予我法力水晶吧！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy a minion. Add a random minion to your opponent's hand.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个随从。随机将一张随从牌置入对手的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Is this a noun or a verb? We will never know.
Tag.zhCN: 腐根到底有多疼，怕是没机会知道了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的随从牌的法力值消耗为（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Call her "Tweety". She'll find it real funny. I PROMISE.
Tag.zhCN: 她最喜欢别人说她像翠迪了，我保证。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机召唤一个基础图腾。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Turns out the tuskarr aren't real choosy about their totems.
Tag.zhCN: 事实证明海象人对于图腾的样式一点都不挑剔。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：每有一个友方图腾，便获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's nice to find a real craftsman in this day and age of mass-produced totems.
Tag.zhCN: 现如今能看到历史如此悠久的图腾，以及技艺如此精湛的匠人，实属不易。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Restore #8 Health. Reveal a minion in each deck. If yours costs more, restore #16 instead.
Tag.zhCN: 恢复#8点生命值。揭示双方牌库里的一张随从牌。如果你的牌法力值 消耗较大，改为恢复#16点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Favored by shaman who study the art of restoration and healing, this spell would feel smug, if it had feelings.
Tag.zhCN: 恢复系萨满最钟爱的技能之一。治疗效果出众，广受盟友好评。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry and Inspire: Give your Totems +2 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼，激励：使你的图腾获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Allowing totems to attack is not cheating. I mean, there isn't anything in the rule books about it.
Tag.zhCN: 用图腾做武器并不算犯规。至少赛事规则里没提到过这点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：你的英雄技能改为“造成 2点伤害”。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You can only pick it up if you are worthy.
Tag.zhCN: 只有得到锤子认可的人，才能将其举起。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 对所有随从造成$4到$5点伤害。过载：（2）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I'm not a shaman or anything, but isn't Elemental Destruction the opposite of what they want to do?
Tag.zhCN: 我虽然不是什么萨满，但他们不是一直倡导要与元素和谐共存的吗？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What happens when you glue a buncha totems together.
Tag.zhCN: 当你把一堆图腾绑在一起时，图腾魔像就诞生了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Give all minions in your hand and deck +1/+1.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使你的手牌和牌库里的所有随从牌获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Calling the mist doesn't sound all that great. "Ooooh, it is slightly damp now!"
Tag.zhCN: 唤雾者召来的不光有雾，还有霾。记得戴口罩。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage to a minion and the minions next to it.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从及其相邻的随从造成$2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 该技能的要诀就是在台风天使用。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Give a friendly Beast Immune this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：在本回合中，使一个友方野兽获得免疫。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Takes way better care of her pets than her brother, Unstablemaster.
Tag.zhCN: 比起那些五大三粗的男人而言，她在照顾宠物方面显然用心多了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Reveal a minion in each deck. If yours costs more, draw it.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：揭示双方牌库里的一张随从牌。如果你的牌法力值消耗较大，抽这张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 骑着雷象去参加枪术比赛真是棒极了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inspire: If your hand is empty, deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
Tag.zhCN: 激励：如果你没有其他手牌，则对敌方英雄造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 当她拈弓搭箭时，你的命运就已掌握在她的手中。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: After your hero is attacked, summon a 3/3 Bear with Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：在你的英雄受到攻击后，召唤一个3/3并具有嘲讽的灰熊。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You'll never guess what's in that conveniently bear-sized, bear-smelling box.
Tag.zhCN: 得多大尺寸的陷阱才能捕住一头熊，只有熊知道。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Each time you cast a spell this turn, get a random Hunter card.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，每当你施放一个法术，随机获取一张 猎人卡牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Rexxar narrowed his eyes, grabbed his machine gun, and said: "It's go time. Lock and load." This card pays homage to that special moment.
Tag.zhCN: 雷克萨唤醒米莎，拿起墙角的机关枪，眯着眼睛说道：“子弹上膛！是时候找点乐子了！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summon three 1/1 Webspinners with "Deathrattle: Get a random Beast."
Tag.zhCN: 召唤三只1/1并具有“亡语：随机获取一张野兽牌”的 结网蛛。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 到处都是蜘蛛，真让人头皮发麻。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever an enemy minion takes damage, destroy it.
Tag.zhCN: 每当有敌方随从受到伤害时，将其消灭。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: With the help of his trusty sidekick Dreadscale, the giant jormungar Acidmaw is ready to face any knight!
Tag.zhCN: 在老伙计恐鳞的帮助下，酸喉能够轻易地咬穿板甲。看来有些骑士要倒大霉了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，对所有敌人造成 1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Let's be clear about this: ACIDMAW is the sidekick.
Tag.zhCN: 有酸喉这个老伙计在，就没有嚼不烂的骑士。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 造成$3点伤害。获得3点 护甲值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You might think bashing doesn't take a lot of practice. It doesn't.
Tag.zhCN: 需要付出多少的努力和汗水，才能挥出如此漂亮的一击。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you have a minion with Taunt, gain +1 Durability.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你控制任何具有嘲讽的随从，便获得+1耐久度。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "King's Attacker" is a shield. Funny, huh?
Tag.zhCN: 国王护卫者是把剑，而国王暗杀者是块盾，有趣吧？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 激励：使你的武器获得+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Four out of three orcs struggle with math." - Angry Zurge
Tag.zhCN: “三个兽人里，有四个的数学是食人魔教的。”——愤怒的祖格

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Also damages the minions next to whomever he attacks.
Tag.zhCN: 同时对其攻击目标相邻的随从造成伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Playing him also gets you into the Magnataur Beta.
Tag.zhCN: 猛犸人体格健硕，攻击起来大开大合，凌厉无比。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使你具有嘲讽的随从获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The best offense is a good defense.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽 战吼：使一个随从获得嘲讽。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Charrrrrge Costs (1) less for each friendly Pirate.
Tag.zhCN: 冲冲冲冲锋 每有一个友方海盗，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What's more boss than riding a parrot with a jawbone for a shoulderpad while wielding a giant hook-lance-thing and wearing a pirate hat? NOTHING.
Tag.zhCN: 骑乘红色鹦鹉，装备颚骨护肩，手持弯钩长枪，头戴海盗船帽。还能有比他更拉风的首领吗？没有！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, gain +1 Attack and Charge.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你的手牌中有龙牌，便获得+1攻击力和冲锋。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Put more spikes on her. No, more spikes. What part of 'more spikes' do you not understand? MORE SPIKES!" - Alexstrasza
Tag.zhCN: “在她身上多装点刺。不，多装点刺。这四个字就这么难理解吗？快照我说的去做！”——阿莱克丝塔萨

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Draw 3 cards. Put any minions you drew directly into the battlefield.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：抽三张牌。将抽到的随从牌直接置入战场。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Leader of the Alliance! Father of Anduin! Also he likes to play Arena, and he averages 12 wins.
Tag.zhCN: 联盟的统治者！安度因的父亲！同时他还喜欢玩竞技模式，场均12胜。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When your turn starts, give your minions +1/+1.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：在你的回合开始时，使你的所有随从获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Competition can be an inspiration to improve oneself. Or kill all the competitors.
Tag.zhCN: 争强好胜既可能挖掘一个人的内在潜力，又可能害死竞争者本人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give a minion +3 Attack and Divine Shield.
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从获得+3攻击力和 圣盾。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your Silver Hand Recruits have +2 Attack and Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 你的白银之手新兵拥有+2攻击力和嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He doesn't even get Sundays off. Every day he's hostling.
Tag.zhCN: 他整天与战马为伍，终年无休。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Warhorse Trainer is granting +2 Attack and Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 战马训练师使其获得+2攻击力和嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Hee hee! Look at his cute little feet.
Tag.zhCN: 嘿嘿！瞧瞧他那双可爱的小脚。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Reveal a minion in each deck. If yours costs more, +1 Durability.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：揭示双方牌库里的一张随从牌。如果你的牌法力值消耗较大，+1耐久度。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The stripes make it look like a candy cane, but we recommend against licking it.
Tag.zhCN: 条纹布包装让它看起来像一支拐杖糖，但我们可不推荐你去“尝一尝”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy all minions except each player's highest Attack minion.
Tag.zhCN: 除了每个玩家攻击力最高的随从之外，消灭所有 其他随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You have to get past the vendors first. So many are lost to shopping...
Tag.zhCN: 想进场得穿过拥挤的人群，太多忙着购物的人把走道堵得水泄不通……

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Put one of each Secret from your deck into the battlefield.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：将每种不同的奥秘从你的牌库中置入战场。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He may sound surly and antisocial, but he's actually just really shy.
Tag.zhCN: 别看他出言不逊，玩世不恭，其实他是个很内向的人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: You can use your Hero Power twice a turn.
Tag.zhCN: 每个回合你可以使用两次英雄技能。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He'll never admit it, but he pushes you hard because he really cares about you.
Tag.zhCN: 之所以对你如此严格要求是因为他很关心你，只不过不愿意承认罢了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Change all enemy minions' Attack to 1.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使所有敌方随从的攻击力变为1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Nobody rocks a monocle like Eadric.
Tag.zhCN: 没人能像耶德瑞克那样轻松驾驭单片眼镜。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Check it out. You can do barrel rolls on this thing.
Tag.zhCN: 瞧啊，骑着龙鹰也能做侧滚翻。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使一个友方随从获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Lance Carrier is an obscure entry level position in orcish armies. A mystery, since orcs don't generally use lances.
Tag.zhCN: 持枪侍从在兽人军队的编制里属于入门级。不过有趣的是，没几个兽人会用枪。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的英雄技能的法力值消耗为（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Not a good basis for a system of government.
Tag.zhCN: 传闻她手中持的便是亚瑟王的断钢剑。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Your opponent's Hero Power costs (5) more next turn.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：下个回合敌方英雄技能的法力值消耗增加（5）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Listen all y'all it's a saboteur!

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your Hero Power costs (5) more this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，你的英雄技能的法力值消耗为（5）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 身为骑手，没有一匹好马怎么能行？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: 50% chance to attack the wrong enemy.

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This champion has learned from the best. Except for his target selection.
Tag.zhCN: 这位勇士师从高人，唯一没学好的就是如何选择目标。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Underneath all that impressive armor, he's just skin and bones. Okay, maybe just bones.
Tag.zhCN: 厚实的盔甲下其实只有皮包骨头。好吧，连皮都没有，只有骨头。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: An elegant gorilla, for a more civilized age.
Tag.zhCN: 相比一般的猩猩而言，他显得稳重多了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 激励：为你的英雄恢复#2点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The medic tournament is less entertaining than the Grand Tournament.
Tag.zhCN: 其实医师也有锦标赛，只不过没那么热闹罢了。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's a lot cooler than Magma Rager.
Tag.zhCN: 再怎么说他也要比岩浆暴怒者冷静多了。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Ironically, the natural enemy of the snobold is THE CANDLE.
Tag.zhCN: 讽刺的是，雪地是蜡烛最大的天敌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机对一个敌人造成1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: At first he liked juggling chain saws, but then he thought, "Flames are better! Because FIRE!"
Tag.zhCN: 一开始他玩的是链锯，后来改玩火了。至于原因，他希望自己的节目会越来越火！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He used to be a librarian. Old habits die hard.
Tag.zhCN: 他曾是图书管理员，少言寡语早已成了习惯。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It takes a lot to wind him up.
Tag.zhCN: 要让他活蹦乱跳，得拧上好久的发条。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He was so excited to get season tickets to this year's Grand Tournament. He normally doesn't get them at first and has to buy them from Ogre scalpers.
Tag.zhCN: 他之所以如此兴奋，是因为买到了本年度锦标赛的季票。平时季票并不好买，他通常都是花费高价在食人魔票贩子那里收来的。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘿！我也想试试你的英雄技能……

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 激励：召唤一个3/5的作战科多兽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Someone called her a Rhinorider, and she's NOT HAPPY.
Tag.zhCN: 有人管她叫犀牛骑手，她很不开心。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 激励：召唤一个{0}的白银之手新兵。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Silver Hand is the best paladin organization. The Argent Crusaders are super jealous.
Tag.zhCN: 新兵们就爱围着她转，她对此也表示很无奈。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What did the pits ever do to you?
Tag.zhCN: 他们的血液里充斥着尚武精神，想要打一架吗？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You can keep him, but you have to promise to feed him and clean out his tank every day!
Tag.zhCN: 你可以把它养着做宠物。但你要保证每天准点喂食，还要清理它的水缸！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You have no idea how tired this guy is of being released.
Tag.zhCN: 老有人要放海怪，海怪自己都觉着累了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Reveal a minion in each deck. If yours costs more, restore #7 Health to your hero.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：揭示双方牌库里的一张随从牌。如果你的牌法力值消耗较大，则为你的英雄恢复#7点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Just could not be talked out of using his turtle for the joust...
Tag.zhCN: 也不知道骑着海龟参加枪术比赛算不算违规……

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Don't worry. With a little skin cream he's going to clear right up.
Tag.zhCN: 不用担心。只要擦点护肤霜，他又会焕然一新的。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: When there's something strange (say, a gibbering demon) in your neighborhood, who are you going to call?
Tag.zhCN: 恶魔说：“当我的邻居变得唠唠叨叨时，我第一个想到的是求助圣光勇士。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Reveal a minion in each deck. If yours costs more, gain Charge.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：揭示双方牌库里的一张随从牌。如果你的牌法力值消耗较大，则获得冲锋。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Yep. It's a horse... wearing armor... going to war.
Tag.zhCN: 骑着重甲战马去打仗，别提有多威风了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Can't attack. Inspire: Can attack as normal this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 无法攻击。 激励：在本回合中可正常进行攻击。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Who argent watches the Argent Watchman?
Tag.zhCN: 银色警卫负责监督，那么谁来监督他们呢？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中可进行攻击。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inspire: Return this minion to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 激励：将本随从移回你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Meets monthly with the gladiators to discuss career goals.
Tag.zhCN: 他每个月都会找角斗士来谈谈职业规划的问题。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：为每个英雄恢复#4点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Menu: Funnel cakes, carrots, popcorn, jormungar steaks. It's hard serving a diverse clientele.
Tag.zhCN: 这里有漏斗蛋糕，有胡萝卜，有爆米花，还有多汁肉排。所有种族齐聚一堂，可谓众口难调。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Reveal a minion in each deck. If yours costs more, gain Taunt and Divine Shield.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：揭示双方牌库里的一张随从牌。如果你的牌法力值消耗较大，则获得嘲讽和圣盾。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Needs just a few more ratings points to become Grandmaster Jouster.
Tag.zhCN: 再爬几个月的天梯就能成为宗师级枪骑士了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inspire: Add a 2/2 Squire to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 激励：将一个2/2的侍从置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Join the Argent Crusade! We have attractive tabards and you get to carry really nice swords!
Tag.zhCN: 我才不会告诉你我的这位侍从是在白银之手骑士那里挖过来的呢！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: To be honest, heckling is not the most effective form of evil.
Tag.zhCN: 他有各种手段和方法来拷问出你心里潜藏的秘密。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: The next time you use your Hero Power, it costs (2) less.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：你的下一个英雄技能的法力值消耗减少（2）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Good fencers make good neighbors, right?
Tag.zhCN: 击剑也是有技巧的，不过兽人完全不在意这一点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的英雄技能的法力值消耗减少（2）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, gain +1 Attack and Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你的手牌中有龙牌，便获得+1攻击力和嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Keeping tabs on the Grand Tournament is priority #1 for the five mighty Dragonflights!
Tag.zhCN: 对五位强大的守护巨龙来说，观看锦标赛是当下的头等大事！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you have a minion with Spell Damage, gain +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你控制任何具有法术伤害的随从，便获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Add a random Paladin card to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 随机将一张圣骑士牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A veteran of a number of crusades, she is a force for light and goodness. Her latest crusade is against goblin telemarketers.
Tag.zhCN: 她是一名久经沙场的十字军统领，代表了正义和信仰。她上一次的征讨对象是地精电话推销员。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Coming soon... to a tuskarr village near you!
Tag.zhCN: 克瓦迪尔劫掠者酷爱打家劫舍，海象人深受其苦。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Costs (1) less for each time you used your Hero Power this game.
Tag.zhCN: 在本局对战中，你每使用一次英雄技能，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Don't ask him about the beard. JUST DON'T.
Tag.zhCN: 别问他胡须是怎么来的，不然有你好受的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you play a card with Battlecry, gain +1/+1.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你使用一张具有战吼的牌，便获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 观众的喜怒哀乐有时也会影响到战局。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you have at least 4 other minions, deal 4 damage.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你拥有至少四个其他随从，则造成4点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Gormok has been giving impaling lessons in a small tent near the tournament grounds. For only 25g you too could learn the fine art of impaling!
Tag.zhCN: 戈莫克在赛场外搭了个帐篷，专门教授刺枪技巧。想在本次大赛上拿个好名次吗？只要998（只收金币）！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Taunt Deathrattle: If you're holding a Dragon, deal 3 damage to all minions.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。亡语： 如果你的手牌中有龙牌，则对所有随从造成3点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Chillmaw keeps trying to ruin the Grand Tournament, and she would've done it too, if it weren't for those dang kids!
Tag.zhCN: 冰喉一心想要毁掉锦标赛。至于原因，都是因为那些吵闹个不停的熊孩子们！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever your hero takes damage, this minion takes it instead.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你的英雄受到伤害，改为由本随从承担。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Bolf keeps coming in 2nd at the Grand Tournament. It might be his year this year, if Lebron doesn't enter.
Tag.zhCN: 博尔夫已经是第二次参加锦标赛了。今年他或许有希望，因为他的英雄没能通过预选赛。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This massive yeti just closes his eyes and charges at the nearest target. The nearest Target is a couple blocks away and has sick deals on skateboards.
Tag.zhCN: 这个巨型雪人只管闭着眼睛，向距离最近的目标发起冲锋。可距离最近的目标也远在几个街区之外，而且还是个滑板高手。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inspire: Add a random spell to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 激励：随机将一张法术牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The ethereals have their own jousting tournament, and Saraad is the reigning champion. Also he won the ethereal hot dog eating contest.
Tag.zhCN: 虚灵也有自己的枪术比赛，萨兰德是本届比赛的冠军，同时他还是虚灵吃热狗大赛的冠军。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Reveal a minion in each deck. If yours costs more, return this to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：揭示双方牌库里的一张随从牌。如果你的牌法力值消耗较大，则将骷髅骑士移回你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Apparently it really was just a flesh wound.

Tag.zhCN: 凯瑞尔宣誓效忠联盟。可是后来，有人在十字路口发现了一个人，似乎是她失踪已久的姐姐。于是凯瑞尔做出了令人难以置信的决定，离开了她的岗哨，踏上了茫茫的贫瘠之地。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个友方随从。对所有敌方随从造成$2点伤害。

Tag.enUS: About as close to feeling guilt as a warlock's ever going to get.
Tag.zhCN: 灵魂离你有多远，“负罪感”三个字就离术士有多远。

Tag.zhCN: 你要是不把药剂交出来，我们就把药剂送到你嘴里去。

Tag.zhCN: “我在此呼唤你的名字：又酥又脆！”

Tag.zhCN: 不是一锅小鬼，也不是一窝，或者一帮小鬼。这是一群小鬼。

Tag.zhCN: 不要问她你项链上的羽毛是哪来的。

Tag.zhCN: 背刺的背和刺和我的背不一样（耶）其他的随从全都露出一脸迷茫（耶）碎片碎在我手上让我觉得异样（耶）快转过身去让我给你当头一棒（耶）（欢迎来到贫瘠之地）

Tag.zhCN: 第一百个半人马倒下了，她终于拿到了足够的半人马护腕。

Tag.zhCN: 生前，塔姆辛是联盟最具天赋的法师之一；现在，她是部落最为危险的术士。

Tag.zhCN: 我一眼就看出他不是个好人！绝对不是！！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Step forward. Confess! Once I was a mere servant of the Light. Now I alone stand in judgement."
Tag.zhCN: “过来，忏悔！曾经的我只是圣光的仆人。但现在，我将独自审判你。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Destroy all minions with 5 or more_Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：消灭所有攻击力大于或等于5的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I will tell you what Velen never taught me. Whosoever stands before the Light… inevitably casts a shadow."
Tag.zhCN: “有一件事维伦从没教过我，我现在来告诉你：站在圣光面前的人……必将投下暗影。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤所有在本局对战中死亡的友方恶魔。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Still you refuse to bend your knee? None can escape death, you old fool. And in death… all will serve me…"
Tag.zhCN: “还不肯跪服吗？没有人能逃脱死亡，你这个顽固的蠢货。而在死后……一切都将臣服于我……”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Choose One - Summon 2 Poisonous Spiders; or 2 Scarabs with Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：召唤两只具有剧毒的蜘蛛；或者召唤两只具有嘲讽的甲虫。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Cenarius once taught me about the precarious balance between life and death. I have come to understand: there IS no balance. Death always wins."
Tag.zhCN: “塞纳留斯曾经教导我，生死之间的平衡极其宝贵。我现在明白了：根本没有平衡。死亡永远不败。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Summon a 3/6 Water Elemental. Your Elementals have Lifesteal this game.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤一个3/6的水元素。在本局对战中，你的所有元素拥有吸血。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Arthas was a spoiled child, playing with toys he could neither control nor understand. Come into the cold. I will show you the true power of the Frozen Throne."
Tag.zhCN: “年轻的阿尔萨斯是个被宠坏的孩子，玩弄着他既不能控制、也不甚了解的力量。过来，不要害怕寒冷。我让你见识一下冰封王座的真正力量。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Equip a 4/3_Shadowmourne that also damages adjacent minions.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：装备一把4/3的影之哀伤，影之哀伤同时对其攻击目标相邻的随从造成伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "You dare to challenge me? Come! Draw your last breath - and then, you are mine."
Tag.zhCN: “你敢挑战我？来啊！马上你就会咽下最后一口气——然后，你就是我的了。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Summon your Taunt minions that died this game.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：召唤所有你在本局对战中死亡的，并具有嘲讽的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The viziers of Azjol-Nerub released Hadronox as a last-ditch effort to hold back the Lich King. They did so by VERY carefully scooping him up in a LARGE newspaper and releasing him.
Tag.zhCN: 艾卓-尼鲁布的元老释放出哈多诺克斯作为抵御巫妖王的最后一道防线。他们非常小心地在一家主流报纸上进行了抢先报道。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 随机对一个敌方随从造成$2点伤害，并使其冻结。

Tag.zhCN: 是这里本来就冷，还是因为辛达苟萨？

Tag.zhCN: 啊，这里真冷。希望她没有带着加基森拍卖师。

Tag.zhCN: 你看，骷髅就该藏在衣橱里，不能冷藏。

Tag.enUS: Just because you did it doesn't mean you have to be guilty.
Tag.zhCN: 尽管是你干的，但你未必有罪。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：选择一张你的手牌洗入你的牌库。

Tag.zhCN: “一个温西尔，一个上古之神还有一个牛头人走进了酒吧……”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 克尔苏加德好像从比格沃斯先生的九条命里借了几条。

Tag.zhCN: 在一个友方奥秘被揭示后，施放一个不同的法师奥秘并获得+2/+2。

Tag.zhCN: 宇宙的奥秘浩瀚无涯……终将在本局对战中的晚些时候揭示。

Tag.zhCN: 这面镜子向我们展示的正是内心中最深沉，最黑暗的欲望：打脸。

Tag.zhCN: 1号！只有你和他们四个不一样！

Tag.zhCN: 造成$3点伤害。注能（@）：将一张冰冻之触置入你的 手牌。

Tag.zhCN: 这难道就是鲍勃讲的，他给死亡骑士倒酒时的情形？

Tag.zhCN: 冻结一个随从。召唤一个2/2的不稳定的骷髅。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Valeera revealed herself to be a double agent. At which point Maiev felt comfortable revealing that she also was a double agent. And then Scabbs announced to everybody that - get this - he was a double agent.
Tag.zhCN: 瓦莉拉公布了自己是个双面间谍。于是玛维承认了自己也是双面间谍。然后斯卡布斯宣布了个事：他也是双面间谍。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Cast a Secret from your deck. _Combo: Cast 2 instead.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：从你的牌库中施放一个奥秘。连击：改为施放2个。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Eye see what you did there.
Tag.zhCN: 你刚才做的事情他也看见了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, summon a 3/4 Spider with Stealth.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：在你的对手施放一个法术后，召唤一只3/4并具有潜行的蜘蛛。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Now this is what I'd call..." "...just shut up."

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, stuff it in a 0/4 Sack.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，将其装入一个0/4的袋子。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Check your coat, but don't check the coat closet.
Tag.zhCN: 记得检查你的衣装，但不要去翻看衣橱。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Stealth. Deathrattle: Store Halkias's soul inside of a friendly Secret. It resummons Halkias when triggered.
Tag.zhCN: 潜行。亡语：将哈尔吉亚斯的灵魂储存在一个友方奥秘中。当其被触发时，重新召唤哈尔吉亚斯。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Everybody tough until the sinstones start walking.
Tag.zhCN: 起初大家过得都很苦，直到罪碑学会了自己走路。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $@ damage to a random enemy minion, twice. Improve your future Relics.
Tag.zhCN: 随机对一个敌方随从造成$@点伤害，触发两次。提升你此后的圣物效果。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Faster than an asteroid, and just as effective.
Tag.zhCN: 比小行星还快，效果还差不多。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Resurrect four friendly Imps. Infuse (@): Give your Imps +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：复活四个友方小鬼。注能（@）：使你的小鬼获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Not even death can stop Rafaam from pursuing a life of crime.
Tag.zhCN: 即便是死了，拉法姆也要以犯罪为生。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 所有随从牌的法力值消耗增加（2）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you drink muck, you go to the Maw before you die.
Tag.zhCN: 喝了泥浆的感觉，就像在活着的时候进入噬渊。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Costs (1) less for each Totem you've summoned this game.
Tag.zhCN: 在本局对战中，你每召唤一个图腾，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Totem Golem's uncle, gone too soon.
Tag.zhCN: 图腾魔像的叔叔，走得有点早。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, gain +1 Health.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，获得+1生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This one's heavier than the wooden totems. Mostly from the weight of your sins.
Tag.zhCN: 比木质的图腾重。主要是因为罪孽太重了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage to all minions. Summon a 2/2 Volatile Skeleton for each killed.
Tag.zhCN: 对所有随从造成$2点伤害。每消灭一个随从，召唤一个2/2的不稳定的骷髅。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Kel'Thuzad thinks adding a silent 'e' at the end of words makes them sound cooler.
Tag.zhCN: 其实只是普通的骷髅。克尔苏加德取这个名字只是为了气势。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：你使用的下一张奥秘牌的法力值消耗为（0）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It turns out she wasn't so great at keeping secrets after all.
Tag.zhCN: 事实证明，她的手上好像存不住秘密。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个白银之手新兵获得+3/+3和嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: And with the new title of 'Golden Hand Recruit', you also get a pay raise!
Tag.zhCN: 有了新职称“黄金之手新兵”，你的薪金也提升了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Infuse (@): Gain stats equal to the Attack of the minions that Infused this.
Tag.zhCN: 注能（@）：获得属性值，数值等同于为本随从注能的随从的攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: That poor golem is going to be stuck as a guard forever. He can never get a head!
Tag.zhCN: 可怜的魔像，被永远地困在了守卫的岗位上，再无出头之日！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：随机对一个敌人造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: These ice sculpures look so realistic!
Tag.zhCN: 这些冰雕看起来好像真的！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Taunt Battlecry: If you control a Secret, summon a copy of this.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。战吼：如果你控制一个奥秘，便召唤一个本随从的复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: “食尸”过的谣言，还算不算谣言？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you control a location, Discover a copy of a card in your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你控制一个地标，发现你牌库中一张牌的复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I'm afraid it came as a great shock to her when she died.
Tag.zhCN: 对她来说，她的离世恐怕是个巨大的打击。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Lifesteal. Battlecry: Deal 5 damage amongst enemies. Endlessly Infuse (@): Deal 1 more.
Tag.zhCN: 吸血，战吼：对所有敌人造成总计5点伤害。无限注能（@）：伤害增加1点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: History has a way of altering villains so that we can no longer see ourselves in them. Unfortunately for the Venthyr, they all look like Sire Denathrius.
Tag.zhCN: 历史可以帮助人们避免走上反派的老路。不幸的是，温西尔个个都和大帝差不多。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After another minion dies, become a copy of it.
Tag.zhCN: 在另一个随从死亡后，成为它的复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I do not like this painting, Harth. Its smug aura mocks me.
Tag.zhCN: 我不喜欢这幅画，哈斯老板。它学我。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After your hero attacks, summon a random basic Totem.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的英雄攻击后，随机召唤一个基础图腾。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Look at your stone. Visualize the totem within. Then gently...
Tag.zhCN: 观察你的石头。想象其中的图腾。然后轻轻地……

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Transform a friendly minion into one that costs (2) more. Infuse (@): Transform all friendly minions instead.
Tag.zhCN: 将一个友方随从变形成为法力值消耗增加（2）点的随从。注能（@）：改为变形所有友方随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Okay gang, let's see who's really under the mask… *gasp* Old Man Bru'kan!?
Tag.zhCN: 好了，朋友们，看看面具后面是谁……*啊*是老布鲁坎！？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, your Totems have +2 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：在本局对战的剩余时间内，你的图腾拥有+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She wrights stone better than she reads it.
Tag.zhCN: 她可是“石纹锻字”的匠人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Transform a friendly minion into one that costs (1) more.
Tag.zhCN: 将一个友方随从变形成为法力值消耗增加（1）点的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Making a dredger is easier than you'd think. You don't need to worry about mucking it up!
Tag.zhCN: 制作泥仆比你想象的简单，搞砸了都不怕！

Tag.name: HOW_TO_EARN
Tag.zhCN: 与萨满祭司职业一同解锁。

Tag.name: HOW_TO_EARN_GOLDEN
Tag.enUS: Unlocked after winning 100 games as Shaman.
Tag.zhCN: 使用萨满祭司赢得100场对战后解锁。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Transform enemy minions into ones that cost (1) less and friendly minions into ones that cost (1) more.
Tag.zhCN: 将敌方随从变形成为法力值消耗减少（1）点的随从，将友方随从变形成为法力值消耗增加（1）点的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A primordial hello to you too!
Tag.zhCN: 有味道的插画，有味道的名字。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 受伤时拥有+2攻击力和冲锋。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Reveal a card from each player's deck, three times. Draw any of yours that cost more.
Tag.zhCN: 揭示每个玩家牌库中的一张牌，如果你的牌法力值消耗较大，抽取你的牌。揭示三次。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Olgra, I love your new tapestry! Where did you get it?
Tag.zhCN: 我喜欢你的新挂毯，奥格拉！你在哪搞的？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]After your hero attacks, give your damaged minions +1/+2. Infuse (@): +2/+2 instead.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的英雄攻击后，使你受伤的随从获得+1/+2。注能（@）：改为+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 严格地说，这是一把待灌能战斧。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：每有一个受伤的随从，便获得+1/+1，然后攻击所有敌人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]At the end of your turn, summon a random basic Totem. Infuse (@): Summon two instead.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，随机召唤一个基础图腾。注能（@）：改为召唤两个。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's the gift (totem) that keeps on giving (totems)!
Tag.zhCN: 可以升值（图腾）的装饰品（图腾）！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤一个3/5并具有嘲讽的元素。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: All it takes is a little love and a LOT of junk!
Tag.zhCN: 只需要一点点的爱意，和大量的垃圾！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Discover and cast a Relic. Infuse (@): Cast all three instead.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现并施放一个圣物。注能（@）：改为施放全部三个。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "The anticipation to use this relic is killing me! Though, it will more likely kill you."
Tag.zhCN: “我一直想玩玩这件圣物，都快想疯了！而你们的死，可以填补我多年的空虚。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Draw a spell. Infuse_(@): Add a Temporary copy of it to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 抽一张法术牌。注能（@）：将它的一张临时复制置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Upon arrival, please ring the doorbell of shadows, and wipe your shoes on the doormat of shadows before entering.
Tag.zhCN: 来到门前时，请按下暗影之门铃，并且请在进门前在暗影之门垫上擦净鞋底。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal $3 damage to a minion. If it dies, your next card this turn costs (2) less.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$3点伤害。如果该随从死亡，在本回合中，你的下一张牌法力值消耗减少（2）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Draka, in an attempt to help, threw them a bone.
Tag.zhCN: 德拉卡给予了对手不少骨粒。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Equip a @/3 Dagger. (+1 Attack for each other card you played this turn, up to 10!)
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：装备一把@/3的匕首。（在本回合中你每使用一张其他牌便+1攻击力， 最高10点！）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: We originally planned on giving Rogue a Legendary minion called "The Moon", but SOMEONE jumped in the frame.
Tag.zhCN: 我们原本计划推出一张叫做“月亮”的潜行者传说随从牌，可有人突然跳进了取景框。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: The next Relic you play this turn casts twice.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中你使用的下一个圣物将施放两次。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Holds Sire Denathrius' most prized possession - his teddy bear, Jeremy Bearimy.
Tag.zhCN: 内藏德纳修斯最珍视的宝物：他的泰迪熊，杰里米·贝里米。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summon two @/@ Spirits. Improve your future Relics.
Tag.zhCN: 召唤两个@/@的灵魂。提升你此后的圣物效果。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Xy'mox chuckled. "You mean the Chaos Emerald?"
Tag.zhCN: 赛·墨克斯笑了。“你指的是混沌宝石吗？”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现一张另一职业的奥秘牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: More of a 'Painted Stranger' if you ask me.
Tag.zhCN: 资源全部加载完毕后，我觉得更像是“清晰的陌生人”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Destroy ALL cards in both players' decks that didn't start there.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：摧毁双方玩家牌库中所有套牌之外的牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Business is slow since the anima shortage began. Things just don't get stained like they used to!
Tag.zhCN: 自从心能短缺，工作清闲了下来。地上迸溅的心能少多了！

Tag.name: HOW_TO_EARN_GOLDEN
Tag.zhCN: 总计赢得1000场对战后解锁。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，战吼：发现一张圣骑士牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Party guests never tip as well as the patrons in Bob's tavern.
Tag.zhCN: 派对来宾从不像鲍勃的酒客那样大方地给小费。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Discover a Class card from your deck and draw all copies of it.
Tag.zhCN: 从你的牌库中发现一张职业牌，抽取它的所有复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The bell tolls for us! Waiter, we need more water!
Tag.zhCN: 钟是我们按的！你好，请给这桌添点水！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Shoot 5 rays at random minions. They give friendly minions +2/+2, and deal $2 damage to enemy minions.
Tag.zhCN: 随机向随从发射5道射线。射线可使友方随从获得+2/+2，或对敌方随从造成$2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Never send to know for whom the bell tolls.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: If your deck has no Neutral cards, add 3 Legendary Invitations to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你的牌库中没有中立卡牌，将3张传说邀请函置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 三张传说邀请函，啊！啊！啊！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Add 2 Silver Hand Recruits to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语： 将2张“白银之手新兵”置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If this dinner party goes well, she thinks she has a good shot at being on Fel's Kitchen.
Tag.zhCN: 如果这场晚宴一切顺利，她就有信心参加地狱厨房了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deathrattle: Give the next Silver Hand Recruit you summon +3/+3 and this Deathrattle.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语： 使你召唤的下一个白银之手新兵获得+3/+3以及此亡语。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: How many bites does it take to get the center of an hors d'oeuvre?
Tag.zhCN: 这点心要啃多少口才能吃到馅？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Funnel cakes? I haven't had those in years…"
Tag.zhCN: “美味的漏斗蛋糕？我好多年没尝过了……”

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The best part of Murlocula is when he said "IT'S MRRGLIN' TIME" and totally mrrgled those guys.
Tag.zhCN: 鱼人吸血鬼的高光时刻：高喊“现在是鱼人时间”，然后把所有人都吸掉。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Summon two Silver Hand Recruits. Infuse (@): Give them +2 Attack and Divine Shield.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤两个白银之手新兵。注能（@）：使其获得+2攻击力和圣盾。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Look, I just want to know what kind of monster put raisins in this."
Tag.zhCN: “我就想知道，究竟是什么样的怪物在这里面加了葡萄干。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: If you control a Secret, choose a card in your opponent's hand to _shuffle into their deck.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你控制一个奥秘，选择你的对手的一张手牌洗入其牌库。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Some people take their secrets to the grave.
Tag.zhCN: 有些人会把秘密带进坟墓里。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Whenever your opponent draws a card next turn, they take 2 damage.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：下个回合，每当你的对手抽牌时，对手会受到2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "The castle was nice but the fireplaces were too small - 2/5 stars"
Tag.zhCN: “城堡很棒，可惜壁炉太小了。评价：2/5。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: For each Paladin card in your hand, randomly gain Divine Shield, Lifesteal, Rush, or Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：你手牌中每有一张圣骑士牌，便从圣盾，吸血，突袭或嘲讽中获得一项。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I heard the Sire invited a Murloc! How dreadful!"
Tag.zhCN: “听说大帝邀请了鱼人！太可怕了！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Set a minion's Attack and Health to 3.
Tag.zhCN: 将一个随从的攻击力和生命值变为3。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's fabulous! It's grand! It's, well it's really very nice.
Tag.zhCN: 漂亮！大气！嗯……真的挺好的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal 1 damage to a minion and give it +2 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成1点伤害，并使其获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: There may not be any skeletons in the closets at Castle Nathria, but there sure are souls in the basement.
Tag.zhCN: 纳斯利亚堡的衣橱里或许没有骷髅，但地下深处是真的关着灵魂。

Tag.zhCN: 使用战士赢得100场对战后解锁。

Tag.zhCN: 引爆一份残骸，对所有随从造成$1点伤害。如果有随从存活，重复此效果。

Tag.enUS: What? It's not like they were using them anymore.
Tag.zhCN: 怎么了？反正这些身体他们再也用不上了。

Tag.name: HOW_TO_EARN
Tag.zhCN: 与死亡骑士职业一同解锁。

Tag.name: HOW_TO_EARN_GOLDEN
Tag.enUS: Unlocked after winning 100 games as Death Knight.
Tag.zhCN: 使用死亡骑士赢得100场对战后解锁。

Tag.zhCN: 与死亡骑士职业一同解锁。

Tag.zhCN: 虽然他也拥有蓝色的，胖胖的身材，但他和某部动画片里的主角没关系。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage to an undamaged minion.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个未受伤的随从造成$2点 伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's funny how often yelling "Look over there!" gets your opponent to turn around.
Tag.zhCN: 大叫着“看那儿！”，然后让你的对手背对着你，这一招总是出奇地有效。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give a minion +2 Attack. Combo: +4 Attack instead.
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从获得+2攻击力；连击：改为获得+4攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I'm cold blooded, check it and see!"

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使你的武器获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Rogues guard the secrets to poison-making carefully, lest magi start incorporating poison into their spells. Poisonbolt? Rain of Poison? Poison Elemental? Nobody wants that.
Tag.zhCN: 潜行者们都小心翼翼地保守着制毒的秘密，唯恐法师们把毒药用在他们的法术之中。毒性箭？剧毒之雨？毒元素？听上去就很可怕。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 对敌方英雄造成$3点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: There's something about this strike that just feels off. Sinister, even.
Tag.zhCN: 尽管这个技能的名字已被改变，但这并不意味着它就不再“邪恶”。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you don't want to be assassinated, move to the Barrens and change your name. Good luck!
Tag.zhCN: 要是你不想被人暗杀，躲到贫瘠之地，然后隐姓埋名。祝你好运！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 潜行者们通常都不擅长慢跑。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Guaranteed to have been owned by a real assassin. Certificate of authenticity included.
Tag.zhCN: 只有真正的刺客才配拥有。如假包换。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 英雄技能 装备一把1/2的 匕首。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 英雄技能 装备一把1/2的 匕首。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Never play 'Hide and Go Seek' with a Hunter.
Tag.zhCN: 千万不要和猎人玩捉迷藏的游戏。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从获得+3攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "As in, you MIGHT want to get out of my way." - Toad Mackle, recently buffed.
Tag.zhCN: 没有善，没有恶，也没有圣光。只有——力量！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，战吼：为你的英雄恢复#6点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Holy beings from the beyond are so cliché!
Tag.zhCN: 神圣的造物从天而降...真是老掉牙的剧情！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 为你的英雄恢复#8点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you are often bathed in Holy Light, you should consider wearing sunscreen.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你经常暴露于圣光之下，你应该考虑随身带着防晒霜。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Prince Malchezaar was a collector of rare weapons. He'd animate them and have them dance for him.
Tag.zhCN: 玛克扎尔王子收集了不少稀有的武器，他赋予它们生命，并让它们为他起舞。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从获得+4/+4。（+4攻击力/+4生命值）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Given the number of kings who have been assassinated, are you sure you want their blessing?
Tag.zhCN: 你知道世界上有多少所谓的“王者”被暗杀了吗？你确定还想要王者祝福吗？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 对所有敌人造成$2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Consecrated ground glows with Holy energy. But it smells a little, too.
Tag.zhCN: 神圣的能量从圣洁的大地涌出。但是，味道也有点熏人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A good paladin has many tools. Hammer of Wrath, Pliers of Vengeance, Hacksaw of Justice, etc.
Tag.zhCN: 一个称职的圣骑士身上会携带很多工具。愤怒之锤、复仇之钳、正义之锯，等等。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever your hero attacks, restore #3_Health to it.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你的英雄进攻，便为其恢复#3点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It Slices, it Dices. You can cut a tin can with it. (But you wouldn't want to.)
Tag.zhCN: 它能用来切片，也能切块。你还可以用它来开罐头。（但你不会这么做的。）

Tag.zhCN: 使一个友方随从获得+2攻击力和冲锋。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Guys! Guys! Slow down!" - some kind of non-warrior minion
Tag.zhCN: “伙计们！伙计们！你们稳着点儿！”——某些不属于战士的随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个受伤的随从获得+3/+3。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 随从很愤怒。随从很厉害！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，使你的英雄获得+4攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Really, if you're a hero, this is every strike.
Tag.zhCN: 真英雄，必英勇，赶快使用英勇打击，做真英雄！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: During times of tranquility and harmony, this weapon was called by its less popular name, Chilly Peace Axe.
Tag.zhCN: 在安宁祥和的年代，人们用另一个不太流行的名字称呼这把武器，寒冰静谧战斧。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个受伤的敌方随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: No… actually you should fear the Reaper.
Tag.zhCN: “那个消失了的潜行者再也不曾出现过...”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal $2 damage to two random enemy minions.
Tag.zhCN: 随机对两个敌方随从造成 $2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Hey you two…could you stand next to each other for a second…
Tag.zhCN: 嘿，你们俩...你们能不能站在一起？就一会儿...

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He can see really far, and he doesn't use a telescope like those filthy pirates.
Tag.zhCN: 他确实能看得很远，他才不像那些肮脏的海盗们需要用望远镜。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He likes to think he is powerful, but pretty much anyone can solo Molten Core now.
Tag.zhCN: 尽管现在每个人都能单刷熔火之心了，但他依然觉得自己很厉害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: His dreams of flying and breathing fire like his idol will never be realized.
Tag.zhCN: 它的梦想是能够像它的偶像那样飞行和吐息火焰，但这样的梦想永远无法实现。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Edward "Lefty" Smith tried to make luggage out of a river crocolisk once.
Tag.zhCN: “左撇子”爱德华·史密斯曾经试着从一条淡水鳄的嘴里把行李夺回来。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Grunting is what his father did and his father before that. It's more than just a job.
Tag.zhCN: 他的祖祖辈辈都是步兵，这已经不仅仅是一份工作而已了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的其他随从拥有+1攻击力。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Raid Leader is granting this minion +1 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 团队领袖使本随从获得+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Orcish raiders ride wolves because they are well adapted to harsh environments, and because they are soft and cuddly.
Tag.zhCN: 兽人劫掠者们以狼作为坐骑是因为它们能够适应艰苦的环境，而且它们特别温顺，很会讨兽人喜欢。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He likes to act like he's in charge, but the silverback matriarch actually runs things.
Tag.zhCN: 尽管他表现得像个领导者，但实际上银背母猩猩才是真正管事的人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They're still embarrassed about "The Deathwing Incident".
Tag.zhCN: 对于“死亡之翼毁城事件”，他仍然耿耿于怀。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: In the old days, Kobolds were the finest candle merchants in the land. Then they got pushed too far...
Tag.zhCN: 在过去，狗头人是这片土地上最好的蜡烛交易商，直到它们被逼太甚...

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Has Charge while you have a weapon equipped.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你装备着武器，本随从拥有 冲锋。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Pirates are into this new fad called "Planking".
Tag.zhCN: 海盗们都非常热衷于这项新的时尚活动：“趴甲板”。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She's never quite sure what she's making, she just knows it's AWESOME!
Tag.zhCN: 她从来不知道她想发明的是什么，她只知道要发明很棒的东西！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Stormpike Commandos are demolition experts. They also bake a mean cupcake.
Tag.zhCN: 雷矛特种兵都是爆破专家。他们还会烘焙简易的蛋糕。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's good to be a knight. Less so to be one's squire.
Tag.zhCN: 做一名骑士很威风，但是做骑士的侍从感觉就差一点了。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You earn the title of Archmage when you can destroy anyone who calls you on it.
Tag.zhCN: 只要你能消灭任何质疑你的头衔的人，你就能获得“大法师”的头衔。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Just mail him a package with a name and 10,000 gold. He'll take care of the rest.
Tag.zhCN: 把姓名和10000金币打包邮寄给他。剩下的他会帮你搞定。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He used to be a 2100+ rated arena player, but that was years ago and nobody can get him to shut up about it.
Tag.zhCN: 他曾经是一个2100分段的竞技场高端玩家。但那已经是几年前的事情了，而且没人能阻止他继续吹嘘这件事。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Mrrraggglhlhghghlgh, mrgaaag blarrghlgaahahl mrgggg glhalhah a bghhll graggmgmg Garrosh mglhlhlh mrghlhlhl!!
Tag.zhCN: 姆啦啦咯哈姆噶啊啊嘎，姆啦嘎嘎咯，啵啦啦嗯嘞噶哈，姆啦嗝，咯啦哈哈吧啦咯。加尔鲁什咯嘛啦喝，嘛啦咯呵！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They were the inspiration for the championship Taurenball team: The Dragonhawks.
Tag.zhCN: 无论是战士还是诗人，都能从美丽的龙鹰身上获取战斗或是写作的灵感。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 决斗的时候离它们远点儿。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: “去杀30条迅猛龙。”——赫米特·奈辛瓦里

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He just wants a hug. A sloppy... slimy... hug.
Tag.zhCN: 他只是想要一个拥抱。一个黏黏的...滑滑的...拥抱。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Sen'jin Village is nice, if you like trolls and dust.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你喜欢巨魔和沙尘的话，森金村还是个不错的地方。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He claims it is an old war wound, but we think he just cut himself shaving.
Tag.zhCN: 他说这是在一次惨烈的战斗中留下的伤疤，但我们觉得，他只是刮胡子的时候弄伤了自己。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He always dreamed of coming down from the mountains and opening a noodle shop, but he never got the nerve.
Tag.zhCN: 他梦想着有一天能够下山开一间拉面店。但他没有那个勇气。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Golems are not afraid, but for some reason they still run when you cast Fear on them. Instinct, maybe? A desire to blend in?
Tag.zhCN: 傀儡们从来不会胆怯，但是出于某种原因，当你对它们施放“恐惧”的时候，它们依然会逃跑。也许这就是天性？或是想要融入这个世界的渴望？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You can hire him... until someone offers him enough gold to turn on you.
Tag.zhCN: 你可以雇佣他们为你效命...直到有人出更高的价钱来让他们对付你。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：在本回合中，使一个随从获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: ADD ME TO YOUR DECK, MAGGOT!

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: This minion has +2 Attack this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，本随从拥有+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Don't bother asking her out on a date. She'll shoot you down.
Tag.zhCN: 媚眼如丝，轻盈如燕，致命如箭。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Someone did mess with Tuskerr once. ONCE.
Tag.zhCN: 有人曾经把塔丝克惹毛过一次。就一次。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Training Ogres in the art of spellcasting is a questionable decision.
Tag.zhCN: 教授食人魔如何施法是个值得商榷的决定。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "ME HAVE GOOD STATS FOR THE COST"
Tag.zhCN: “我非常厉害，绝对值这个价格！”

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You don’t tame a Core Hound. You just train it to eat someone else before it eats you.
Tag.zhCN: 你无法驯服一头熔火恶犬。你只能通过训练让它在吃掉你之前先吃掉其他人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Their wings are silent but their screech is... whatever the opposite of silent is.
Tag.zhCN: 它们挥动翅膀的时候悄无声息，但是它们的嘶鸣却是...任何悄无声息的反义词都可以形容。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: One Insane Rocketeer. One Rocket full of Explosives. Infinite Fun.
Tag.zhCN: 一个疯狂的火箭兵加上一个装满炸药的火箭。完美的组合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your weapon has +2 Attack while this is damaged.
Tag.zhCN: 本随从受伤时，你的武器拥有+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She'll craft you a sword, but you'll need to bring her 5 Steel Ingots, 3 Motes of Earth, and the scalp of her last customer.
Tag.zhCN: 她会为你代工一把好武器，但是你必须给她5个铁锭，3个土之微粒，以及她上一个顾客的头皮。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 恶毒铁匠使其获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: When Deathwing assaulted the capital, this soldier was the only member of his squad to survive. Now he's all bitter and stuff.
Tag.zhCN: 在死亡之翼攻击主城的时候，这个士兵是小队中唯一活下来的一个。现在，他已经变得忍辱负重，镇定自若了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each other friendly minion on the battlefield.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：战场上每有一个其他友方随从，便获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Frostwolves are locked in combat with the Stormpike Expedition over control of Alterac Valley. Every attempt at peace-talks has ended with Captain Galvangar killing the mediator.
Tag.zhCN: 为了争夺奥克兰特山谷的控制权，霜狼氏族和雷矛探险队打得不可开交。任何前来企图进行和平谈判的斡旋者都会被处死。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的随从牌的法力值消耗增加（3）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: No Job is too big. No fee is too big.

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you hit an Eredar Lord with enough Wisps, it will explode. But why?
Tag.zhCN: 如果你用足够多的小精灵攻击艾瑞达领主的话，他就会爆炸。但这是为什么呢？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 我打赌你一定不敢进攻达纳苏斯。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy your weapon and deal its damage to all enemy minions.
Tag.zhCN: 摧毁你的武器，对所有敌方随从 造成等同于其攻击力的伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Look, it's not just about waving daggers around really fast. It's a lot more complicated than that." - Shan, Rogue Trainer
Tag.zhCN: “注意看好，并不是把匕首飞快地挥来挥去就行了，比那要复杂得多。”——潜行者训练师，肖

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy a minion with 3_or less Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个攻击力小于或等于3的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A step up from a spell cast by many beginning acolytes: "Shadow Word: Annoy".
Tag.zhCN: 许多侍僧学徒都会施放：“暗言术：怒”，这个法术是它的进阶法术。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a minion is healed, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个随从获得治疗时，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They help the downtrodden and distressed. Also they sell cookies.
Tag.zhCN: 她们帮助被压迫和沮丧的人们。她们也卖饼干。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从的生命值翻倍。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Double the trouble. Double the fun!
Tag.zhCN: 加倍的付出会得到加倍的收获！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you summon a Beast, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你召唤一个野兽，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you feed him, he loses his whole identity.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你喂饱了它，它就名不副实了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Spell Damage +2 Deathrattle: The next minion_you draw inherits these powers.
Tag.zhCN: 法术伤害+2，亡语：你抽到的下一张随从牌会继承这些能力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: With Medivh as her son, nothing YOU do could ever disappoint her.

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 他们能够预见未来。在未来的时间里，双方玩家都将抽更多的牌。真准！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you cast a spell, gain +2 Attack this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，每当你施放一个法术，便获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She’s trying to kick the habit, but still takes some mana whenever she has a stressful day.
Tag.zhCN: 她很想戒掉这嗜好，但是每当她感到压力很大的时候，她总是会吸上几口。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Return a friendly minion from the battlefield to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使一个友方随从从战场上移回你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Most pandaren say his brew tastes like yak. But apparently that's a compliment.
Tag.zhCN: 大部分熊猫人都喜欢去他的酒坊喝酒，然后在好几天以后才能记起回家的路。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.enUS: Return a minion to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 将一个随从移回你的手牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使相邻的随从获得嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She carries a shield, but only so she can give it to someone she can stand behind.
Tag.zhCN: 她拿着一面盾牌，但也只有这样，她才能把它给别人，然后躲在后面。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Swap the Attack and Health of a minion.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 使一个随从的攻击力和生命值互换。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "You'll love my new recipe!" he says... especially if you're not happy with your current number of limbs.
Tag.zhCN: “你一定会喜欢我的新配方的！”他总是这么说...特别是当你对你现在的触手数量不满意的时候。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.enUS: Swap Attack and Health of a minion.
Tag.zhCN: 将一个随从的攻击力和生命值互换。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Attack and Health have been swapped by Crazed Alchemist.
Tag.zhCN: 疯狂的炼金师使其攻击力和生命值互换。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Charge. Has +1 Attack for each other Murloc on the battlefield.
Tag.zhCN: 冲锋，在战场上每有一个其他鱼人便拥有+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's a legend among murlocs. "Mrghllghghllghg!", they say.
Tag.zhCN: 他是鱼人中的传奇。“姆咯啦咯咯啦呵嘎哈咯！”他们都这么说他。

Tag.name: HOW_TO_EARN
Tag.enUS: Unlocked when you have all the Murlocs from the Legacy Set.
Tag.zhCN: 集齐所有怀旧系列鱼人牌后解锁。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 软泥怪喜欢弗拉门戈舞。别问为什么。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Argent Dawn stands vigilant against the Scourge, as well as people who cut in line at coffee shops.
Tag.zhCN: 银色指挥官总是机警地注意着天灾军团的动向，同时阻止任何想在咖啡店里插队买咖啡的人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: The first minion you play each turn costs (1) less.
Tag.zhCN: 你每个回合使用的第一张随从牌的法力值消耗减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She's quite jealous of the Gallon-Sized Summoner.
Tag.zhCN: 大个子召唤师就是由她召唤出来的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 每当有一张奥秘牌被使用时，便获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Where is Mankrik’s wife? She’ll never tell.
Tag.zhCN: 她永远也不会告诉你曼科里克的妻子在哪里。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage randomly split between all other characters.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：造成3点伤害，随机分配到所有其他角色身上。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's not really all that crazy, he is just not as careful with explosives as he should be.
Tag.zhCN: 其实他也不算是很疯狂，他只是应该在携带炸药的时候更加小心一点而已。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Transform another random minion into a 5/5 Devilsaur or a 1/1 Squirrel.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 随机使另一个随从变形成为一个5/5的魔暴龙或一个1/1的松鼠。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Tinkmaster Overspark nearly lost his Tinker's license after the Great Ironforge Squirrel Stampede of '09.
Tag.zhCN: 在09年度的铁炉堡松鼠大暴走事件之后，工匠大师欧沃斯巴克差点丢掉了他的工匠执照。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.enUS: Transform a minion into a 5/5 or a 1/1 at random.
Tag.zhCN: 随机将一个随从变形成为5/5或者1/1。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you summon a minion with 3 or less Attack, give it Charge.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你召唤一个攻击力小于或等于3的随从，使其获得冲锋。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Warsong clan is such drama. It's really not worth it to become a commander.
Tag.zhCN: 战歌氏族中闹剧不断，什么三教九流的人都能当上他们的指挥官。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: If your opponent has 4 or more minions, take control of one.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你的对手有4个或者更多随从，夺取其中一个的控制权。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Mind Control technology is getting better, but that's not saying much.
Tag.zhCN: 精神控制技术正在日益改善，但这并不能说明什么。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.zhCN: 夺取一个随从的控制权。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Charge. Battlecry: Give your opponent a Mana Crystal.
Tag.zhCN: 冲锋，战吼：使你的对手获得一个法力水晶。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Having Arcane golems at home really classes up the place, and as a bonus they are great conversation pieces.
Tag.zhCN: 如果家里有一台奥术傀儡的话，一定能够使房间蓬荜生辉，格调提高，而且，它们还能成为不错的谈资。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Take control of an enemy minion that has 2 or less Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：夺取一个攻击力小于或等于2的敌方随从的控制权。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You never know who may be secretly working for the Cabal....
Tag.zhCN: 你绝不知道谁在为这个秘密组织效劳...

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.enUS: Steal a minion that has 2 or less Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 偷取一个攻击力小于或等于2的敌方随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使相邻的随从获得+1/+1和嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You wouldn’t think that Argus would need this much defending. But it does.
Tag.zhCN: 你肯定没想到阿古斯会需要如此坚实的防御。但它确实需要。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you cast a spell, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你施放一个法术，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He used to run the black market auction house, but there was just too much violence and he had to move.
Tag.zhCN: 他曾经经营过黑市的拍卖行，但是那里的暴力冲突太多了，他只好被迫离开。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，亡语：对所有角色造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Abominations enjoy Fresh Meat and long walks on the beach.
Tag.zhCN: 憎恶喜欢享用新鲜的肉，以及在海滩上漫步。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a player casts a spell, put a copy into the other player’s hand.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个玩家施放一个法术，复制该法术，将其置入另一个玩家的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Lorewalker Cho archives and shares tales from the land of Pandaria, but his favorite story is the one where Joey and Phoebe go on a road trip.
Tag.zhCN: 游学者周卓整理并分享有关潘达利亚大陆的轶事，但他最喜欢的故事，是乔伊和菲比一起外出旅行发生的事情。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the start of your turn, deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合开始时，随机对一个敌人造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Laying siege isn't fun for anyone. It's not even all that effective, now that everyone has a flying mount.
Tag.zhCN: 攻城这件事一点儿也不好玩，而且通常还不怎么奏效，因为现在人人都有飞行坐骑。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使你的其他鱼人获得+2生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Coldlight murlocs reside in the darkest pits of the Abyssal Depths. So no, there's no getting away from murlocs.
Tag.zhCN: 寒光鱼人终年居住于无底海渊最黑暗的洞穴之中。所以，是的，你到哪儿都别想摆脱鱼人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Costs (1) less for each other card in your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 你每有一张其他手牌，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: His mother said that he was just big boned.
Tag.zhCN: 他的妈妈说，他只是骨架比较大而已。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。亡语：&召唤一个5/5的贝恩·血蹄。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Cairne was killed by Garrosh, so... don't put this guy in a Warrior deck. It's pretty insensitive.
Tag.zhCN: 凯恩被加尔鲁什杀害了，所以...别把这张牌放在战士的套牌里，这完全说不通。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's the leader of the gnomes, and an incredible inventor. He's getting better, too; He turns things into chickens WAY less than he used to.
Tag.zhCN: 他是侏儒的领袖，无与伦比的发明家。而且他变得越来越像个领袖了；相比他只是个发明家的时候，他已经不那么经常把人变成小鸡了。

Tag.name: HOW_TO_EARN_GOLDEN
Tag.enUS: This was rewarded to players who helped test the Store during the Beta.
Tag.zhCN: 所有在测试阶段参与测试商店功能的玩家都能获得此项奖励。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Charge. Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Whelps for your opponent.
Tag.zhCN: 冲锋，战吼： 为你的对手召唤两条1/1的雏龙。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: At least he has Angry Chicken.
Tag.zhCN: 至少他还有愤怒的小鸡。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 造成$2点伤害；连击：改为造成$4点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: There is a high cost to Eviscerating your opponent. You might tweak your elbow! That really hurts!
Tag.zhCN: 在你向对手使用刺骨时需要特别小心！一旦把手肘搭进去，那可就得不偿失了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 使一个敌方随从对其相邻的随从 造成等同于其攻击力的伤害。

Tag.zhCN: 每个人都有背叛的价码。拿侏儒打比方的话，长毛绒玩具和一小点儿巧克力就能让他们就范。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give your minions Stealth until your next_turn.
Tag.zhCN: 直到你的下个回合，使所有友方随从获得潜行。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Rogues conceal everything but their emotions. You can't get 'em to shut up about feelings.
Tag.zhCN: 潜行者们能够隐藏除了他们表情之外的一切东西。你不能阻止他们表达执行暗杀后的兴奋感觉。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 获得潜行直到你的下个回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $1 damage to all enemy minions. Draw_a card.
Tag.zhCN: 对所有敌方随从造成$1点伤害，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I wouldn't say I LOVE knives, but I'm definitely a fan.
Tag.zhCN: 转瞬即逝的寒光闪过，漫天飞舞的血花绽放。

Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当一个敌人攻击时，召唤一个2/1的防御者，并使其成为攻击的目标。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 我们永远不会忘记你，“防御者！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 连击：&召唤一个2/1的迪菲亚强盗。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He stole the deed to town years ago, so technically the town is his. He just calls people Scrub to be mean.
Tag.zhCN: 他在数年前偷走了地契，所以理论上说这片地盘确实是他的。他还喜欢用“白痴”称呼别人，显得自己很有势力。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When your hero takes damage, deal_that much damage to the enemy hero.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘： 当你的英雄受到伤害时，对敌方英雄造成等量伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Justice sometimes takes the form of a closed fist into a soft cheek.
Tag.zhCN: 有时正义的表现形式就是这么简单：紧握的拳头打在瘫软的脸上。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：造成1点伤害。连击：改为造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Perdition's Blade is Ragnaros's back-up weapon while Sulfuras is in the shop.
Tag.zhCN: 当拉格纳罗斯还买不起萨弗拉斯的时候，他的武器正是毁灭之刃。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.zhCN: 造成1点伤害。@造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The agents of SI:7 are responsible for Stormwind's covert activities. Their duties include espionage, assassination, and throwing surprise birthday parties for the royal family.
Tag.zhCN: 军情七处的特工们负责暴风城内的所有隐秘行动，包括间谍活动、暗杀以及秘密筹备皇室成员的生日派对。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当一个友方随从死亡时，使其回到战场，并具有1点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I am not sure how you get demptioned the first time. It’s a mystery!
Tag.zhCN: 救赎并非是从罪恶中得以解脱，而是对生活的彻底肯定，包括其中的痛苦、折磨和荒诞。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage to the enemy hero. Combo: Return this to your hand next turn.
Tag.zhCN: 对敌方英雄造成$2点伤害；连击：在下个回合将其移回你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: When all else fails, nothing beats a swift whack upside the head.
Tag.zhCN: 就算其他方法都不管用，直接往头上狠狠来一下总是会有效的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Return a friendly minion to your hand. It_costs (2) less.
Tag.zhCN: 将一个友方随从移回你的手牌，它的法力值消耗减少 （2）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Rogue dance troops will sometimes Shadowstep away at the end of a performance. Crowds love it.
Tag.zhCN: 潜行者的攻击有如舞蹈，有时他们会以暗影步结束这一切。这不是什么终结技，只因为观众喜欢这样子。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，你所施放的下一个法术的法力值消耗减少（2）点。

Tag.enUS: The next spell you cast this turn costs (2) less.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，你所施放的下一个法术的法力值消耗减少（2）点。

Tag.zhCN: 抉择： 对一个随从造成$3点伤害；或者造成$1点伤害并抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The talk around the Ratchet Inn is that this card is too good and should be a Legendary.
Tag.zhCN: 棘齿城酒馆里的人们纷纷表示，这张牌太强了，应该是传说级别的。

Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$1点伤害，抽一张牌。

Tag.zhCN: 抉择： 使一个随从获得+4攻击力；或者+4生命值和嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Druids call it the "Mark of Nature." Everyone else calls it "needing a bath."
Tag.zhCN: 只有德鲁伊们称之为“自然印记”。其他人都喜欢说“加个状态”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从获得+4生命值和 嘲讽。

Tag.zhCN: 本随从拥有+4生命值和嘲讽。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 使你的所有随从获得“亡语：召唤一个2/2的树人”。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: “重新造林”计划突然听起来像是个恐怖的阴谋。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Choose One - Give your minions +1/+1; or Summon a 3/2 Panther.
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：使你的所有随从获得+1/+1；或者召唤一只3/2的 猎豹。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Never look a panther in the eye. Or is it 'Always look a panther in the eye'? Well, it's one of those.
Tag.zhCN: 在灰谷的树林中，猎豹的毛皮漆黑油亮，数量众多。那为什么这地方要叫灰谷，而不是黑谷呢？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy a minion. Your opponent draws 2_cards.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个随从，你的对手抽两张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 又一位战死沙场的将士。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 相邻的随从拥有+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: We are pretty excited about the upcoming release of Dire Wolf Beta, just repost this sign for a chance at a key.

Tag.zhCN: 抉择：获得两个法力水晶；或者抽三张牌。

Tag.enUS: Druids take nourishment from many things: the power of nature, the songbird's chirp, a chocolate cake.
Tag.zhCN: 德鲁伊能够从很多地方获得精神上的滋养：自然的伟力；鸟儿的鸣唱；蛋糕的美味。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：变形成为7/6并具有突袭；或者变形成为4/9并具有嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Cat or Bear? Cat or Bear?! I just cannot CHOOSE!
Tag.zhCN: 是猎豹还是熊？！是猎豹还是熊？！真是艰难的抉择！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：造成2点伤害；或者沉默一个随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: These guys just show up and start Keeping your Groves without even asking.
Tag.zhCN: 这些家伙不知道从哪儿冒出来，然后就自说自话地开始守护你的丛林了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Gain 1 Mana Crystal this turn only.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，获得一个 法力水晶。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Some druids still have flashbacks from strangers yelling "Innervate me!!" at them.

Tag.zhCN: 如果他现在还是很愤怒，那就等到他平静下来。

Tag.zhCN: 其实他的耐性并不好。只是等待他的目标靠近需要花点时间。

Tag.zhCN: 第一课：把尖的那头对准别人。

Tag.zhCN: 在你使用这张牌的时候，一定要喊出它的名字。
