Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Not only does it reveal your enemies, but it's also great for parties!
Tag.zhCN: 它不但能让你的敌人无处遁形，还能让整个晚会熠熠生辉！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give a friendly Beast +2 Attack and Immune this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，使一只友方野兽获得+2攻击力和免疫。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The seething wrath is just beneath the surface. Beneath that is wild abandon, followed by slight annoyance.
Tag.zhCN: 盛燃的愤怒掩藏于表面之下，同时还伴随着野性的狂放不羁和些许傲慢。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，+2攻击力和免疫。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When one of your minions is attacked, summon three 1/1 Snakes.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当你的随从受到攻击时，召唤三条1/1的蛇。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Why did it have to be snakes?

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：召唤一个2/1的损坏的傀儡。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Overheat threshold exceeded. System failure. Wheat clog in port two. Shutting down."
Tag.zhCN: “温度过高。系统失灵。二号仓粮食堵塞。正在关闭。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to draw an extra card.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合开始时，你有50%的几率额外抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Nat Pagle, Azeroth's premier fisherman! He invented the Auto-Angler 3000, the Extendo-Pole 3000, and the Lure-o-matic 2099 (still in testing).
Tag.zhCN: 纳特·帕格是艾泽拉斯最棒的钓手！他发明了自动鱼竿3000型，伸缩鱼竿3000型，以及电气自动诱捕器2099型（仍在测试中）。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Destroy your opponent's weapon and draw cards equal to its Durability.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：摧毁对手的武器，并抽数量等同于其耐久度的牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: “That belongs in the Hall of Explorers!”
Tag.zhCN: “这东西应该陈列在探险者大厅里！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you cast a spell,& add a 'Fireball' spell to_your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你施放一个法术，&将一张“火球术”法术牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Antonidas was the Grand Magus of the Kirin Tor, and Jaina's mentor. This was a big step up from being Grand Magus of Jelly Donuts.
Tag.zhCN: 肯瑞托的首席法师，达拉然最伟大的子民，安东尼达斯在被巫妖王阿尔萨斯杀死之前，曾是吉安娜的导师。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Players only have 15 seconds to take their_turns.
Tag.zhCN: 玩家只有15秒的时间来进行他们的回合。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Time to write some flavor text.
Tag.zhCN: 没时间写什么卡牌趣文了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Set a hero's remaining Health to 15.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 将一方英雄的剩余生命值变为15。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Alexstrasza the Life-Binder brings life and hope to everyone. Except Deathwing. And Malygos. And Nekros.
Tag.zhCN: 生命的缚誓者阿莱克丝塔萨给所有人带来生命和希望。除了死亡之翼。除了玛里苟斯。除了耐克鲁斯。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Summon 1/1 Whelps until your side of the battlefield is full.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤数条1/1的雏龙，直到你的随从数量达到上限。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Onyxia long manipulated the Stormwind Court by disguising herself as Lady Katrana Prestor. You would have thought that the giant wings and scales would have been a giveaway.
Tag.zhCN: 伪装成女伯爵卡特拉娜·普瑞斯托，奥妮克希亚长期控制着暴风城议会。你可能会想，一定是她的大翅膀和鳞片让她漏出了马脚。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Malygos hates it when mortals use magic. He gets so mad!
Tag.zhCN: 玛里苟斯憎恨凡人使用魔法。那会让他气急败坏！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Choose a minion and become a copy of it.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：选择一个随从，成为它的复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Faceless Ones are servants of Yogg-Saron, and they feed on fear. Right now they are feeding on your fear of accidentally disenchanting all your good cards.
Tag.zhCN: 作为尤格-萨隆的仆从，无面者们以人们的恐惧为食，而现在他们的菜谱中包括你对“不小心把好牌分解掉”的担心和忧虑。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.enUS: Become a copy of a minion.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 相邻的随从拥有+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Totemsmiths like to use the rarest woods for their totems. There are even rumors of totems made of Ironbark Protectors.
Tag.zhCN: 图腾制造师喜欢用最稀有的木材来打造图腾。甚至有传言说，这些图腾是由埃隆巴克保护者身上的树皮做的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 火舌图腾使其获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Orgrim Doomhammer gave this legendary weapon to Thrall. His name is a total coincidence.
Tag.zhCN: 奥格瑞姆·毁灭之锤将他的传奇武器赠与了萨尔。他的名字只是纯属巧合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give your hero +4_Attack this turn. Gain 4 Armor.
Tag.zhCN: 使你的英雄获得4点护甲值，并在本回合中获得 +4攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 一般说来，你不把嘴里的肉嚼完，是不舍得变回人形态的。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I think I'll just nap under these trees. Wait... AAAAAHHH!" - Blinkfizz, the Unfortunate Gnome
Tag.zhCN: “我想我可以在这片树荫下打个盹儿。等等...啊啊啊啊啊！”——不幸的侏儒布林克菲兹

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, get two random Dream cards.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，随机获取两张梦境牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Ysera rules the Emerald Dream. Which is some kind of green-mirror-version of the real world, or something?
Tag.zhCN: 伊瑟拉统治翡翠梦境。所谓翡翠梦境，究竟只是现实世界的绿色朦胧倒影，还是其他别的什么地方？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Choose One - Give your other minions +2/+2; or Summon two 2/2 Treants with Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：使你的所有其他随从获得+2/+2；或者召唤两个2/2并具有嘲讽的树人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Yes, he's a demigod. No, he doesn't need to wear a shirt.
Tag.zhCN: “当它们还是种子的时候，我便认识它们了……”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使你的所有其他随从获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 召唤两个2/2并具有嘲讽的树人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It is said that some shaman can say "Floatin' totem" 10 times, fast.
Tag.zhCN: 据说，有些萨满能够以很快的速度连着说十遍“疼痛的图腾”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deathrattle: Summon a 3/3 Pip Quickwit for your opponent.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语： 为你的对手召唤一个3/3的皮普·急智。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He lives in Blackrock Mountain. He eats Gnomes. That's pretty much it.
Tag.zhCN: 他住在黑石山。他吃侏儒。基本上就是这样。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal damage equal to your hero's Attack to a minion.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成等同于你的英雄攻击力的伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It is true that some druids are savage, but others still enjoy a quiet moment and a spot of tea.
Tag.zhCN: 确实有些德鲁伊野性十足，但仍有些喜欢在恬静的时刻品上一壶好茶。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Return an enemy minion to your opponent's hand.
Tag.zhCN: 将一个敌方随从移回你对手的 手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: “潜行者”的闷棍技术比“盗贼”好很多，他们不用天赋支持，就可以保证百分之百闷棍命中。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You don't see a lot of Dalaran warriors.
Tag.zhCN: 你肯定没见过达拉然战士。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：为你的英雄恢复#4点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If she threatens to "moon" you, it's not what you think.
Tag.zhCN: 她是艾泽拉斯最早的“月光族”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使相邻的随从获得法术伤害+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Sometimes he forgets and just wanders into someone else's game.
Tag.zhCN: 有时候他会很健忘，甚至迷迷糊糊地走进别人的游戏中去。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Costs (1) less for each other minion on the battlefield.
Tag.zhCN: 战场上每有一个其他随从，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使一个友方随从获得风怒。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Is there anything worse than a Windspeaker with halitosis?
Tag.zhCN: 患有口臭的风语者...还有什么比这更糟糕的吗？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: All minions lose Divine Shield. Gain +3/+3 for each Shield lost.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：所有随从失去圣盾。每有一个随从失去圣盾，便获得+3/+3。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Blood Knights get their holy powers from the Sunwell, which you should NOT bathe in.
Tag.zhCN: 血骑士从太阳井中获得他们的神圣能量，所以你别把那里当成是洗太阳浴的地方。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: This minion has consumed Divine Shields and has increased Attack and Health.
Tag.zhCN: 本随从吞噬了圣盾，攻击力和生命值提高。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your cards and powers that restore Health now deal damage instead.
Tag.zhCN: 你的恢复生命值的牌和技能改为造成等量的伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Auchenai know the end is coming, but they're not sure when.
Tag.zhCN: 奥金尼的人们知道末日即将来临，只是不确定它到来的时间。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your cards and powers that restore Health now deal damage instead.
Tag.zhCN: 你的恢复生命值的牌和技能改为造成等量的伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：对敌方英雄造成3点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your face is the place you'd probably least like a dagger, and where rogues are most likely to deliver them.
Tag.zhCN: 你的脸可能是你最不希望被刀子碰到的地方，但却是潜行者们最喜欢下手的地方。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When a minion attacks your hero, destroy it.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当一个随从攻击你的英雄，将其消灭。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Rumor has it that Deathwing brought about the Cataclysm after losing a game to this card. We may never know the truth.
Tag.zhCN: 是不是因为死亡之翼的对手使用这张牌击败了他，所以他一怒之下引发了大灾变？我们不得而知。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After a friendly minion dies, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 在一个友方随从死亡后，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She may be an evil cult master, but she still calls her parents once a week.
Tag.zhCN: 也许她是个邪恶的教派领袖，但是每个星期她都会和她的父母通电话。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage to a minion. If it’s a friendly Demon, give it +2/+2 instead.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$2点伤害，如果该随从是友方恶魔，则改为使其获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Demonfire is like regular fire except for IT NEVER STOPS BURNING HELLLPPP
Tag.zhCN: 恶魔之火和普通火焰没什么区别，除了它从来不会熄灭...救命！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to this minion and summon a 1/1 Imp.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，对本随从造成1点伤害，并召唤一个1/1的 小鬼。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She would enjoy the job a lot more if she just could get the imps to QUIT BITING HER.
Tag.zhCN: 如果她能让这些小鬼不再咬她的话，她会更加享受这份工作的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Deal 1 damage to a minion and give it +2_Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：对一个随从造成1点伤害，并使其获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I'm going to need you to come in on Sunday." - Cruel Taskmaster
Tag.zhCN: “这个周末你们必须来加班。”——严酷的监工

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.zhCN: 造成1点伤害并使其获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a minion takes damage, gain +1 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个随从 受到伤害，便获得+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He used to work as an accountant before he tried his hand at Berserkering.
Tag.zhCN: 在投身狂战士这份很有前途的工作之前，他是一个会计。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 获得5点护甲值。抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Shields were invented because Face Block is USELESS.
Tag.zhCN: 光有面罩是不够的，所以人们发明了盾牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $1 damage to a minion and give it +2_Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$1点伤害，并使其获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They're only smiling on the outside.
Tag.zhCN: 吃得苦中苦，方为人上人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your spells cost (1) less (but not less than 1).
Tag.zhCN: 你的法术的法力值消耗减少（1）点（但不能少于1点）。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Apprentices are great for bossing around. "Conjure me some mana buns! And a coffee! Make that a mana coffee!"
Tag.zhCN: 学徒们就是用来到处使唤的。“给我做点魔法面包，再来杯咖啡！我要魔法咖啡！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 法力值消耗减少（1）点（但不能少于1点）。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, deal $6 damage to it.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，对该随从造成$6点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A great sniper hits the spot. Just like a delicious flank of boar. Mmmmm.
Tag.zhCN: 伟大的狙击手总是能够正中目标。就像吃下一整块猪肋排。嗯，味道好极了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When your hero is attacked, deal $2 damage to all enemies.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当你的英雄受到攻击，对所有敌人造成$2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It traps your food AND cooks it for you!
Tag.zhCN: 普通陷阱捉到的是猎物；爆炸陷阱捉到的是烤熟的食物！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When an enemy minion attacks, return it to its owner's hand. It costs (2) more.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当一个敌方随从攻击时，将其移回拥有者的手牌，并且法力值消耗增加（2）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Dang, that's cold." - appropriate response to Freezing Trap, or a mean joke.
Tag.zhCN: “呃，好冷。”——当你中了冰冻陷阱或是听到一个冷笑话时，通常都是这个反应。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Will be Frozen again at the start of the next turn.
Tag.zhCN: 在下个回合开始时，会被再次冻结。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: The next Secret you play this turn costs (0).
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 在本回合中，你使用的下一个奥秘的法力值消耗为（0）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Kirin Tor reside in the floating city of Dalaran. How do you make a Dalaran float? Two scoops of ice cream, one scoop of Dalaran.
Tag.zhCN: 肯瑞托的法师们居住在飘浮之城达拉然。怎样让达拉然飘起来？只要用魔法把氢气球变成透明的就行了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的下一个奥秘的法力值消耗为（0）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Combo: Gain +2/+2 for each other card you've played this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 连击：在本回合中，你每使用一张其他牌，便获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He led the Stonemasons in the reconstruction of Stormwind, and when the nobles refused to pay, he founded the Defias Brotherhood to, well, deconstruct Stormwind.
Tag.zhCN: 他领导石工协会重建了暴风城，而当贵族们拒绝支付工钱的时候，他将领导迪菲亚兄弟会，嗯，拆掉暴风城。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After you play a card, summon a 2/1 Satyr.
Tag.zhCN: 在你使用一张牌后，召唤一个2/1的萨特。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Xavius has grand nightmares of summoning Sargeras into this world, but a few Satyr will have to do for now.
Tag.zhCN: 萨维斯怀着召唤萨格拉斯的宏伟噩梦，但他现在要从召唤萨特做起。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 所有随从的法力值消耗增加（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They come out at night to eat leftover mana crystals. "Mmmmmm," they say.
Tag.zhCN: 它们在晚上出没，吸食残余的法力水晶。“嗯...”它们发出这样的声音。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 随机消灭一个敌方随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Our ballista operator is effective, but not picky.
Tag.zhCN: 我们的弩炮手效率很高，但准度就……

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Change the Health of ALL minions to 1.
Tag.zhCN: 将所有随从的生命值变为1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: We are all special unique snowflakes... with 1 Health.
Tag.zhCN: 正因为我们都是独一无二的，所以我们都是平等的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Costs (1) less for each Health your hero is missing.
Tag.zhCN: 你的英雄每缺失一点生命值，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He gets terrible heartburn. BECAUSE HE IS FULL OF LAVA.
Tag.zhCN: 无数初次来到熔火之心的冒险者倒在他滚烫的脚掌之下。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 为所有随从恢复#4点生命值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy a minion with 5_or more Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个攻击力大于或等于5的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you miss, it leaves a lightning-bolt-shaped scar on your target.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你的法术没有命中，那么你的目标身上会留下一道闪电形状的伤疤。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使一个友方随从获得+3生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He also moonlights Thursday nights as a bouncer at the Pig and Whistle Tavern.
Tag.zhCN: 他在每周四的夜晚都会悄然出现在猪和哨声旅店担当保镖。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $5 damage. Restore #5 Health to your hero.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$5点伤害。为你的英雄恢复#5点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 如果该牌是阿肯尼特，则收获启示。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The message, "If found, please return to Mulgore," is tattooed on his rear.
Tag.zhCN: 在它的屁股上印着这样一串文字：“如果你找到它，请将它归还至莫高雷。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a minion is healed, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个随从获得治疗，便随机对一个敌人造成1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Punching is its primary function. Also, its secondary function.
Tag.zhCN: 一个地精牧师发明了使用暗影作为能源的战斗机器人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $3 damage to a minion and the enemy hero.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从和敌方英雄造成$3点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Cobra Shot" hurts way, way, way more than "Cobra Cuddle."
Tag.zhCN: 戴眼镜的蛇当然会瞄的更准一点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Take control of a random enemy Secret.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机夺取一个敌方奥秘的控制权。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They pretend to be wise and enlightened, but they mostly just hate to be left out of a secret.
Tag.zhCN: 她们看上去很聪明，很有学问，但实际上，她们只是讨厌别人有秘密瞒着她们而已。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]After you summon a Pirate, deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 在你召唤一个海盗后，随机对一个敌人造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you hear someone yell, "Cannonball!" you're about to get wet. Or crushed.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你听到有人喊道：“海盗船开炮了！”，那么就算你没有被炸死，也会被浑身弄湿。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：对所有随从造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: How is this supposed to work? Your enemies think, "Hey! Cute sheep!" and run over to cuddle it?
Tag.zhCN: 这项武器究竟应该怎么使用？让你的敌人觉得它很可爱然后指望他会把它抱起来？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：对所有随从造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: How is this supposed to work? Your enemies think, "Hey! Cute sheep!" and run over to cuddle it?
Tag.zhCN: 这项武器究竟应该怎么使用？让你的敌人觉得它很可爱然后指望他会把它抱起来？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of each turn, destroy this minion if it's your only one.
Tag.zhCN: 在每个回合结束时，如果本随从是你唯一的随从，则消灭 本随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Dark Animus is evil and mysterious and huge and unable to write sentences that utilize proper grammar.
Tag.zhCN: 黑暗意志是一个又邪恶又神秘又巨大又不懂得怎么写程序的大坏蛋。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：使每个玩家获得一张零件牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The yetis of Chillwind Point are a source of both inspiration and savage beatings.
Tag.zhCN: 冰风岗的雪人不仅是蛮力的象征，更是工程师们创作灵感的源泉。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: There is a factory in Tanaris for crafting force-tanks, but it only ever made two, because of cost overruns.
Tag.zhCN: 在塔纳利斯，有一间生产强袭坦克的兵工厂，但由于其巨额成本，仅有两辆坦克被生产出来。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you have a Beast, transform this minion into a 7/7.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你控制任何野兽，将本随从变形成为7/7。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Druids of the Fang live in the Wailing Caverns. They wear cool snake shirts and tell snake jokes and say "bro" a lot.
Tag.zhCN: 毒牙德鲁伊生活在哀嚎洞穴里，于是那里成为了大部分部落冒险者第一次遇到暗夜精灵的地方。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Shhh, I think I hear something." "Ah, it's probably nothing." - Every Henchman
Tag.zhCN: 虽然他们不如在陆地上的同类们精于算计，但他们在捕猎方面的本领却更胜一筹。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Add a Spare Part card to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：将一张零件牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Clockwork gnomes are always asking what time it is.
Tag.zhCN: 发条侏儒总是会问：“现在几点？”因为他需要有人定时帮他旋紧发条。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使一个友方机械获得+4生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's the same as the previous generation but they slapped the word "upgraded" on it to sell it for double.
Tag.zhCN: 其实他和旧的型号没有任何不同，但是在被贴上了“高级”标签之后，他的售价就能翻一倍。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个机械获得+4生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: To operate, this contraption needs a hula doll on the dashboard. Otherwise it's just a “falling machine.”
Tag.zhCN: 这架精致的飞行器需要飞行员在起飞前做好精确的调校。否则，它只能被叫做“降落器”。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The inventor of the Annoy-o-Tron was immediately expelled from Tinkerschool, Tinkertown, and was eventually exiled from the Eastern Kingdoms altogether.
Tag.zhCN: 发明吵吵机器人的工程师先是被工匠学院立即开除，然后被赶出了工匠镇，最后被驱逐出了东部王国。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you gain Armor, give this minion +1 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你获得 护甲值，使本随从获得+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 冬拥堡垒的城墙一般都会用最坚固的材料在两个半小时内修筑起来。但这并不能阻止攻城战车的长驱直入。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your Hero Power can target minions.
Tag.zhCN: 你的英雄技能能够以随从为目标。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Goblins seldom have the patience for sniping. Most prefer lobbing explosives.
Tag.zhCN: 地精一般都不喜欢使用狙击枪，他们都喜欢直接用炸药解决问题。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Stealth 50% chance to attack the wrong enemy.

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He didn't have the grades to get into ninja school, but his dad pulled some strings.
Tag.zhCN: 他通过走后门进入了忍者学院，但总是通不过偷取毕业证书的考试。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you control a Secret at the end of your turn, restore #4 Health to your hero.
Tag.zhCN: 如果在你的回合结束时，你控制一个奥秘，则为你的英雄恢复#4点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "LUMOS!" is not what they yell. What do you think this is, Hogwarts?
Tag.zhCN: “明光闪烁！”他们可不会念这样的咒语；你以为这是哪儿？霍格沃茨魔法学校？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Deal 6 damage randomly split between all other characters.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：造成6点伤害，随机分配到所有其他角色身上。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 如果你还在抱怨疯狂投弹者乱扔炸弹，你应该看看这位。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: There was some hard talk between gnome magi and engineers about inventing this mech.
Tag.zhCN: 在将这款机械装置投入生产之前，侏儒工程师们与法师们不知进行了多少次谈判。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Draw a card. If it's a minion, transform it into a Chicken.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 抽一张牌，如果该牌是随从牌，则将其变形成为一只小鸡。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's legitimately surprised every time he turns himself into a chicken.
Tag.zhCN: 他的实验室总被路过的人误以为是鸡棚。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The engineering equivalent of a "Kick Me" sticker.
Tag.zhCN: 它被许多工程师认为是工程学造福艾泽拉斯冒险者的起点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of each player's turn, that player draws until they have 3 cards.
Tag.zhCN: 在每个玩家的回合结束时，该玩家抽若干牌，直至其手牌数量达到3张。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This robot is a lean, mean, butlerin' machine.
Tag.zhCN: 他是有史以来最熟练、最高效、最有礼貌的服侍机器人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Has +4 Attack while your opponent has 6 or more cards in hand.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你对手的手牌数量大于或等于6张，便拥有+4攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He’s not such a binge exploder anymore. These days, he only explodes socially.
Tag.zhCN: 他已经不再是一个漫无目的的爆破狂人了，他认为每一次爆炸都应该有其社会意义，或者表明他对生命的态度。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（2）的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Once upon a time, only goblins piloted shredders. These days, everyone from Doomsayer to Lorewalker Cho seems to ride one.
Tag.zhCN: 在过去，只有地精会驾驶这玩意儿。如今，从末日预言者到精灵龙再到游学者周卓，好像大家都喜欢驾驶收割机。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，战吼：每有一个具有亡语的敌方随从，便获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Warlocks have the town exorcist on speed dial in case they unleash the wrong demon.
Tag.zhCN: 术士们让城里的驱魔者都开通了驱魔热线，防止在他们召唤出错误的恶魔的时候酿成惨剧。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The gnomes are valiant and ready to return to their irradiated, poorly ventilated homeland!
Tag.zhCN: 侏儒士兵们英勇无畏，他们随时准备着回到他们那饱受辐射的、通风糟糕的家园！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Deal 4 damage to a random enemy minion.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机对一个敌方随从造成4点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He lobbies Orgrimmar daily on behalf of bombs.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever your hero takes damage on your turn, gain +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你的英雄在你的回合受到伤害，便获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Evil Eye Watcher of Doom" was the original name, but marketing felt it was a bit too aggressive.
Tag.zhCN: 和他对话时，你很难与之进行眼神交流。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to all minions with Deathrattle.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 对所有具有亡语的随从造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Scarlet Crusade is doing market research to find out if the "Mauve Crusade" would be better received.
Tag.zhCN: 血色十字军臭名昭著，其领导者们想要通过更名来改善人们对这个组织的看法。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you have a Mech, gain +1/+1 and add a Spare Part to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你控制一个机械，便获得+1/+1并将一张零件牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Won't you take me to... Tinkertown?
Tag.zhCN: 要不你就带我去...工匠镇？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the start of each turn, gain +1 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 在每个回合开始时，获得+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This card is the real thing.
Tag.zhCN: 它虽然体型不大，但它学习战斗的能力却非常惊人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you play a 1-Attack minion, give it +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你使用一张攻击力为1的随从牌，便使其获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Hobgoblins are meeting next week to discuss union benefits. First on the list: dental plan.
Tag.zhCN: 大地精们将在下个星期召开联合会议。会议的第一项议题是：建立一个牙科诊所。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（4）的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The pinnacle of goblin engineering. Includes an espresso machine and foot massager.
Tag.zhCN: 地精科技的巅峰之作。魔像内装饰豪华，配备速溶咖啡机以及足浴按摩器。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a friendly Mech dies, gain +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个友方机械死亡，便获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: One bot's junk is another bot's AWESOME UPGRADE!
Tag.zhCN: 当某个零部件对某个机器人不再有用时，它可能会使另一个机器人焕然一新。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Give your other minions Windfury, Taunt, or Divine Shield (at random).
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机使你的其他随从分别获得风怒，嘲讽，或者圣盾效果中的一种。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 每个人都喜欢他的免胶水强化装置！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Transform a friendly minion into a random minion with the same Cost.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 将一个友方随从随机变形成为一个法力值消耗相同的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: For when you didn’t combobulate quite right the first time around.
Tag.zhCN: 他坚信物质守恒的定律，更痴迷于魔法的随机性。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He is sometimes found hiding in the treasure chest in the Gurubashi Arena.
Tag.zhCN: 有时候你能够在古拉巴什竞技场的宝箱中发现他。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Summon two 1/1 Boom Bots. WARNING: Bots may explode.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 召唤两个1/1的砰砰机器人。警告：该机器人随时可能爆炸。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 让你见识一下他的厉害！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Deal 1-4 damage to a random enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：随机对一个敌人造成1-4点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the start of your turn, if you have at least 3 Mechs, destroy them all and form V-07-TR-0N.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合开始时，如果你控制至少三个机械，则消灭这些机械，并将其组合成V-07-TR-0N。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Do not push the big red button!
Tag.zhCN: 别按那个最大的红色按钮！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: All minions have a 50% chance to attack the wrong enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 所有随从有50%几率攻击错误的敌人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Mogor helped reopen the Dark Portal once. You know you're in trouble when you have to rely on an ogre.
Tag.zhCN: 穆戈尔曾经帮助兽人重新打开了黑暗之门。既然你让一个食人魔参与了这件事情，就别指望最后会有什么好结果了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Also damages the minions next to whomever it attacks.
Tag.zhCN: 同时对其攻击目标相邻的随从造成伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Foe reaping is really not so different from harvest reaping, at the end of the day.
Tag.zhCN: 对于田里的庄稼来说，所有的收割机都是死神。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：&随机召唤一个传说随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: When Sneed was defeated in the Deadmines, his shredder was sold at auction to an anonymous buyer. (Probably Hogger.)
Tag.zhCN: 当斯尼德在死亡矿井被击败后，他的伐木机在一次拍卖中被一位匿名买家收购。（可能是霍格。）

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Add a Spare Part card to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼，亡语： 将一张零件牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 托什雷的基地是侏儒工程师们在外域的港湾。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever an enemy minion dies, summon a Leper Gnome.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个敌方随从死亡，召唤一个 麻风侏儒。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He was obsessed with explosives until he discovered knitting. Now he yells, “SWEATERS! MORE SWEATERS!”
Tag.zhCN: 过去他非常执迷于炸药。而现在他更加关怀麻风侏儒们的生计，因为他们能够造成更稳定的伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you cast a 1-Cost spell, add a random Mech to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你施放一个法力值消耗为（1）的法术，随机将一张机械牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Gazlowe was voted "Most Likely to Explode" in high school.
Tag.zhCN: 在学校里，加兹鲁维就被认为是“最能制造混乱的人”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever your opponent casts a spell, summon a Burly Rockjaw Trogg.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你的对手施放一个法术，召唤一个石腭穴居人壮汉。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He keeps earthinating the countryside despite attempts to stop him.
Tag.zhCN: 他不断震颤着大地，使山脉深处出现了大量洞穴，解决了穴居人的住房问题。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Equip a random weapon for each player.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：为每个玩家装备一把武器。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: PREPARE PARTY SERVOS FOR IMMEDIATE DEPLOYMENT.
Tag.zhCN: 启动布林顿，让所有参加派对的人都嗨起来！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's hard to make a living as a hunter in a world where beasts instantly reappear minutes after you kill them.
Tag.zhCN: 作为一个野兽公敌来说，在这个世界里活下来是非常不容易的。因为你在几分钟前杀死的野兽，会突然再次不知道从哪儿冒出来……

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Costs (1) less for each card in your opponent's hand.
Tag.zhCN: 你的对手每有一张手牌，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He and Mountain Giant don't get along.
Tag.zhCN: 虽然体型相仿，他和山岭巨人总是交不上朋友。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Bane of spellcasters and spelling bees everywhere.
Tag.zhCN: 有些大块头正需要小个子的保护。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Spell Damage +1 Battlecry: If you control another Mech, get a random Fire spell.
Tag.zhCN: 法术伤害+1 战吼：如果你控制着其他机械，随机获取一张火焰法术牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The inventor of the goblin shredder is involved in several patent disputes with the inventor of the soot spewer.
Tag.zhCN: 地精发明家们从来不会考虑环保和安全这两个因素；而他们认为正是这一点使他们的发明更加出类拔萃。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Gain 1 Mana Crystal this turn only.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，获得一个 法力水晶。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What's the best way to buy new gear? With a gear, of course! Obtained by owning 123 Goblins vs Gnomes cards.
Tag.zhCN: 怎样换新工具最划算？当然是用旧工具来换！ 拥有123张地精大战侏儒卡牌后获得该奖励。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 英雄技能 获得$d2点护甲值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 英雄技能 获得$d4点护甲值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 英雄技能 获得$d2点护甲值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 英雄技能 获得$d4点护甲值。

Tag.name: CARDNAME
Tag.zhCN: 巡游歌手精英牛头人酋长

Tag.zhCN: 英雄技能 获得$d4点护甲值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He is the weakest of the four Elemental Lords. And the other three don't let him forget it.
Tag.zhCN: 他是四大元素领主中最弱的一个。而另外三个总是会提醒他这一点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Kor'kron are the elite forces of Garrosh Hellscream. Let's just say you don't want to run into these guys while wearing a blue tabard.
Tag.zhCN: 库卡隆就是加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮的精英部队。这么说吧，你最好不要穿着蓝色的战袍出现在这些壮汉面前。

Tag.zhCN: 这些法力浮龙以奥术能量为食。所以尽管这些捣蛋鬼不会成为真正的威胁，你也不应该让它们接近任何法术力源。

Tag.zhCN: 有一次，我开出了一张黑色的花，一张会笑的壶，还有一张初版龙希尔闪卡。

Tag.zhCN: 这个姿势不错，朋友。不过这次你可以再高兴一点，笑得再开一点。

Tag.zhCN: 做好寿司，冰鲜鱼人是关键。

Tag.zhCN: 下个扩展包就没用啦。*眨眼示意*

Tag.zhCN: 虽然名字听起来很正面，但仍不能改变其通灵术的邪恶本质。

Tag.zhCN: 可以掠过随从，不要略过英雄。

Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，召唤四只1/1的尸蜂攻击它。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: In your brain, in your brain, Zombees, Zombees, Zombees-ees-ees.
Tag.zhCN: 你存在我深深的脑海里。——致尸蜂

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，召唤四只2/2的尸蜂攻击它。

Tag.zhCN: 冲过大风雪，亡灵坐在雪橇上。奔驰过田野，他们追踪坠饰忙！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 这只是小动物爱的抱抱！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give all friendly Demons and Murlocs "Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Imploc."
Tag.zhCN: 使所有友方恶魔和鱼人获得“亡语：召唤一个2/2的小鬼鱼人。”

Tag.enUS: They have faces only a morrglr could love.

Tag.zhCN: 对所有随从造成$2点伤害。如果你在本局对战中弃过牌，再造成$1点。

Tag.zhCN: 请注意，逾期不还者需赔付十倍的滞纳金！

Tag.zhCN: 经证实，该仪式已获得上古之神克苏恩的认可。

Tag.zhCN: 我以前没得选择，现在我想做一个好人。

Tag.enUS: Even after all this time, Gul'dan still makes Cho'gall go get donuts and coffee.
Tag.zhCN: 即便这么多年过去了，古尔丹还是会吩咐古加尔去准备咖啡和甜甜圈。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 消耗生命值，而非法力值。

Tag.enUS: Pro tip: DO NOT BOGART THE BANANAS.
Tag.zhCN: 其实除了香蕉之外，他还喜欢吃花生酱。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Each turn this is in your hand, transform it into a random minion.
Tag.zhCN: 如果这张牌在你的手牌中，每个回合都会随机变成一张随从牌。

Tag.zhCN: 一个翻脸比翻书还快的家伙，说变就变！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，战吼：如果你的克苏恩至少有10点攻击力，则召唤另一名双子皇帝。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Do they make decisions based on age? "I'm two minutes older therefore we burn this village."
Tag.zhCN: 我比你大两分钟，所以听我的！快，给我放火烧了那座村子！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Summon your Deathrattle minions that died this game.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤所有你在本局对战中死亡的，并具有亡语的随从。

Tag.enUS: Has not been able to get "Under the Sea" out of his head for like FIVE THOUSAND YEARS.
Tag.zhCN: 恩佐斯会在睡前听美人鱼给它吟唱安眠曲。这个习惯保持了五千多年，从未改变。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Cast a random spell for each spell you've cast this game (targets chosen randomly).
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 在本局对战中，你每施放过一个法术，便随机施放一个法术（目标随机而定）。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I spell your doom... Y-O-U-R D-O-O-M!
Tag.zhCN: 你死期到了……死期到了……期到了……到了……了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合开始时，本牌的法力值消耗减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 不知他的预言里有没有这么一条：被各式各样的玩家反复蹂躏。

Tag.enUS: Rejected names: Forty-Foot Faceless, Big ol' No-face, Huge Creature Sans Face, Teddy.
Tag.zhCN: 无面巨兽打哈欠时犹如黑洞般吞噬周围的一切。所以当你看到它伸懒腰时，就赶紧跑吧！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Often wonders what path his life might have taken if he wasn't named, you know, "Eldritch Horror".
Tag.zhCN: 长得丑并不是它的错，但是出来吓人就是它的不对了。

Tag.zhCN: 音响设备全面升级，让我们燥起来！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 亡语：为敌方英雄恢复#8点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 竟然为敌人治疗！看来连中央处理器都被腐化了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：对所有其他随从造成1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: But goes by "Ravishing Ghoul" when he hits the club.
Tag.zhCN: 别看他个头不大，脾气倒不小。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 受伤时拥有+2攻 击力。

Tag.zhCN: 恩佐斯很在意自己的触须，因此它对相关的洗护用品非常挑剔。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They say that "grotesque is in the eye of the beholder," but that's just because they've never seen a Grotesque Dragonhawk. Yikes!
Tag.zhCN: 人们总说“外形不重要，主要看气质”，可要是他们看过畸变的龙鹰就不会这么想了。真的好恶心！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's tried other things, but bog sidling, bog ambling, and bog trundling just aren't as effective as bog creeping.
Tag.zhCN: 他试过很多种出行方式，包括站起来走，横过来挪，卷起来滚，但是都没有窝在那爬来得轻松惬意。

Tag.zhCN: 亡语：随机使一个友方随从获得+1/+1。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 造成2点伤害。使你的克苏恩获得+2/+2（无论它在哪里）。

Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，如果你控制两个远古造物之血，则将其融合成远古造物。

Tag.enUS: Add two cups of Blood of the Ancient One to one cup of lemon juice. Add just a dash of sugar and stir. Delicious!
Tag.zhCN: 一杯柠檬汁外加两杯远古造物之血，再加点朗姆酒摇匀后，充满着远古风情的鸡尾酒就制作好了。

Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合开始时，将本随从的攻击力 变为7。

Tag.enUS: [x]Choose One - Summon a 2/2 Slime; or Gain an empty Mana Crystal.
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：召唤一个2/2的泥浆怪；或者获得一个空的法力水晶。

Tag.zhCN: 被雷劈是什么滋味……恐怕没多少亲历者能活着告诉你。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（3）的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They never get the recognition they deserve.
Tag.zhCN: 无面者夜以继日不停工作，却从未得到应有的认可。

Tag.zhCN: 根据能量守恒定律，你损失的生命值最终会转移到我身上。

Tag.zhCN: 召唤全部三个动物伙伴。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Hello. Misha, Leokk and Huffer aren't here right now, but if you leave a message we'll get back to you right away." BEEP.
Tag.zhCN: 总有人抱怨使用“动物伙伴”这张牌时，召唤出来的并不是他们想要的。现在好了，三个愿望，一次满足。

Tag.zhCN: 听说除虱粉对治疗这种寄生感染有奇效。

Tag.enUS: He thought the set was called "Flippers of the Old Cods" and hungrily volunteered to be in it. He is definitely going to get his hearing checked.
Tag.zhCN: 上古之神对他低语了很长时间他才回过神来，看来这位勇士真的该好好检查一下听力了。

Tag.enUS: Garrosh's best buddy. It's true. Look it up.
Tag.zhCN: 马尔考罗克是加尔鲁什最好的兄弟！真的，不信你去查查。

Tag.zhCN: 亡语：随机使一个友方随从获得圣盾。

Tag.enUS: "Don't worry about me… I'll just be here... under these tentacles."
Tag.zhCN: “别担心，即便我倒下了，也会祝福你们。向着胜利……前进！”

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使你具有圣盾的随从获得+1/+1。

Tag.zhCN: 就一把武器而言，它的确还蛮振奋人心的。

Tag.zhCN: 每年总会有个别圣骑士在西部荒野举重大赛上偷偷使用这一招，导致因作弊而被淘汰出局。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, restore #8 Health to a damaged friendly character.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，为一个受伤的友方角色恢复#8点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What happens when you try and corrupt a corrupted firelord? DOUBLE NEGATIVE, INSECT!
Tag.zhCN: 根据负负得正定理，当你去腐化一个已被腐化的炎魔之王，其结果就是他变成了你们口中所谓的“好人”。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The secret ingredient: liquified funnel cake.
Tag.zhCN: 她最拿手的甜点就是巧克力熔岩漏斗蛋糕。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy all minions. Draw a card for each.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭所有随从。每消灭一个随从，便抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: We ran out of space for "DOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!!"
Tag.zhCN: 古往今来总有人在那里宣扬末日论，可我们现在不是还活得好好的吗。

Tag.zhCN: 村民那充满魔性的舞步在艾泽拉斯造成了轰动，模仿者不计其数！

Tag.enUS: Sometimes the Old Gods' corruptions gives you power untold, sometimes you get +1 Attack. We can’t all be winners in the Eldritch lottery.
Tag.zhCN: 被上古之神腐化后，有时会获得无穷的力量，有时仅仅获得+1攻击力。不可能每个人都是幸运儿，主要看气质。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 俗话说怨由心生，可这家伙根本就没有心，哪儿来的这么多恨……

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽 亡语：召唤一个2/2的泥浆怪。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Overmind and the Old Gods are surprisingly similar.
Tag.zhCN: 科普卢星区的主宰和上古之神有很多相似之处。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Destroy all enemy Secrets. Gain +1/+1 for each.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：摧毁所有敌方奥秘。每摧毁一个，便获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You don't want to be around after it has eaten an explosive trap. You thought Sludge Belcher was bad...
Tag.zhCN: 要是他吃下了爆炸陷阱，就最好离他远一点。没人会喜欢这种惊喜的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Give your C'Thun +2/+2 (wherever it is). If it's dead, shuffle it into your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使你的克苏恩获得+2/+2（无论它在哪里）。如果克苏恩死亡，将其洗入你的牌库。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Hello, is Doom there? No? Can I leave a message?"
Tag.zhCN: 为什么会有人蠢到去召唤厄运？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Who's a cute widdle N'Zoth? You are! Yes you are! Yes you're the cutest widdle N'Zoth in the whole world!!!
Tag.zhCN: 别看恩佐斯长得那么惊悚，它的子嗣却出奇的可爱。这些黏呼呼臭烘烘的小家伙们最得女性玩家的恩宠了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：使你的武器获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Quick! Before I drown! Let me sharpen your sword for you.
Tag.zhCN: 你有两个选择：要么死，要么在她的船上服役100年。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the start of your turn, double this minion's Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合开始时，本随从的攻击力 翻倍。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I like it because it scales.
Tag.zhCN: 你问我梦魇为什么要有鳞片，因为有鳞片很酷啊。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：召唤一个5/5的无面破坏者。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you strike him down, he shall become more powerful than you can possibly imagine.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你杀死他，他会变得更强，强到你无法想象。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 召唤五个{0}的白银之手新兵。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Or if you're too tired, you can just kind of lean against the darkness.
Tag.zhCN: 对抗黑暗，伸张正义，是每一位圣骑士的毕生信念。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Add a copy of each damaged friendly minion to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 将每个受伤的友方随从的各一张复制置入你的手牌。

Tag.zhCN: 使一个友方随从获得+2攻击力。如果是野兽，还会使其获得突袭。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤每种休眠灵种各一个。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If I had a nickel for every time a Hunter Legendary minion in Castle Nathria summoned three different companions, I'd have two nickels - which isn't a lot, but it's weird that it happened twice.
Tag.zhCN: 如果每当纳斯利亚堡的猎人传说随从召唤出三个不同的伙伴我都能拿到五美分，那我就能拿到十美分。钱算不多，但这种事发生两次就很奇怪。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $3 damage. Summon a random Dormant Wildseed.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$3点伤害。随机召唤一个休眠的灵种。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 随机施放8个德鲁伊法术（目标随机而定）。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The spirits prefer to convoke when there's some hot gossip to discuss.
Tag.zhCN: 每当热门八卦出现，万灵总会聚在一起。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal $6 damage to three random enemy minions. Excess damage hits the enemy hero.
Tag.zhCN: 随机对三个敌方随从造成$6点伤害。超过目标生命值的伤害会命中敌方英雄。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Choose an enemy minion. Throw a random minion from your hand at it.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：选择一个敌方随从。随机将你手牌中的一个随从投向选中的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Do you ever wonder why you don't get invited anywhere?" "… no, not really."
Tag.zhCN: “你想没想过，为什么从来没人邀请你？”“……没，没怎么想过。”

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.enUS: Choose an enemy minion. Throw a random minion from your hand at it.
Tag.zhCN: 选择一个敌方随从。随机将你手牌中的一个随从投向选中的随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give a friendly minion +1/+1. Repeat for each Imp you control.
Tag.zhCN: 使一个友方随从获得+1/+1。你每控制一个小鬼，重复一次。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What type of vial library has 0 vials in it!?

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summon a 3/5 Shadow with Taunt. If a minion died this turn, summon another.
Tag.zhCN: 召唤一个3/5并具有嘲讽的影子。如果在本回合中有随从死亡，再召唤一个。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They're dancing to one of Rin's demonic symphonies. Her music might not be famous now, but just you wait!
Tag.zhCN: 这其实是林恩的恶魔交响曲。她的音乐作品现在可能还不火，不过等着瞧吧！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Summon two 2/1 Shades. Each gains a Deathrattle to cast your last Shadow spell.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤两个2/1的阴影。每个阴影获得一个亡语以施放你的上一个暗影法术。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You're so vein. I bet you think this flavor text is about you.
Tag.zhCN: 你心里好阴暗呐，你一定以为这条卡牌趣文与你有关。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Reduce the Cost of the highest Cost Shadow spell in your hand by (3).
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：使你手牌中法力值消耗最高的暗影法术牌的法力值消耗减少（3）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You merely adopted the shadows; I was born in them!
Tag.zhCN: 你还是不适应暗影。我就生在暗影里！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 突袭，亡语：召唤一只8/8并具有突袭的墓翼蝠。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Leads with an iron fist and a stony demeanor.

Tag.name: HOW_TO_EARN_GOLDEN
Tag.zhCN: 完成成就“顽石军团，集合！”后解锁。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After a card is added to your hand from another class, copy it.
Tag.zhCN: 在另一职业的卡牌被置入你的手牌后，复制置入的牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Sending mail via steward is soooo old school.
Tag.zhCN: 请执事者送信，太老派了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Your opponent's minions cost (1) more next turn.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：下个回合你的对手随从牌的法力值消耗增加（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He had plenty of experience with dusting things from his time as a butler, so when a murder was committed he saw a real job opportunity!
Tag.zhCN: 他在当管家时就常与粉尘打交道。悬案发生之际，正是他换行的好机会！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your minions cost (1) more this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，你的随从牌的法力值消耗增加（1）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Until your next turn, your hero can only take 1 damage at a time.
Tag.zhCN: 直到你的下个回合，你的英雄每次只会受到1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 那个靠枕知道的太多了……

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your hero only takes 1 damage at a time until the start of your next turn.
Tag.zhCN: 直到你的下个回合开始，你的英雄每次只会受到1点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summon two 2/2 Volatile Skeletons. Gain 4 Armor.
Tag.zhCN: 召唤两个2/2的不稳定的骷髅。获得4点护甲值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: And that's why you keep your skeletons in your closet instead of your freezer.
Tag.zhCN: 你看，骷髅就该藏在衣橱里，不能冷藏。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Brand an enemy minion. Whenever it takes damage, deal 1 damage to the enemy hero.
Tag.zhCN: 标记一个敌方随从。每当该随从受到伤害，对敌方英雄造成1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 大哥被标记了，怎么办？打灭。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever this takes damage, deal 1 damage to your hero.
Tag.zhCN: 每当本随从受到伤害，对你的英雄造成1点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give your hero +3 Attack this turn. Pick from 3 cards in your hand to shuffle into your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，使你的英雄获得+3攻击力。从你的3张手牌中选择一张洗入你的牌库。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Just because you did it doesn't mean you have to be guilty.
Tag.zhCN: 尽管是你干的，但你未必有罪。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Draw two cards and reduce their Cost by (@). Improve your future Relics.
Tag.zhCN: 抽两张牌并使其法力值消耗降低（@）点。提升你此后的圣物效果。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A glaive is a glaive, but a mystery box could be anything! It could even be a glaive!
Tag.zhCN: 战刃就是战刃，但神秘宝箱里可能有任何装备！甚至可能有把战刃！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]After your hero attacks, draw until you have 3 cards.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的英雄攻击后，抽牌，直到你拥有三张牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：弃掉你的手牌。亡语：抽三张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Tried intermittent fasting. It didn't stick.
Tag.zhCN: 尝试过间歇性断食。没能坚持。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand to shuffle into your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：选择一张你的手牌洗入你的牌库。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He did NOT want to cast a spell.
Tag.zhCN: 听说你想要一个法术？他这里可没有。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]At the end of your turn, if you control a Secret, deal 2 damage to all enemies.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，如果你控制一个奥秘，对所有敌人造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "So a Venthyr, an Old God, and a Tauren walk into a bar…"
Tag.zhCN: “一个温西尔，一个上古之神还有一个牛头人走进了酒吧……”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Resurrect your Volatile Skeletons. Any that can't fit on the battlefield instantly explode! @(@)
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：复活你的不稳定的骷髅。战场上放不下的骷髅会立即爆炸。@（复活@个）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Looks like Kel'Thuzad is borrowing some of Mr. Bigglesworth's nine lives.
Tag.zhCN: 克尔苏加德好像从比格沃斯先生的九条命里借了几条。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After a friendly Secret is revealed, cast a different Mage Secret and gain +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 在一个友方奥秘被揭示后，施放一个不同的法师奥秘并获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The secrets of the universe are vast... and will be revealed sometime later this game.
Tag.zhCN: 宇宙的奥秘浩瀚无涯……终将在本局对战中的晚些时候揭示。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Secret: After an enemy minion attacks your hero, summon a copy of it to attack the enemy hero.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：在一个敌方随从攻击你的英雄后，召唤一个它的复制并使其攻击敌方英雄。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The mirror shows us nothing less than the deepest, darkest desire of our hearts: to go face.
Tag.zhCN: 这面镜子向我们展示的正是内心中最深沉，最黑暗的欲望：打脸。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Choose a friendly minion. Summon 3 copies of it. Overload: (2)
Tag.zhCN: 选择一个友方随从。召唤3个它的复制。过载：（2）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Number 1, could you please sing the opening to "I Want It That Way"?
Tag.zhCN: 1号！只有你和他们四个不一样！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $3 damage. Infuse (@): Add a Frozen Touch to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$3点伤害。注能（@）：将一张冰冻之触置入你的 手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Is this what Bob was talking about when he said he served a drink to a Death Knight once?
Tag.zhCN: 这难道就是鲍勃讲的，他给死亡骑士倒酒时的情形？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Infused Deal $3 damage. Add a Frozen Touch to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 已注能 造成$3点伤害。将一张冰冻之触置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Freeze a minion. Summon a 2/2 Volatile Skeleton.
Tag.zhCN: 冻结一个随从。召唤一个2/2的不稳定的骷髅。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Summon a @/@ Ghost. (Has +1/+1 for each other card you played this turn!)
Tag.zhCN: 召唤一个@/@的幽灵。（在本回合中每有一张其他牌被使用，拥有+1/+1！）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A graveyard in the realm of the dead; a bit redundant, don't you think?
Tag.zhCN: 在亡者的国度修建坟场，是不是有点多余？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 英雄技能 发起一项指控！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If I had a nickel for every time a Hunter Legendary minion in Castle Nathria summoned three different companions, I'd have two nickels - which isn't a lot, but it's weird that it happened twice.
Tag.zhCN: 如果每当纳斯利亚堡的猎人传说随从召唤出三个不同的伙伴我都能拿到五美分，那我就能拿到十美分。钱算不多，但这种事发生两次就很奇怪。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's a great judge of character.

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They claim they're from the Fae Court, but that might be a Fae Kout.
Tag.zhCN: 自称来自枝叶繁茂的法夜宫廷。也可能是“职业仿冒”的法夜宫廷。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: How many bites does it take to get the center of an hors d'oeuvre?
Tag.zhCN: 这点心要啃多少口才能吃到馅？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: We originally planned on giving Rogue a Legendary minion called "The Moon", but SOMEONE jumped in the frame.
Tag.zhCN: 我们原本计划推出一张叫做“月亮”的潜行者传说随从牌，可有人突然跳进了取景框。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Looks like Kel'Thuzad is borrowing some of Mr. Bigglesworth's nine lives.
Tag.zhCN: 克尔苏加德好像从比格沃斯先生的九条命里借了几条。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "The anticipation to use this relic is killing me! Though, it will more likely kill you."
Tag.zhCN: “我一直想玩玩这件圣物，都快想疯了！而你们的死，可以填补我多年的空虚。”

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Vashj was supposed to make an appearance in "The Sunken City," but after a freak accident in "Ashes of Outland," she ended up here.
Tag.zhCN: 瓦丝琪本该在“沉没之城”中露面。但她在“外域的灰烬”中发生了一桩奇怪的意外，最终来到了这里。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Not even death can stop Rafaam from pursuing a life of crime.
Tag.zhCN: 即便是死了，拉法姆也要以犯罪为生。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You'll actually find more than one tonement here.

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you keep seeing a statue of the Sire, you’re not going in circles. There’s just so many of them.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你反复见到大帝的雕像，那也不能说明你在兜圈子。因为大帝的雕像太多了。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: There may not be any skeletons in the closets at Castle Nathria, but there sure are souls in the basement.
Tag.zhCN: 纳斯利亚堡的衣橱里或许没有骷髅，但地下深处是真的关着灵魂。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's fabulous! It's grand! It's, well it's really very nice.
Tag.zhCN: 漂亮！大气！嗯……真的挺好的。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A graveyard in the realm of the dead; a bit redundant, don't you think?
Tag.zhCN: 在亡者的国度修建坟场，是不是有点多余？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Holds Sire Denathrius' most prized possession - his teddy bear, Jeremy Bearimy.
Tag.zhCN: 内藏德纳修斯最珍视的宝物：他的泰迪熊，杰里米·贝里米。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Making a dredger is easier than you'd think. You don't need to worry about mucking it up!
Tag.zhCN: 制作泥仆比你想象的简单，搞砸了都不怕！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What type of vial library has 0 vials in it!?

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When your opponent spends all their Mana, draw two cards.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当你的对手消耗了其所有法力值时，抽两张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Valeera revealed herself to be a double agent. At which point Maiev felt comfortable revealing that she also was a double agent. And then Scabbs announced to everybody that - get this - he was a double agent.
Tag.zhCN: 瓦莉拉公布了自己是个双面间谍。于是玛维承认了自己也是双面间谍。然后斯卡布斯宣布了个事：他也是双面间谍。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Cast a Secret from your deck. _Combo: Cast 2 instead.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：从你的牌库中施放一个奥秘。连击：改为施放2个。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Eye see what you did there.
Tag.zhCN: 你刚才做的事情他也看见了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, summon a 3/4 Spider with Stealth.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：在你的对手施放一个法术后，召唤一只3/4并具有潜行的蜘蛛。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Now this is what I'd call..." "...just shut up."

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, stuff it in a 0/4 Sack.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，将其装入一个0/4的袋子。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Check your coat, but don't check the coat closet.
Tag.zhCN: 记得检查你的衣装，但不要去翻看衣橱。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Return your opponent's kidnapped minion to their hand.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：将你对手被绑架的随从移回其手牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Stealth. Deathrattle: Store Halkias's soul inside of a friendly Secret. It resummons Halkias when triggered.
Tag.zhCN: 潜行。亡语：将哈尔吉亚斯的灵魂储存在一个友方奥秘中。当其被触发时，重新召唤哈尔吉亚斯。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Everybody tough until the sinstones start walking.
Tag.zhCN: 起初大家过得都很苦，直到罪碑学会了自己走路。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 盛放着哈尔吉亚斯的灵魂。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $@ damage to a random enemy minion, twice. Improve your future Relics.
Tag.zhCN: 随机对一个敌方随从造成$@点伤害，触发两次。提升你此后的圣物效果。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Faster than an asteroid, and just as effective.
Tag.zhCN: 比小行星还快，效果还差不多。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Resurrect four friendly Imps. Infuse (@): Give your Imps +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：复活四个友方小鬼。注能（@）：使你的小鬼获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Not even death can stop Rafaam from pursuing a life of crime.
Tag.zhCN: 即便是死了，拉法姆也要以犯罪为生。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Infused. Battlecry: Summon four friendly Imps that died this game. __Give your Imps +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 已注能 战吼：召唤四个在本局对战中死亡的友方小鬼。使你的小鬼获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 所有随从牌的法力值消耗增加（2）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you drink muck, you go to the Maw before you die.
Tag.zhCN: 喝了泥浆的感觉，就像在活着的时候进入噬渊。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Costs (1) less for each Totem you've summoned this game.
Tag.zhCN: 在本局对战中，你每召唤一个图腾，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Totem Golem's uncle, gone too soon.
Tag.zhCN: 图腾魔像的叔叔，走得有点早。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, gain +1 Health.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，获得+1生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This one's heavier than the wooden totems. Mostly from the weight of your sins.
Tag.zhCN: 比木质的图腾重。主要是因为罪孽太重了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage to all minions. Summon a 2/2 Volatile Skeleton for each killed.
Tag.zhCN: 对所有随从造成$2点伤害。每消灭一个随从，召唤一个2/2的不稳定的骷髅。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Kel'Thuzad thinks adding a silent 'e' at the end of words makes them sound cooler.
Tag.zhCN: 其实只是普通的骷髅。克尔苏加德取这个名字只是为了气势。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：你使用的下一张奥秘牌的法力值消耗为（0）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It turns out she wasn't so great at keeping secrets after all.
Tag.zhCN: 事实证明，她的手上好像存不住秘密。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的下一个奥秘的法力值消耗为（0）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的下一个奥秘的法力值消耗为（0）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个白银之手新兵获得+3/+3和嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: And with the new title of 'Golden Hand Recruit', you also get a pay raise!
Tag.zhCN: 有了新职称“黄金之手新兵”，你的薪金也提升了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Infuse (@): Gain stats equal to the Attack of the minions that Infused this.
Tag.zhCN: 注能（@）：获得属性值，数值等同于为本随从注能的随从的攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: That poor golem is going to be stuck as a guard forever. He can never get a head!
Tag.zhCN: 可怜的魔像，被永远地困在了守卫的岗位上，再无出头之日！

Tag.zhCN: 费林或其盟友必须击败本随从，将它抢救回来。亡语：里面可能……有惊喜！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 注：只有购买升级套餐才能获得左臂。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This is delicious! Oh no. BRAIN FREEEEEEEZE!

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Summon the minion it last attacked.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：召唤本随从上次攻击的随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Summon a minion from both player's decks. Repeat until either side of the battlefield is full.
Tag.zhCN: 从双方玩家的牌库中各召唤一个随从。重复，直到任意一方的随从数量达到上限。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $3 damage to a_character and Freeze it.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个角色造成$3点伤害，并使其冻结。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It is customary to yell "Chill out!" or "Freeze!" or "Ice ice, baby!" when you play this card.
Tag.zhCN: 在你用这张牌的时候，你可以随意喊出一些咒语，比如“冻住！”“冻结！”或者“结冰，结冰吧，宝贝儿！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Colossal +2 After a friendly Mech attacks, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
Tag.zhCN: 巨型+2 在一个友方机械攻击后，对所有敌人造成1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Always planning ahead, Ini knew she'd need this invention to protect all her other inventions.
Tag.zhCN: 伊妮总能计划在先。她料到自己会用这项发明来保护她的其他发明。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Taunt When a minion is summoned, attack it.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。当一个随从被召唤时，攻击它。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Rogues want me Fish fear me
Tag.zhCN: 潜行者好爱我 小鱼儿好怕我

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 对一个敌人造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现一项能力。亡语：休眠4回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现一项能力。亡语：休眠4回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现一项能力。亡语：休眠4回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：造成1点伤害。连击：获得吸血。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使格蕾丝获得+1攻击力和吸血。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使格蕾丝获得+2攻击力和吸血和无视嘲讽。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Her expert knack for carefully timed damage has made her a formidable combatant.
Tag.zhCN: 她擅长在合适的时机造成合适的伤害，堪称强大的斗士。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Taunt Whenever this is attacked, draw a card for each player, and play the one with highest cost.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。每当本随从受到攻击时，为每个玩家抽一张牌，并使用法力值消耗较高的牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个友方随从获得冲锋。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现一项能力。亡语：休眠3回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现一项能力。亡语：休眠3回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现一项能力。亡语：休眠3回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's an excellent protector... when he's not busy charging headlong into battle!
Tag.zhCN: 他是个出色的护卫……冲向战场时除外！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Used to strike an area. Battlecry: The next Mech you play costs (0).
Tag.zhCN: 用于敲击某个区域。。战吼：你使用的下一张机械牌法力值消耗为（0）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的下一张机械牌的法力值消耗为（0）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal @ damage to an enemy. Increases for each Naga played this game.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个敌人造成@点伤害。在本局对战中，你每使用过一张纳迦牌，伤害都会提高。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Dedicated to the court at an early age, Zainra never approved of your friendship with Dathril.
Tag.zhCN: 扎恩拉年轻时便投身王庭，从未认可过你和达斯利的友谊。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a spell is cast, summon a minion of that spell's Cost.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个法术被施放时，召唤一个法力值消耗等同于该法术的随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Gives Grace Deathrattle: Draw a card for each enemy minion on the board.
Tag.zhCN: 使格蕾丝获得亡语：场上每有一个敌方随从，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Draw a card for each enemy minion on the board.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：场上每有一个敌方随从，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Pirates consider it an honor to lose to her, given her reputation... but you're not a pirate.
Tag.zhCN: 在海盗圈，输给她都算是种荣耀……但你不是海盗。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Turn an enemy minion Dormant. Your opponent must pay a random sum to awaken it.
Tag.zhCN: 使一个敌方随从休眠。你的对手必须付出一定代价才能将其唤醒。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever this attacks, both players draw until they have 4 cards.
Tag.zhCN: 每当本随从攻击时，双方玩家抽若干数量的牌，直到拥有四张手牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: The elements themselves seem to have turned against you as they rage across the open sea...
Tag.zhCN: 元素在大海上肆虐，突然向你发难……

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal @ damage to a random enemy. (increases each use)
Tag.zhCN: 随机对一个敌人造成@点伤害。（每次使用都会提升）

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage to a minion. If it's Frozen, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$2点伤害。如果它已被冻结，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This may appear weak at frost glance, but it's actually a very ice spell.
Tag.zhCN: 这个法术听起来很次，实际上并非如此。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现一项能力。亡语：休眠4回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现一项能力。亡语：休眠4回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Summon the minion it last attacked.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：召唤本随从上次攻击的随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Passive Enemy cards cost (@) more. Changes at the start of their turn.
Tag.zhCN: 被动 敌方卡牌法力值消耗增加（@）点。在其回合开始时改变。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中不能使用卡牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After you play an SI:7 card, deal damage equal to its Cost to the enemy Hero.
Tag.zhCN: 在你使用一张军情七处牌后，对敌方英雄造成等同于其法力值消耗的伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Taunt At the end of your turn, deal $3 damage to two random enemy minions. Deathrattle: Advance fight.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽 在你的回合结束时，随机对两个敌方随从造成$3点伤害。亡语：推进战斗。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After you cast a spell, attack the lowest Health ally.
Tag.zhCN: 在你施放一个法术后，攻击生命值最低的友方角色。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Loses 1 Attack when a Terrifying Tentacle dies. Deathrattle: Go Dormant for 3 turns.
Tag.zhCN: 当恐怖触须死亡时失去1点攻击力。亡语：休眠3回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Loses 1 Attack when a Terrifying Tentacle dies. Deathrattle: Go Dormant for 3 turns.
Tag.zhCN: 当恐怖触须死亡时失去1点攻击力。亡语：休眠3回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Taunt Loses 1 Attack when a Giant Tentacle dies.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，当恐怖触须死亡时失去1点攻击力。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Loses 1 Attack when a Terrifying Tentacle dies. Deathrattle: Go Dormant for 3 turns.
Tag.zhCN: 当恐怖触须死亡时失去1点攻击力。亡语：休眠3回合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Unleash the amulet's power against Queen Azshara to secure your escape.
Tag.zhCN: 释放护符的力量来对抗艾萨拉女王，安全撤离。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: You've hired the best possible vessel and its engineer, Ini Stormcoil, to take you to the ruins of Zin-Azshari.
Tag.zhCN: 你雇佣了最好的潜艇，还有机师伊妮·积雷，出发前往辛艾萨莉的遗迹。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: The crew is ready to begin the voyage! But is the submarine...?

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: This vessel is truly a marvel of modern engineering! Better not press the wrong button...
Tag.zhCN: 这艘潜艇堪称现代工程学的奇迹！最好不要按错按钮……

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: This vessel runs a lot more smoothly when the water is on the outside and not the inside.
Tag.zhCN: 潜艇的行进顺畅了许多，特别是在把水排到了舱外之后。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Tangling with a kraken has left catastrophic damage, as well as some stowaways!
Tag.zhCN: 与海怪的战斗带来了严重的伤害，以及偷渡者！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: You'll need every trick in the book to get it going THIS time.
Tag.zhCN: 这一次，你需要用到书中的内容了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inactive This needs a tweak to get started!

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Waterlogged, Inactive It's usually best to start with this one.
Tag.zhCN: 已浸水，未启动 修理通常从这里开始。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inactive This needs a fiery tweak to get going!
Tag.zhCN: 未启动 需要调整加热才能使用！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Activated The fuel is flowing and ready to go!
Tag.zhCN: 已启动 燃料流动正常，准备供能！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: On Fire, Inactive This should be cooled without damaging it!
Tag.zhCN: 已失火，未启动 需要冷却，别搞坏了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inactive This needs a rinse and a tweak to restore it!
Tag.zhCN: 未启动 需要清洗调校才能恢复！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inactive Pry it open to begin stoking the fires!

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inactive It still needs to be pried open with something hot.
Tag.zhCN: 未启动 需要用加热过的工具撬开。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Activated The boiler is ready to receive some fuel!
Tag.zhCN: 已启动 可以给锅炉供燃料了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: On Fire, Inactive Put out the flames without harming the boiler.
Tag.zhCN: 已失火，未启动 熄灭火焰。不要伤到锅炉。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inactive Open the boiler with a tool that also clears out the ash.
Tag.zhCN: 未启动 用工具打开锅炉，清空灰尘。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inactive It's not safe to use this until the water's been pounded out.
Tag.zhCN: 未启动 排干水之前无法安全使用。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: On Fire, Inactive Combat the flames carefully to restore it.
Tag.zhCN: 已失火，未启动 仔细扑灭火焰，使其恢复运转。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Inactive Whack this with something watery to get it operational.
Tag.zhCN: 未启动 需要用沾了水的工具敲打才能使用。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Ini deals 1-3 damage to random enemy minions when she is attacked.
Tag.zhCN: 当伊妮受到攻击时，随机对敌方随从造成1-3点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deals 1-3 damage to random enemy minions when attacked.
Tag.zhCN: 当伊妮受到攻击时，随机对敌方随从造成1-3点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Rush, Divine Shield After this attacks, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 突袭。圣盾。在本随从攻击后，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Gain 2 Mana Crystals this turn only. Overload: (2)
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，获得两个法力水晶。过载：（2）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Curiously, this plant never blooms in the same place twice.
Tag.zhCN: 神奇的是，这种花不会在同一个地方绽放两次。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 对所有敌方随从造成$3点伤害，过载：（2）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: An umbrella won't be effective, I'm afraid.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's got a keen eye for loot, but sometimes throwing gold around can work against him.
Tag.zhCN: 他对战利品特别敏感，但有时金子也能吸引他的注意。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Passive Your enemy guesses whose hand has greater total Mana Cost to earn a Coin.
Tag.zhCN: 被动 使你的敌人猜测双方手牌的法力值消耗总和哪一方更大，猜中即可获取一张幸运币。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Guess that the enemy's hand has a lesser total Mana Cost than yours.
Tag.zhCN: 猜测敌人手牌法力值消耗的总和比你的低。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Guess that the enemy's hand has a greater total Mana Cost than yours.
Tag.zhCN: 猜测敌人手牌法力值消耗的总和比你的高。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]After you summon a Mech, deal 3 damage randomly _split among all enemies.
Tag.zhCN: 在你召唤一个机械后，造成3点伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Why didn't you just build a normal submarine. Only you can fit inside" "WhY DiDn'T YoU JuSt BuIlD anormalsub-WHY DO YOU THINK WREZIG!! If you can build a freaking Mecha-Shark, then you build a freaking Mecha-Shark!"
Tag.zhCN: “你为什么不造一艘正常的潜艇呢，自己坐的那种。”“你为什么不造一艘正常的——你在想什么！要是你能造机械大鲨鱼，那当然要造机械大鲨鱼！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使你的其他机械获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Don't leave them out in the rain. In Un'Goro Crater there is a whole colony of rust-tooth leapers.
Tag.zhCN: 最好不要让它们淋雨。在安戈洛环型山，金刚锈牙兽的数量已经无法控制了。

Tag.zhCN: 第5天。伊莉斯有个预感，失落之城就在葛拉卡温泉的深处。尼利潜了下去，发现了一个美丽的洞窟！也许鱼人不知道失落之城的入口，但它们身上肯定还有秘密。

Tag.zhCN: 第7天。今天很惨！脚下的地面开裂，我们直接栽进了裂隙！邪能干扰了我的感官，迷雾里到处都是魔化的野兽。好在安布拉用魔法驱散了它们，我们这才逃了出来。

Tag.zhCN: 第9天。迎接我们的不是温暖的怀抱，而是冰冷的长矛。好在埃舒头领体谅我们，屏退了卫兵。有个泰坦考据学家听说了伊莉斯的专业能力，把她请到了图书馆。而安布拉又在城里消失了……

Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，弃一张牌并用3/2的小鬼填满你的面板。持续3回合。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Wow, the Tortollans really embellish these stories.
Tag.zhCN: 哇哦，始祖龟的故事美化得太过了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Taunt Deathrattle: Get 2 random Fel spells. They cost Health instead of Mana.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。亡语：随机获取2张邪能法术牌。这些牌会消耗生命值，而非法力值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 消耗生命值，而非法力值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Poisonous, Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Blob with Poisonous and a 2/2 Blob with Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 剧毒。嘲讽。亡语：召唤一个2/2并具有剧毒的黏团，以及一个2/2并具有嘲讽的黏团。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 丛林有风险，焦油需谨慎。

Tag.name: HOW_TO_EARN
Tag.enUS: Earnable after opening a The Lost City of Un'Goro card pack.
Tag.zhCN: 打开安戈洛龟途卡牌包后可解锁。

Tag.zhCN: 亡语：&随机获取两张临时的法力值消耗为（2）的随从牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: And a tiny soul patch to match.
Tag.zhCN: 唇下再留一撮小胡子就更棒了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 使一个友方随从获得+4/+4和“亡语：随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（4）的随从。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: +4/+4和亡语：随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（4）的随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After your hero attacks,& deal 1 damage to all minions.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的英雄攻击后，&对所有随从造成1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: ...and the axe of the beforefathers before the forefathers before him.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。亡语：&随机召唤一只邪能野兽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Oh, don't worry, Deathy doesn't bite.
Tag.zhCN: 哦，别怕，阿烂不会咬人的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]At the end of your turn,& set the Attack and Health of all enemy minions to 1.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，&将所有敌方随从的攻击力和生命值变为1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Who died and made him King of anything?
Tag.zhCN: 究竟有多少命丧，才成就了山中之王？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Summon two 2/1 Sizzling Cinders. Kindred: Trigger your Sizzling Cinders' Deathrattles.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤两个2/1的炽烈烬火。延系：触发你的炽烈烬火的 亡语。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You can't just have the sizzle, you gotta have the cinders.
Tag.zhCN: 你不能只要火的炽烈，不要火的余烬。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After you Discover a card, reduce its Cost by (1).
Tag.zhCN: 在你发现一张卡牌后，使其法力值消耗减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I've already told him 3 times to PUSH.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Quest: Shuffle cards into your deck, 5 times. Reward: Master Dusk.
Tag.zhCN: 任务：将卡牌洗入你的牌库，总计5次。奖励：暮影 大师。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Day 2. Our first night in the Crater was a tad rough on this old shell. I can’t shake the feeling that we’re being watched. I swear I saw a glint of shining silver in the dark. I was going to ask Umbra about it at breakfast, but she never turned up.
Tag.zhCN: 第2天。山里的第一夜有点难受，唉，年纪大了。总觉得有人在监视我们，昨天夜里我绝对看到了什么奇怪的亮光。本打算早餐时问问安布拉，可她一直没露面。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: When this dies, shuffle it into your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 当本随从死亡时，将其洗入你的牌库。

Tag.name: CARDNAME
Tag.zhCN: 暮影大师重洗玩家附加效果

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: When a Ninja dies, shuffle it into your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 当一个忍者死亡时，将其洗入你的牌库。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Draw 2 cards that didn't start in your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 抽两张你套牌之外的牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Summon two 3/3 Ninjas with Stealth. Your Ninjas now shuffle back into your deck when they die.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤两个3/3并具有潜行的忍者。你的忍者会在其死亡时洗回你的牌库。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Discover a Legendary minion. Shuffle the other two into_your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发现一张传说随从牌。将其余两张洗入你的牌库。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Tortollan has knives if you have coin."
Tag.zhCN: “只要你肯出钱，始祖龟自然会出力。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Discover a card from your deck. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
Tag.zhCN: 从你的牌库中发现一张牌，如果你在本回合中使用该牌，再从其余选项中选择一张。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Are the Shrouded Shells actually great trackers, or are the Cult of the Damned just REALLY bad about leaving secret maps lying around?
Tag.zhCN: 究竟是隐甲龟的侦查技艺确实精湛？还是说诅咒教派离谱过于离谱，把他们的机密地图到处乱丢？

Tag.name: CARDNAME
Tag.zhCN: 异教地图玩家附加效果

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you play the Discovered card this turn, also choose one of the other two options.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你在本回合中使用发现的牌，再从其余选项中选择一张。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Get a random weapon from another class. Combo: Give it +2 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机获取一张另一职业的武器牌。连击：使其获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Neferset your drink on the table without a coaster.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal $@ damage to a minion (improved for each time you've shuffled cards into your deck).
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$@点伤害（你每将卡牌洗入牌库一次都会提升）。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Shuffle three 3/3 Ninjas with Stealth into your deck that are Summoned When Drawn.
Tag.zhCN: 将三张3/3并具有潜行和抽到时召唤的忍者洗入你的牌库。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Spill the tea or I'll end your entire career, sis."
Tag.zhCN: “招了吧，不然我就让你身败名裂。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summon a 1/1 Spitter with Stealth and Poisonous. Kindred: Do it again.
Tag.zhCN: 召唤一只1/1并具有潜行和剧毒的喷毒龙。延系：重复一次。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Rush Costs (1) less for each time you've shuffled cards into your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 突袭 你每将牌洗入你的牌库一次，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: An expert at tracking the elusive Adaptive Amalgam.
Tag.zhCN: 追踪进化融合怪的专家。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Look at 3 cards in your enemy's deck. Pick one to put on top.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：检视敌方牌库中的三张牌，选择一张置于其牌库顶。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I got eyes on Umbra's unstoppable undead army. I'll uh... stay wayyy up here."
Tag.zhCN: “我看到了安布拉的亡灵大军。我……我就在上面好了。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Stealth. Battlecry, Combo, and Deathrattle:& Cast 'Fan of Knives'.
Tag.zhCN: 潜行。战吼，连击，亡语：&施放刀扇。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This is allegedly what Opu looks like. We will confirm if we ever see him.
Tag.zhCN: 据说奥普就长这个样子。我们会进一步确认他的形象——如果我们有机会见到他的话。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Deal 5 damage and gain 5 Armor. Kindred: Costs (2) less.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：造成5点伤害，获得5点护甲值。延系：法力值消耗减少（2）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's so anxious. Always winds up in knots.
Tag.zhCN: 他太纠结了。起飞时总会纠成一个结。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Spend up to 5 Armor. For each spent, deal $1 damage to all minions.
Tag.zhCN: 消耗最多5点护甲值。每消耗一点，对所有随从造成$1点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Quest: Survive 10 turns. Reward: Latorvius, Gaze of the City.
Tag.zhCN: 任务：存活10个回合。奖励：拉特维厄斯，城市之眼。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Day 8. We’ve done it! As night fell, we came upon a brilliantly glowing tunnel guarded by two slumbering Tol’vir. With silent footsteps, we walked through and emerged into the heart of the Lost City! I’m sure my people will welcome us with open arms.
Tag.zhCN: 第8天。成功了！入夜时分，我们走到一处发光的隧道，入口只有两个瞌睡的托维尔人看守。我们悄悄走过隧道，直接来到了失落之城的核心地带！同胞们一定会用温暖的怀抱迎接我们。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Get 2 random 'Journey to Un'Goro' Quest Rewards. Shuffle the rest into your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机获取2张勇闯安戈洛的任务奖励。将其余奖励洗入你的牌库。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：抽一张牌。亡语：弃掉该牌。

Tag.name: HOW_TO_EARN_GOLDEN
Tag.enUS: Earnable on The Lost City of Un'Goro Reward Track.
Tag.zhCN: 可以在安戈洛龟途奖励路线中获得该奖励。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: When this dies, discard the card it drew.
Tag.zhCN: 当本随从死亡时，弃掉其抽到的牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Taunt, Lifesteal Has +6 Attack during your opponent's turn.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。吸血 在你对手的回合拥有+6攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Why would they put a waterfall here if there wasn't something cool behind it?
Tag.zhCN: 后面肯定有什么好东西，不然他们为什么要在这里放一道瀑布呢？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to an enemy minion. If it dies,& gain 5 Armor.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：对一个敌方随从造成2点伤害。如果该随从死亡，&获得5点护甲值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: All it needs now is a nice coat of blue paint!
Tag.zhCN: 现在只需要给龟壳喷上一层蓝漆！

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal 2 damage to an enemy minion.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个敌方随从造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Gain 3 Armor. Deal damage equal to your Armor to an enemy minion.
Tag.zhCN: 获得3点护甲值。对一个敌方随从造成等同于你护甲值的伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 堡垒异常强固——富含维生素和矿物质！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Taunt Deathrattle: Destroy the _top 3 cards of your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。亡语：摧毁你牌库顶的三张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I still don't know why he has a sword. Despite being in many battles, he really just watches.
Tag.zhCN: 我还是不明白为什么他拿着把剑。他主要的任务明明是观察。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summon two 0/6 Security with Taunt. They gain +1 Attack when damaged.
Tag.zhCN: 召唤两个0/6并具有嘲讽的守卫。守卫在受到伤害时会获得+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: These 0/6 Taunts have kept invaders out for centuries.
Tag.zhCN: 千百年来，正是这些0/6的嘲讽随从挡住了入侵者。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Taunt After this takes damage, gain +1 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽 在本随从受到伤害后，获得+1攻击力。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn,& give another friendly damaged minion +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，&使一个受伤的其他友方随从获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Summon copies of your damaged minions. Give the copies Rush.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤你受伤的随从的复制，使复制获得突袭。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Of course the Titans trust the Tortollans to take care of Un'Goro Crater. Nablya is just there as insurance.
Tag.zhCN: 当然啦，把安戈洛交给始祖龟，泰坦们完全放心。娜博亚留在这里只是一道保险。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Rush. Whenever this takes damage,& get a 1-Cost Gorishi Stinger.
Tag.zhCN: 突袭。每当本随从受到伤害，&获取一张法力值消耗为（1）的格里什毒刺虫。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This card is the wasp's elbows!

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage. Summon a 2/1 Grub with Rush.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$2点伤害。召唤一只2/1并具有突袭的异种虫幼体。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Quest: Deal exactly 2 damage to an enemy on your turn, 12 times. Reward: Gorishi Colossus.
Tag.zhCN: 任务：在你的回合对敌人造成刚好2点伤害，总计12次。奖励：格里什巨虫。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Day 4. I am dismayed to report that we thought we'd found a hidden entrance to the Lost City, but in fact it was a Silithid Hive! We high-tailed it out of there faster than a goblin wearing rocket boots. I am not terribly fond of bugs.
Tag.zhCN: 第4天。很遗憾，本以为是失落之城入口的那个洞其实是异种虫的巢穴！我们逃出来的时候，跑得比地精穿了火箭靴还快。我实在不喜欢虫子。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: For the rest of the game, whenever you deal exactly 2 damage to an enemy, deal 2 more.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：在本局对战的剩余时间内，每当你对敌人刚好造成2点伤害时，多造成2点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Swap your Hero Power to "Deal 8 damage to a random enemy." After 2 uses, swap back.
Tag.zhCN: 将你的英雄技能替换为“随机对一个敌人造成8点伤害。”使用两次后，换回原技能。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "...and there were seven minions on board, and it STILL hit the enemy hero!"
Tag.zhCN: “……当时对面足有七个随从，可它还是砸中了敌方英雄的脸！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $8 damage to a random enemy. (Two uses left!)
Tag.zhCN: 随机对一个敌人造成$8点伤害。（还可使用两次！）

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $8 damage to a random enemy. (Last use!)
Tag.zhCN: 随机对一个敌人造成$8点伤害。（还可使用一次！）

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Deal 6 damage to an enemy minion with a minion type.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：对一个具有随从类型的敌方随从造成6点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Tortollans would be nothing without their QA department.
Tag.zhCN: 要是没有质保部门帮忙捉虫，始祖龟一族早就完蛋了。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal 6 damage to an enemy with a minion type.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个具有随从类型的敌人造成6点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Summon two Deathrattle minions from your deck. They fight!
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：从你的牌库中召唤两个亡语随从，并使其互相攻击！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Whenever another friendly minion attacks, set its Health equal to this minion's Health.
Tag.zhCN: 每当另一个友方随从攻击时，将其生命值变为与本随从相同。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 能对你的生命产生重大影响。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Choose a minion. If it's friendly, give it +2 Health. If it's an enemy, give it -2 Health.
Tag.zhCN: 选择一个随从。如果是友方随从，使其获得+2生命值；如果是敌方随从，使其获得-2生命值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle:& Get a random Holy and Shadow spell.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：&随机获取神圣和暗影法术牌各一张。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Gravedawn Glade is FULL of indecisive Priests.
Tag.zhCN: 墓晨林地里到处都是难以决断的牧师。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summon a random 4-Cost minion and give it Taunt. Kindred: Do it again.
Tag.zhCN: 随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（4）的随从并使其获得嘲讽。延系：重复一次。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: How many Gravedawns does it take to screw in a Voidbulb?
Tag.zhCN: 维护一株虚空芽需要多少墓晨林地的时光？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 抽两张牌。延系：本牌法力值消耗减少（2）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 太神了！它自己就能帮自己光合作用！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Quest: Cast 4 Holy spells Reward: Life's Breath. Quest: Cast 4 Shadow spells. Reward: Death's Touch.
Tag.zhCN: 任务：施放4个神圣法术。奖励：生命之息。任务：施放4个暗影法术。奖励：死亡之触。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Day 6. Today we found ourselves in a glade tormented by conflicting Holy and Shadow magic. At its center were two enormous Elementals, like opposite sides of the same coin. I hope one day we'll return here to see this broken place restored to peace.
Tag.zhCN: 第6天。今天我们来到了一片林地，神圣和暗影的魔法在此激战。林地中心有两个巨大的元素，就像是同一枚硬币的两面。希望我们还有机会回到这里，期待这片饱受摧残的土地还能恢复平和。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 任务：施放4个神圣法术。奖励：生命之息。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 任务：施放4个暗影法术。奖励：死亡之触。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Taunt. Battlecry: Summon a copy of this. If you're holding both halves _of Sol'etos, combine!
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。战吼：召唤一个本随从的复制。如果你手中有索利托斯的两部分，将其拼合！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Reborn. Deathrattle: Deal 5 damage to a random enemy. If you're holding both halves of Sol'etos, combine!
Tag.zhCN: 复生。亡语：随机对一个敌人造成5点伤害。如果你手中有索利托斯的两部分，将其拼合！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Taunt, Reborn. Battlecry: Summon a copy of this. Deathrattle: Deal 5 damage to a random enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。复生。战吼：召唤一个本随从的复制。亡语：随机对一个敌人造成5点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Resurrect a 1, 2, and 3-Cost minion. Give them Reborn.
