Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$@点伤害并获得2点额外伤害。如果该随从死亡，则失去所有额外伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 暴力会引发暴力，而塔库斯能引发大量暴力。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal damage to a random enemy minion equal to its Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 随机对一个敌方随从造成等同于其攻击力的伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal damage to a random enemy minion equal to its Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 随机对一个敌方随从造成等同于其攻击力的伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: If it opens its mouth, you should run. Double-time.
Tag.zhCN: 如果它张开了大嘴，快跑，二倍速跑起来。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，使你的英雄攻击力翻倍。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，使你的英雄攻击力翻倍。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: His favorite number is 7. Disrupt its perfection at your own peril!
Tag.zhCN: 他最喜欢的数字是7。破坏完美阵型的人后果自负！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]If there are 8 or more minions on the battlefield, destroy them all.
Tag.zhCN: 如果战场上的随从数大于或等于八个，则消灭所有随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Is it insane to let a critter pilot a mech? Dr._Boom_thinks_not.
Tag.zhCN: 让小动物来驾驶机甲，这是疯了吗？“不！没疯！”砰砰博士 喊道。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Give a Mech +2 Attack this turn and force it to attack a random enemy minion.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，使一个机械获得+2攻击力并迫使其随机攻击一个敌方随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]The friendliest face you could hope to meet in a plague-ridden desert.
Tag.zhCN: 在灾祸横行的沙漠里，他就是你最亲的人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Riding on a dinosaur and looking for a fight, Brann's ready to finish this.
Tag.zhCN: 跨上恐龙，但求一战，布莱恩做好了准备，解决这 一切。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal $1 damage, then deal $1 damage to the enemy hero.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$1点伤害，再对敌方英雄造成$1点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Equip a random weapon and set its Durability to 1.
Tag.zhCN: 随机装备一把武器，并将其耐久度变为1点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Passive At the start of your turn, Discover which card you draw.
Tag.zhCN: 被动 在你的回合开始时，发现你要抽 的牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Whether she needs magic or a trusty machete, Elise is ready to save Uldum.
Tag.zhCN: 一手魔法，一手弯刀，伊莉斯做好了准备，拯救奥 丹姆。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Choose One - +$a2 Attack this turn; or Gain $d2 Armor.
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：在本回合中获得+$a2攻击力；或者获得+$d2点护甲值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Restore #2 Health to a character. If it's at full Health, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 为一个角色恢复#2点生命值。此时如果目标拥有所有生命值，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Passive. After you cast 2 spells in a turn, add a Moonfire to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 被动 在一回合中你施放两个法术后，将一张“月火术”置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Sir Finley rides into battle, ready to dispense justice against his final foe.
Tag.zhCN: 战驹疾驰，正义将至，芬利爵士做好了准备，惩戒最终的敌人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summon a 2/2 Amalgam with all minion types.
Tag.zhCN: 召唤一个2/2的融合怪探险者。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 发现一张萨满祭司或圣骑士的战吼随从牌。 过载：（1）。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从获得圣盾和风怒。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]With a bag full of treasures and a well-styled mustache, Reno is ready to take Tekahn down!
Tag.zhCN: 带好宝藏，剪好胡须，雷诺做好了准备，干掉塔 卡恒！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 造成$1点伤害。连击：改为造成$2点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your next spell this turn has Spell Damage +2.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，你的下一个法术拥有法术伤害+2。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: You have Spell Damage +2 for your next spell this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，你的下一个法术拥有法术伤害+2。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Fire two missiles at random enemies that each deal $1 damage. If any minion dies, repeat this.
Tag.zhCN: 发射两枚飞弹，每枚造成$1点伤害。如果任何随从死亡，则重复此效果。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Aww. So cute. Want to feed him another finger?
Tag.zhCN: 噢，它真的好可爱！想不想再喂它几根手指头？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Always fun to say out loud "VOL-CA-NO-SAUUUR!"
Tag.zhCN: 当溃疡长在背上时，你的脾气也不会好到哪去。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 将一个随从的属性值变为7/14。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Comes with fries and a drink.
Tag.zhCN: 可免费升级套餐里的薯条跟可乐。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you control at_least 2 other minions, Adapt.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你控制至少两个其他随从，便获得进化。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Doesn't like to adapt unless others are watching. Some minions are such show-offs.
Tag.zhCN: 并不是很想进化，除非边上有人看着…至少两个。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Bet you can't eat just one murloc!
Tag.zhCN: 昨晚的鱼人刺身实在是太美味了！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Murloc hydrologists are pretty rare. Most murloc undergrads pick computer science.
Tag.zhCN: 绝大多数鱼人冲着就业前景报考了计算机专业，而报考水文学的则寥寥无几。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Taunt Battlecry: Set all other minions' Attack and Health to 3.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，战吼：将所有其他随从的攻击力和生命值变为3。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 其实他最喜欢的数字是4，只可惜…

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage. Add a 1/2 Elemental to_your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$2点伤害。 将一张1/2的元素牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 火可以带来光明，也可以毁掉一切。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 那种没人在意你的感觉，是永远的痛。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What did you draw? Shhhh… it’s a secret.
Tag.zhCN: 你抽到什么了？嘘…那是个秘密。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, add a 'Flame Geyser' to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你在上个回合使用过元素牌，将一张“烈焰喷涌”置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Explorers nicknamed him the Teapot Elemental.
Tag.zhCN: 身处野外的探险者会时不时地用他来泡茶。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Choose a minion. Summon a 1/1 copy of it.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：选择一个随从，召唤一个它的1/1复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Mirage is actually the name of its long-lost cat.
Tag.zhCN: 闲暇时他会召唤一个幻象来陪自己玩炉石。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When your opponent casts a spell, add a copy to your hand that costs (0).
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当你的对手施放一个法术时，将该法术的一张复制置入你的手牌，其法力值消耗变为（0）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $15 damage randomly split among all_minions. Overload: (1)
Tag.zhCN: 造成$15点伤害，随机分配到所有随从身上。 过载：（1）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Many young shaman summon a volcano as their first school project.
Tag.zhCN: 许多年轻的萨满喜欢以火山为主题来做毕业设计。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Return this to_your hand as a 6/6 that costs (4).
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：将本随从移回你的手牌，并变为法力值消耗为（4）点的6/6随从牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you strike her down, she shall become more powerful than you can possibly… well, she'll become a 6/6 anyways.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你杀死她，她会变得更强，强到…变成6/6这样。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Return this to_your hand as a 10/10 that costs (8).
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：将本随从移回你的手牌，并变为法力值消耗为（8）点的10/10随从牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Quest: Cast 8 spells that didn't start in your deck. Reward: Time Warp.
Tag.zhCN: 任务：施放8个你的套牌之外的 法术。 奖励：时空扭曲。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Although powerful, the incantation is simple. It’s just a jump to the left, and then a step to the right.
Tag.zhCN: 这个咒语看似复杂，但只要往左跳一小步，再往右跳一小步，就完成施法了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Take an extra turn. (Once per game)
Tag.zhCN: 获得一个额外回合。（每局对战限一次）

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Discover a copy of a spell in your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 从你的牌库中发现一张法术牌的复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This one’s a bird. And here’s a bunny!
Tag.zhCN: 听说念咒语不跳舞，成功概率要减半！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Restore #5 Health to a minion and your hero.
Tag.zhCN: 为你的英雄和一个随从恢复#5点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: By accepting this healing, you agree to the following terms…
Tag.zhCN: 接受本次治疗就意味着您默认接受了以下条款…

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deathrattle: Copy a card from your opponent's deck _and add it to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：复制你对手的牌库中的一张牌，并将其置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Being made of light has its disadvantages, but at least it's always looking on the bright side.
Tag.zhCN: 他的心里藏不了任何事，所以看起来很阳光。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your spells cost (1) less (but not less than 1).
Tag.zhCN: 你的法术的法力值消耗减少（1）点（但不能少于1点）。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 这可是纯天然的熔岩灯！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 法力值消耗减少（1）点（但不能少于1点）。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Look at 3 cards. Guess which one started in your opponent's deck to get a copy of it.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：检视三张卡牌。猜中来自你对手套牌中的卡牌，则获取该牌的一张复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: George promised to be good. But it's easy for little Glimmerroots to forget.
Tag.zhCN: 好奇的不只有猫，还有萤根草。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，亡语：随机使一个友方随从获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 别看他现在拄着拐杖，年轻时可是大名鼎鼎的“乌龟队长”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 消灭一个友方随从，并连续进化两次。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: For better results, feed your pterrordax low-fat, high-fiber minions.
Tag.zhCN: 想让你的翼手龙变得更强壮吗？那就多喂一点低脂高纤维的随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Taunt Has +3 Attack during your opponent's turn.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽 在你对手的回合拥有+3攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Hi, Tar here. Long time lurking, first time taunting…
Tag.zhCN: 潜了这么久，终于能上来冒个泡了…

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Add two Razorpetals to_your hand that deal_2 damage.
Tag.zhCN: 将两张可造成2点伤害的“刀瓣”置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The result of a fundamental misunderstanding of the phrase "flower power".
Tag.zhCN: 经常不洗澡的人，会有头皮屑。经常不洗澡的花…

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Add a Razorpetal to your hand that deals 2 damage.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：将一张可造成2点伤害的“刀瓣”置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The reason why there are no zombies in Un'goro.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Draw a card, then add a copy of it to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 抽一张牌，然后将一张它的复制置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Costs (1) less for each non-Rogue Class card added to your hand this game.
Tag.zhCN: 在本局对战中，你每将一张非潜行者的职业牌置入你的手牌，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You know you’re a Rogue when a sharp rock makes you go “Ooh! Dagger!”
Tag.zhCN: 因为职业病的关系，潜行者只要看到尖锐的硬物就想拿来当匕首。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Combo: Gain +1/+1 for each other card you've played this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 连击：在本回合中，你每使用一张其他牌，便获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 它还有一个名字，叫“范克里夫草”。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: 'Cause slayers gonna slay, slay, slay, slay, slay.
Tag.zhCN: 它会用舌头抽晕你，再把你吞下去。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Go Dormant. Play 4 cards in a turn to revive this minion.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：进入休眠状态。在一回合中使用4张牌可复活本随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Dormant When you play 4 cards in a turn, revive this minion.
Tag.zhCN: 休眠 在一回合中使用4张牌可复活本随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Quest: Play four minions with the same name. Reward: Crystal Core.
Tag.zhCN: 任务：使用四张名称相同的随从牌。 奖励：水晶核心。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Why can't it ever be The Taverns Below?
Tag.zhCN: 其实洞穴就在旅店的下面。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: For the rest of the game, your minions are 5/5.
Tag.zhCN: 在本局对战的剩余时间内，你的所有随从变为5/5。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, gain _Taunt and Divine_Shield.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你在上个回合使用过元素牌，则获得嘲讽和圣盾。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He spends a lot of time keeping himself in stoneshape.
Tag.zhCN: 他为了保持这副身材，花了大把的时间在塑形。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Still salty about it not being the "Year of the Mastodon."
Tag.zhCN: 它直到如今还在为没能评上“乳齿年”而耿耿于怀。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，战吼： 发现一张具有嘲讽的随从牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Briefly tried stand-up comedy under the name "Stonehill Offender", but turtles are just too thin-skinned.
Tag.zhCN: 它最厉害的武器并非手中的剑盾，而是极尽讽刺挖苦之能事的嘴。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 他虽然怕螃蟹，却喜欢吃螃蟹肉。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 在本随从攻击英雄后，进化。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A youngster who is truly hungry for self-improvement.
Tag.zhCN: 它渴望成长，渴望到发狂。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Often misunderstood, it's just that he likes to use the eggs as pillows.
Tag.zhCN: 说出来怕你不信，他偷蛋只为拿来当枕头用。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Add a random minion with 5 or more Attack to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机将一张攻击力大于或等于5的随从牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: In the Tortollan tongue, Un’goro is known as the “Land of the Lost and Found.”
Tag.zhCN: 在始祖龟语里，“安戈洛”指的是“失落的世界”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 在本随从攻击后，冻结本随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 他讲过的很多笑话，自己都觉得冷。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you played an_Elemental last turn, Adapt.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你在上个回合使用过元素牌，则获得进化。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 什么？都已经这样了，还需要进化？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A key ingredient in all discerning Funnel Cake recipes.
Tag.zhCN: 漏斗蛋糕如此美味的秘诀，就是用魔暴龙蛋来和面。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This is what happens when you use a volcano as a bird bath.
Tag.zhCN: 凤凰本非凡俗鸟，浴火重生凌云霄。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的随从的法力值消耗增加（2）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She rules the emerald hive at the end of the yellow brick trail.
Tag.zhCN: 伊瑟拉对于蜂后将自己的蜂巢命名为“翡翠梦境”感到怒不可遏，发誓要告到她倾家荡产。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a minion from your hand with 5 or more Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。亡语：从你手牌中召唤一个攻击力大于或等于5的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 这条蛇在生前吃了个大家伙。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever this minion takes damage, deal 3 damage to_your hero.
Tag.zhCN: 每当本随从受到伤害，对你的英雄造成 3点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's actually only the middle head that's bitter. The others are sweet and spicy.
Tag.zhCN: 其实只有中间的头口感苦涩，其他的头要么偏甜，要么偏辣。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Discover a spell_and cast it with random targets.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 发现一张法术牌，并向随机目标施放。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I see pizza in my future.
Tag.zhCN: 我在未来看到有吃不完的披萨。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Low, low rents! Must enjoy a nomadic lifestyle. Quasi-sentient, bipedal, amphibious humanoids ONLY!"
Tag.zhCN: 廉价壳屋招租啦！房客仅限情感丰富，温良恭让的双足两栖人型生物，喜好流浪生活者更佳！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 冲锋，战吼：在本回合中无法攻击英雄。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What happens when a dinosaur mixes soda and pop rocks.
Tag.zhCN: 瞧见没，这就是让恐龙吃跳跳糖喝可乐的下场！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Always sticking its neck into other people’s business.
Tag.zhCN: 因为脖子长的缘故，他总爱窥探别人的家长里短。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：变形成为5/3并具有潜行；或者变形成为3/5并具有嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Master of the Three Shell Monte.
Tag.zhCN: 他是玩三壳游戏的高手，你永远也猜不中球在哪个壳下面。

Tag.zhCN: 那些能让你变大的蘑菇通常都装在标有“？”的箱子里。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 使一个友方随从获得+1/+1，然后获得等同于其攻击力的 护甲值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 其实你也可以拥有大地之鳞。第一步：在泥地里打滚；第二步：等自然风干。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 如果你的手牌中有攻击力大于或等于5的随从牌，便获得进化。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：抽一张牌，使其法力值消耗变为（5）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Forming the Golakka Crater was the end of Barnabus' disastrous career as a dancer.
Tag.zhCN: 自从一脚踩出了葛拉卡盆地后，班纳布斯的跳舞生涯便宣告结束了。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使你牌库中所有随从的法力值消耗减为（0）点。

Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，召唤一个1/1的鱼人。

Tag.enUS: Emits a sound only murlocs can hear, which is good because it’s REALLY annoying.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of Elementals in your hand_by (1).
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使你手牌中所有元素牌的法力值消耗减少（1）点。

Tag.enUS: Good for summoning elementals. Great for making s'mores.
Tag.zhCN: 擅长召唤元素，更擅长烤棉花糖。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你在上个回合使用过元素牌，则召唤两个2/3并具有嘲讽的元素。

Tag.zhCN: 他只是想和他的小伙伴们一起摇摆。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你在上个回合使用过元素牌，则施放一个元素祈咒。

Tag.zhCN: 炼金术师认为只要将土、气、水、火四种元素结合在一起，就能产生第五元素。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你控制至少两个其他随从，便获得嘲讽。

Tag.enUS: Universally adored by both control decks and ninjas.

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 毒液取自安戈洛的当地植物，威力惊人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 任务：弃掉六张牌。 奖励：虚空传送门。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 探险者：“但是，古尔丹，代价是什么呢？” 古尔丹：“弃掉…六张牌…”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Open a permanent portal that summons 3/2 Imps.
Tag.zhCN: 打开一座会永久召唤3/2小鬼的传送门。

Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，召唤两个3/2的小鬼。

Tag.enUS: [x]Deathrattle: Summon a random minion you discarded this game.

Tag.zhCN: 这帮小家伙只有1/1的身材，却有着4/4的食量！

Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 摧毁你牌库中所有法力值消耗小于或等于（3）点的卡牌。

Tag.zhCN: 亡语：将两张1/2的烈焰元素置入你的手牌。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机将一张法师法术牌置入你的 手牌。

Tag.enUS: HATES being summoned for Kirin Tor party lighting.
Tag.zhCN: 他最讨厌被肯瑞托的法师拿来当派对的灯光特效。

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你在上个回合使用过元素牌，则造成5点伤害。

Tag.zhCN: 它的一副公鸭嗓让自己在族群里独树一帜。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Shuffle a sealed Un'Goro pack into your deck. If your deck has no duplicates, draw it.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 将一张安戈洛卡牌包洗入你的牌库。如果你的牌库里没有相同的牌，则抽取这张卡牌包。

Tag.zhCN: 雷诺教导她别老跟着藏宝图走，要勇敢地踏上未知的旅途。

Tag.enUS: Add 5 Journey to Un'Goro cards to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 将五张勇闯安戈洛系列的卡牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.zhCN: 历经数千年的演变后，它变成了我们现在所熟知的精灵龙。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Discover a minion that costs (8) or more. Summon it.
Tag.zhCN: 发现一张法力值消耗大于或等于（8）点的随从牌，并召唤该随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Discover a card from your opponent's class.
Tag.zhCN: 发现一张你对手职业的卡牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's the good kind of hallucination.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After you summon a minion, trigger its Deathrattle effect.
Tag.zhCN: 在你召唤一个随从后，触发其亡语。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 听到她歌声的随从们纷纷选择了…死亡。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Taunt Battlecry: Gain +5 Health for each Elemental you played last turn.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，战吼：在上个回合，你每使用一张元素牌，便获得+5生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Between you and me, Ozruk is a bit obsessed with his body.
Tag.zhCN: 欧泽鲁克很在意自己的身材，是健身房里的常客。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$3点伤害，并对其相邻的随从 造成$1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Ooh. I'll have a bite of this, and of this, and of this...
Tag.zhCN: 牙好，胃口就好，什么都想咬一口。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry:& Add a random Beast to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：&随机将一张野兽牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It’s not LITERALLY jeweled. The goblins were terribly disappointed.
Tag.zhCN: 地精珠宝商慕名而来，失望而归…

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Draw two 1-Cost minions from your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：从你的牌库中抽两张法力值消耗为（1）的随从牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Ferocious in combat… and even more terrifying in pet battles.
Tag.zhCN: 作战时以勇猛著称…特别是在宠物对战里。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Shuffle a 4/5 Raptor into your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：将一张4/5的“迅猛龙头领”洗入你的 牌库。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They’re just baby teeth. Lots and lots of baby teeth.
Tag.zhCN: 等它咬掉你的手指时，你就不会觉得它可爱了。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Wasn't clever enough to go AROUND the electric fence.
Tag.zhCN: 还不够聪明，都不会绕过通电的防护栏。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Each time you play a Beast this turn, add_a_random Beast to_your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，每当你使用一张野兽牌，随机将一张野兽牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 猎人们就喜欢这种乱哄哄一拥而上的感觉。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Replace your Hero Power with 'Give a Beast +3/+3.'
Tag.zhCN: 将你的英雄技能替换为“使一只野兽获得+3/+3”。

Tag.zhCN: 那些喜欢研究恐龙的人，多半都成了恐龙的晚餐。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After your opponent plays a minion, attack_it.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，攻击该随从。

Tag.enUS: Swamp King Dred, more like Swamp King Dead, amiright?
Tag.zhCN: 常年生活在沼泽潮湿环境下的爵德，不可避免地患上了关节炎。

Tag.zhCN: 任务：使用七张法力值消耗为（1）的随从牌。 奖励：卡纳莎女王。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Question: What's scarier, one giant angry dinosaur or 20 smaller vicious ones? Answer: AHHHHHHH THEY FOUND MEEEEEE
Tag.zhCN: 是1个大恐龙可怕呢，还是20个小恐龙可怕呢？这是一个值得思考的…啊！它们来了！！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 突袭。战吼：将20张迅猛龙牌洗入你的牌库。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Replace your deck with_copies of "Discover a card."
Tag.zhCN: 将你牌库里的所有卡牌替换成 “发现一张牌”。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It turns out cards DO grow on trees!
Tag.zhCN: 我就说卡牌是树上长出来的吧，你还不信！

Tag.enUS: Week 6. I remain covered head to toe with scales. They do not yet realize that I am not a dinosaur.

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Orcish raiders ride wolves because they are well adapted to harsh environments, and because they are soft and cuddly.
Tag.zhCN: 兽人劫掠者们以狼作为坐骑是因为它们能够适应艰苦的环境，而且它们特别温顺，很会讨兽人喜欢。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He likes to act like he's in charge, but the silverback matriarch actually runs things.
Tag.zhCN: 尽管他表现得像个领导者，但实际上银背母猩猩才是真正管事的人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They're still embarrassed about "The Deathwing Incident".
Tag.zhCN: 对于“死亡之翼毁城事件”，他仍然耿耿于怀。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: In the old days, Kobolds were the finest candle merchants in the land. Then they got pushed too far...
Tag.zhCN: 在过去，狗头人是这片土地上最好的蜡烛交易商，直到它们被逼太甚...

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Has Charge while you have a weapon equipped.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你装备着武器，本随从拥有 冲锋。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Pirates are into this new fad called "Planking".
Tag.zhCN: 海盗们都非常热衷于这项新的时尚活动：“趴甲板”。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She's never quite sure what she's making, she just knows it's AWESOME!
Tag.zhCN: 她从来不知道她想发明的是什么，她只知道要发明很棒的东西！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Stormpike Commandos are demolition experts. They also bake a mean cupcake.
Tag.zhCN: 雷矛特种兵都是爆破专家。他们还会烘焙简易的蛋糕。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's good to be a knight. Less so to be one's squire.
Tag.zhCN: 做一名骑士很威风，但是做骑士的侍从感觉就差一点了。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You earn the title of Archmage when you can destroy anyone who calls you on it.
Tag.zhCN: 只要你能消灭任何质疑你的头衔的人，你就能获得“大法师”的头衔。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Just mail him a package with a name and 10,000 gold. He'll take care of the rest.
Tag.zhCN: 把姓名和10000金币打包邮寄给他。剩下的他会帮你搞定。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He used to be a 2100+ rated arena player, but that was years ago and nobody can get him to shut up about it.
Tag.zhCN: 他曾经是一个2100分段的竞技场高端玩家。但那已经是几年前的事情了，而且没人能阻止他继续吹嘘这件事。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Mrrraggglhlhghghlgh, mrgaaag blarrghlgaahahl mrgggg glhalhah a bghhll graggmgmg Garrosh mglhlhlh mrghlhlhl!!
Tag.zhCN: 姆啦啦咯哈姆噶啊啊嘎，姆啦嘎嘎咯，啵啦啦嗯嘞噶哈，姆啦嗝，咯啦哈哈吧啦咯。加尔鲁什咯嘛啦喝，嘛啦咯呵！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They were the inspiration for the championship Taurenball team: The Dragonhawks.
Tag.zhCN: 无论是战士还是诗人，都能从美丽的龙鹰身上获取战斗或是写作的灵感。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 决斗的时候离它们远点儿。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: “去杀30条迅猛龙。”——赫米特·奈辛瓦里

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He just wants a hug. A sloppy... slimy... hug.
Tag.zhCN: 他只是想要一个拥抱。一个黏黏的...滑滑的...拥抱。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Sen'jin Village is nice, if you like trolls and dust.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你喜欢巨魔和沙尘的话，森金村还是个不错的地方。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He claims it is an old war wound, but we think he just cut himself shaving.
Tag.zhCN: 他说这是在一次惨烈的战斗中留下的伤疤，但我们觉得，他只是刮胡子的时候弄伤了自己。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He always dreamed of coming down from the mountains and opening a noodle shop, but he never got the nerve.
Tag.zhCN: 他梦想着有一天能够下山开一间拉面店。但他没有那个勇气。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Golems are not afraid, but for some reason they still run when you cast Fear on them. Instinct, maybe? A desire to blend in?
Tag.zhCN: 傀儡们从来不会胆怯，但是出于某种原因，当你对它们施放“恐惧”的时候，它们依然会逃跑。也许这就是天性？或是想要融入这个世界的渴望？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You can hire him... until someone offers him enough gold to turn on you.
Tag.zhCN: 你可以雇佣他们为你效命...直到有人出更高的价钱来让他们对付你。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：在本回合中，使一个随从获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: ADD ME TO YOUR DECK, MAGGOT!

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中获得+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Don't bother asking her out on a date. She'll shoot you down.
Tag.zhCN: 媚眼如丝，轻盈如燕，致命如箭。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Someone did mess with Tuskerr once. ONCE.
Tag.zhCN: 有人曾经把塔丝克惹毛过一次。就一次。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Training Ogres in the art of spellcasting is a questionable decision.
Tag.zhCN: 教授食人魔如何施法是个值得商榷的决定。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "ME HAVE GOOD STATS FOR THE COST"
Tag.zhCN: “我非常厉害，绝对值这个价格！”

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You don’t tame a Core Hound. You just train it to eat someone else before it eats you.
Tag.zhCN: 你无法驯服一头熔火恶犬。你只能通过训练让它在吃掉你之前先吃掉其他人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Their wings are silent but their screech is... whatever the opposite of silent is.
Tag.zhCN: 它们挥动翅膀的时候悄无声息，但是它们的嘶鸣却是...任何悄无声息的反义词都可以形容。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: One Insane Rocketeer. One Rocket full of Explosives. Infinite Fun.
Tag.zhCN: 一个疯狂的火箭兵加上一个装满炸药的火箭。完美的组合。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She'll craft you a sword, but you'll need to bring her 5 Steel Ingots, 3 Motes of Earth, and the scalp of her last customer.
Tag.zhCN: 她会为你代工一把好武器，但是你必须给她5个铁锭，3个土之微粒，以及她上一个顾客的头皮。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: When Deathwing assaulted the capital, this soldier was the only member of his squad to survive. Now he's all bitter and stuff.
Tag.zhCN: 在死亡之翼攻击主城的时候，这个士兵是小队中唯一活下来的一个。现在，他已经变得忍辱负重，镇定自若了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each other friendly minion on the battlefield.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：战场上每有一个其他友方随从，便获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Frostwolves are locked in combat with the Stormpike Expedition over control of Alterac Valley. Every attempt at peace-talks has ended with Captain Galvangar killing the mediator.
Tag.zhCN: 为了争夺奥克兰特山谷的控制权，霜狼氏族和雷矛探险队打得不可开交。任何前来企图进行和平谈判的斡旋者都会被处死。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的随从牌的法力值消耗增加（3）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: No Job is too big. No fee is too big.

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you hit an Eredar Lord with enough Wisps, it will explode. But why?
Tag.zhCN: 如果你用足够多的小精灵攻击艾瑞达领主的话，他就会爆炸。但这是为什么呢？

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 我打赌你一定不敢进攻达纳苏斯。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy your weapon and deal its damage to all enemies.
Tag.zhCN: 摧毁你的武器，对所有敌人造成等同于其攻击力的伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Look, it's not just about waving daggers around really fast. It's a lot more complicated than that." - Shan, Rogue Trainer
Tag.zhCN: “注意看好，并不是把匕首飞快地挥来挥去就行了，比那要复杂得多。”——潜行者训练师，肖

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy a minion with 3_or less Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个攻击力小于或等于3的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: A step up from a spell cast by many beginning acolytes: "Shadow Word: Annoy".
Tag.zhCN: 许多侍僧学徒都会施放：“暗言术：怒”，这个法术是它的进阶法术。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a minion is healed, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个随从获得治疗时，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They help the downtrodden and distressed. Also they sell cookies.
Tag.zhCN: 她们帮助被压迫和沮丧的人们。她们也卖饼干。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从的生命值翻倍。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Double the trouble. Double the fun!
Tag.zhCN: 加倍的付出会得到加倍的收获！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you summon a Beast, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你召唤一个野兽，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you feed him, he loses his whole identity.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你喂饱了它，它就名不副实了。

Tag.name: CARDNAME
Tag.enUS: Fast Spawn to Deck Dummy FX
Tag.zhCN: Fast Spawn to Deck Dummy FX

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Holds the FX for inserting a card into a deck quickly.
Tag.zhCN: Holds the FX for inserting a card into a deck quickly.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Holds the FX for playing Timewarp FX.
Tag.zhCN: Holds the FX for playing Timewarp FX.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Holds the FX for playing Frost Nova FX.
Tag.zhCN: Holds the FX for playing Frost Nova FX.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Holds the FX for playing Holy Healing FX.
Tag.zhCN: Holds the FX for playing Holy Healing FX.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Holds the FX for playing Flamestrike FX.
Tag.zhCN: Holds the FX for playing Flamestrike FX.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $5 damage to all characters except Ysera.
Tag.zhCN: 对除了伊瑟拉之外的所有角色造成$5点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Return a minion to its owner's hand.
Tag.zhCN: 将一个随从移回其拥有者的 手牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give a minion +5/+5. At the start of your next turn, destroy it.
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从获得+5/+5，在你的下个回合开始时，消灭该随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Has +5/+5, but will be destroyed soon.
Tag.zhCN: 拥有+5/+5，但它马上会被消灭。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Restore #2 Health to all friendly characters.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：为所有友方角色恢复#2点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Healing is just something she does in her free time. It's more of a hobby really.
Tag.zhCN: 她只是在闲暇时间做一些治疗工作。这其实只不过是一个业余爱好罢了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使一个友方野兽获得+2/+2和嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Who let the dogs out?" he asks. It's rhetorical.
Tag.zhCN: “是谁把狗放出来的？”他问。其实，这只是他的口头禅。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个野兽获得+2/+2和嘲讽。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的其他野兽拥有+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Other beasts totally dig hanging out with timber wolves.
Tag.zhCN: 其他野兽最喜欢和森林狼一起外出打猎了。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Tundra rhinos are often mistaken for kodos. Or am I mistaken?
Tag.zhCN: 人们经常无法分清苔原犀牛和科多兽。这是一头苔原犀牛，对不对？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $3 damage to two random enemy minions.
Tag.zhCN: 随机对两个敌方随从造成$3点 伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 看见没，我完全可以“一心两用”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw one and discard the others.
Tag.zhCN: 检视你的牌库顶的三张牌，抽其中一张，弃掉其余牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: For the person who just cannot decide what card to put into a deck!
Tag.zhCN: 为了那些不知道该把什么牌放入套牌的人准备的！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Magi conjured arcane arrows to sell to hunters, until hunters learned just enough magic to do it themselves. The resulting loss of jobs sent Stormwind into a minor recession.
Tag.zhCN: 法师们用奥术强化箭矢，然后出售给猎人；后来猎人们自己学会了足够的魔法之后便能够自给自足。不少法师因此失业，给暴风城的经济带来不小的冲击。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的英雄在攻击时免疫。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The longbow allows shots to be fired from farther away and is useful for firing on particularly odorous targets.
Tag.zhCN: 弓弦很长，这使得射手能够射得更远，对付那些难闻的目标尤其有效。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $5 damage to the enemy hero.
Tag.zhCN: 对敌方英雄造成$5点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This spell blasts you directly in the MIND.
Tag.zhCN: 这个法术直接震爆你的心灵。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a character is healed, gain +2 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个角色获得治疗，便获得 +2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She’s smaller than her sisters Mediumwarden and Heavywarden.
Tag.zhCN: 她善于从别人的希望之中获取力量。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：消灭一个具有嘲讽的敌方随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He was sent by the Lich King to disrupt the Argent Tournament. We can pretty much mark that a failure.
Tag.zhCN: 巫妖王派他来阻止银色锦标赛的进行。可以说那是个失败。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个具有嘲讽的随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, give another random friendly minion +1 Health.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，随机使另一个友方随从获得+1生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She can't wait to learn Power Word: Fortitude Rank 2.
Tag.zhCN: 她已经等不及想要学习2级的真言术：韧了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Destroy a minion with 7 or more Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 消灭一个攻击力大于或等于7的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Mere devilsaurs no longer excite him. Soon he'll be trying to catch Onyxia with only a dull Krol Blade.
Tag.zhCN: 魔暴龙之类的猎物已经让他提不起兴趣了。很快，他就会提着一把生锈的“科罗尔之刃”去猎杀奥妮克希亚了。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy a minion with an Attack of 7 or more.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个攻击力大于或等于7的随从。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]At the start of your turn, swap this minion with a random one in your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合开始时，随机将你的手牌中的一张随从牌与本随从 交换。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever this minion takes damage, draw a_card.
Tag.zhCN: 每当本随从受到伤害，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He trained when he was younger to be an acolyte of joy, but things didn’t work out like he thought they would.
Tag.zhCN: 在他年轻的时候，他经受的是“快乐侍僧”的训练，但是训练成果并不如他想象的那么好。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I solemnly swear to uphold the Light, purge the world of darkness, and to eat only burritos." - The Argent Dawn Oath
Tag.zhCN: “在此我严正宣誓：追随圣光，净化黑暗，只吃煎饼。”——银色黎明之誓

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: There is no beast more frightening (or ridiculous) than a fully enraged chicken.
Tag.zhCN: 没有什么野兽比一只彻底发疯的小鸡更加吓人（或者更加可笑）的了。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you want to stop a worgen from infiltrating, just yell, "No! Bad boy!"
Tag.zhCN: 他们原本都是人类，他们更知道怎样悄无声息地进入某些人类的居所中。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Voodoo is an oft-misunderstood art. But it is art.
Tag.zhCN: 别以为带上大坏蛋面具，再把两根筷子插在嘴里，你就是巫医了，伙计。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's in charge of the Annual Scarlet Monastery Blood Drive!
Tag.zhCN: 他负责每年一度的血色修道院献血运动！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使你的对手获得两根香蕉。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: King Mukla wanders Jaguero Isle, searching for love.
Tag.zhCN: 穆克拉在哈圭罗岛上徘徊，寻找他的真爱。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Half of this class will not graduate… since they'll have been turned to chickens." - Tinkmaster Overspark, teaching Gizmos 101.
Tag.zhCN: “班里的一半学生无法毕业...因为他们会被变成小鸡。”——工匠大师欧沃斯巴克，授课于齿轮101班

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Take control of a random enemy minion.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：随机夺取一个敌方随从的控制权。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Sylvanas was turned into the Banshee Queen by Arthas, but he probably should have just killed her because it just pissed her off.
Tag.zhCN: 没有人比女王更渴望真正地死去。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Stranglethorn is a beautiful place to visit, but you wouldn't want to live there.
Tag.zhCN: 荆棘谷是一个很适合观光的地方，但你绝对不会想住在那儿。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They always have a spare flask of Sunwell Energy Drink™!
Tag.zhCN: 他们会随身带着一瓶太阳井能量饮料！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Never wash your whites with a Scarlet Crusader.
Tag.zhCN: 他们的狂热使衣衫上的猩红色更加刺眼。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's stationed in the Hellfire Peninsula, but he's hoping for a reassignment closer to Orgrimmar, or really anywhere the ground is less on fire.
Tag.zhCN: 他受命驻扎在地狱火半岛，但他很希望能够被调配到奥格瑞玛附近，或者随便什么地方，只要那里的土地不要老是着火就行。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The first time they tried to guard Silvermoon against the scourge, it didn’t go so well…
Tag.zhCN: 当他们首次试图在天灾军团的围攻下守住银月城时，事情进行得并不顺利...

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She is still working on installing the rocket launcher add-on for Mr. Bitey.
Tag.zhCN: 她依然在想办法为咬咬先生装上火箭发射器。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The wonderful thing about tigers is tigers are wonderful things!
Tag.zhCN: 这些美丽的大猫是荆棘谷一道亮丽的风景！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：对敌方英雄造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He really just wants to be your friend, but the constant rejection is starting to really get to him.
Tag.zhCN: 他真的很想和你做朋友，但由于总是被排斥，他开始变得很沮丧。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She doesn’t ACTUALLY walk on the Sun. It's just a name. Don’t worry!
Tag.zhCN: 她不是真的能够在太阳上行走。这只是个名称，别担心！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 棘齿城酒馆里的人们纷纷表示，这张牌太强了，应该是传说级别的。

Tag.zhCN: 只有德鲁伊们称之为“自然印记”。其他人都喜欢说“加个状态”。

Tag.zhCN: 使你的所有随从获得“亡语：召唤一个2/2的树人”。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Druids take nourishment from many things: the power of nature, the songbird's chirp, a chocolate cake.
Tag.zhCN: 德鲁伊能够从很多地方获得精神上的滋养：自然的伟力；鸟儿的鸣唱；蛋糕的美味。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：冲锋；或者获得+2生命值并具有嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Cat or Bear? Cat or Bear?! I just cannot CHOOSE!
Tag.zhCN: 是猎豹还是熊？！是猎豹还是熊？！真是艰难的抉择！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：造成2点伤害；或者沉默一个随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: These guys just show up and start Keeping your Groves without even asking.
Tag.zhCN: 这些家伙不知道从哪儿冒出来，然后就自说自话地开始守护你的丛林了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Gain 2 Mana Crystals this turn only.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，获得两个 法力水晶。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Some druids still have flashbacks from strangers yelling "Innervate me!!" at them.
Tag.zhCN: 有些德鲁伊做梦时都回响着陌生人的喊叫声：“给我个激活！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy any minion damaged by this minion.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭任何受到本随从伤害的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Sholazar Basin is home to a lot of really horrible things. If you're going to visit, wear bug spray. And plate armor.
Tag.zhCN: 索拉查盆地栖息着很多非常恐怖的生物。如果你一定要去那里，带上杀虫剂，还要穿上板甲。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Balance is important to druids. This card is perfectly balanced.
Tag.zhCN: 平衡对德鲁伊来说很重要。这张卡牌现在就很平衡了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 抉择： +5攻击力；或者+5生命值并具有嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Young Night Elves love to play "Who can get the Ancient of War to Uproot?" You lose if you get crushed to death.
Tag.zhCN: 年轻的暗夜精灵们喜欢一种叫做“谁能让战争古树站起来”的游戏。如果在它起身的时候你被踩死了，你还是输了。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Lightning Bolt! Lightning Bolt! Lightning Bolt!

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It's like an ocean of liquid magma in your mouth!
Tag.zhCN: 就像火焰领主吐了一口口水，呃，火。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Westfall is full of dust devils. And buzzards. And crazed golems. And pirates. Why does anyone live here?
Tag.zhCN: 西部荒野满是尘魔。还有秃鹰。还有失控的傀儡。还有海盗。为什么谁都喜欢住在这地方？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使你的图腾获得+2生命值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Silence a minion, then deal $1 damage to it.
Tag.zhCN: 沉默一个随从，然后对其造成$1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Earth Shock? Shouldn't it be "Azeroth Shock"?
Tag.zhCN: 大地震击？确切地说，就是“艾泽拉斯震击”吗？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Transform a minion into a 0/1 Frog with Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从变形成为一只0/1并具有嘲讽的青蛙。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you Hex a Murloc... it really isn't much of a change, is it?
Tag.zhCN: 如果你对一个鱼人使用妖术...其实结果也没什么变化，对不对？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 召唤两只2/3并具有嘲讽的幽灵狼。过载：（2）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Spirit wolves are like regular wolves with pom-poms.
Tag.zhCN: 幽灵狼只是普通的狼而已，它们擅长发出吓人的寒光。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, deal 2 damage to ALL other characters.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，对所有其他角色造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Baron Geddon was Ragnaros's foremost lieutenant, until he got FIRED.
Tag.zhCN: 迦顿男爵曾经是拉格纳罗斯的首席副官，因为他实在太“火”了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 随机对两个敌方随从造成$2点伤害，过载：（2）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you combine it with Spooned Lightning and Knived Lightning, you have the full dining set.
Tag.zhCN: 配上勺状闪电和刀状闪电，你就集齐整套闪电餐具了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you play a card_with Overload, gain_+1/+1.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你使用一张具有过载的牌，便获得+1/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Unlike bound elementals, Unbound ones really enjoy a night on the town.
Tag.zhCN: 无拘无束的它喜欢在灯红酒绿的城里度过每个夜晚。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2-$3 damage to all enemy minions. Overload: (2)
Tag.zhCN: 对所有敌方随从造成$2到$3点伤害，过载：（2）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: An umbrella won't be effective, I'm afraid.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you control a Secret at_the end of your turn, gain +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，如果你控制着奥秘，获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The ethereals are wrapped in cloth to give form to their non-corporeal bodies. Also because it's nice and soft.
Tag.zhCN: 虚灵们浑身捆绑着布条，不仅是因为布料柔软舒适，更是为了让他们的外表更能为其他种族接受。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Freeze a minion and the minions next to it, and deal $1 damage to them.
Tag.zhCN: 冻结一个随从和其相邻的随从，并对它们造成$1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Magi of the Kirin Tor were casting Cubes of Cold for many years before Cones came into fashion some 90 years ago.
Tag.zhCN: 冰锥术在大约90年前开始流行起来，而在那之前，肯瑞托的法师们习惯用的是冰块术。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $3 damage randomly split among all enemy characters.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$3点伤害，随机分配到所有敌方角色身上。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You'd think you'd be able to control your missiles a little better since you're a powerful mage and all.
Tag.zhCN: 既然你想要做一个超级厉害的法师，就必须得把奥术飞弹控制得好一些。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 毒如鹤顶，刃若清刚；图穷匕现，君命难长。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Take the time for an evil laugh after you draw this card.
Tag.zhCN: 抽到这张牌的时候，发出一阵邪恶的狂笑吧。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: When a Water elemental and an Ice elemental love each other VERY much...
Tag.zhCN: 当水元素和冰元素相爱到一定程度的时候...

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: They initially planned to be the Beryl or Cerulean drakes, but those felt a tad too pretentious.
Tag.zhCN: 它们本来应该是宝蓝色或是蔚蓝色，但这几个颜色显得有点太耀眼了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When your opponent casts a spell, Counter it.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当你的对手施放一个法术时，反制该法术。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What's the difference between a mage playing with Counterspell and a mage who isn't? The mage who isn't is getting Pyroblasted in the face.
Tag.zhCN: 一个会法术反制的法师和一个不会法术反制的法师之间有什么区别？那个不会的法师被炎爆术炸了一脸。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Secret: As soon as your hero is attacked, gain 8 Armor.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当你的英雄受到攻击时，获得8点护甲值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This is Rank 1. Rank 2 is Chocolate Milk Barrier.
Tag.zhCN: 这只是这个技能的第一级，第二级会是...巧克力牛奶护体。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Secret: When your opponent plays a minion, summon a copy of it.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当你的对手使用一张随从牌时，召唤一个该随从的复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "You go first." - Krush'gor the Behemoth, to his pet boar.
Tag.zhCN: “你先上。”——“巨兽”克鲁什格尔对他的宠物野猪说道。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When your hero takes fatal damage, prevent it and become Immune this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当你的英雄将要承受致命伤害时，防止这些伤害，并使其在本回合中免疫。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Ice is nice, and will suffice!
Tag.zhCN: 法师们都很奇怪，为什么把一样东西塞进冰箱需要三个步骤？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Can't attack. At the end of your turn, deal 8 damage to a random enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 无法攻击。在你的回合结束时，随机对一个敌人造成8点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Ragnaros was summoned by the Dark Iron dwarves, who were eventually enslaved by the Firelord. Summoning Ragnaros often doesn’t work out the way you want it to.
Tag.zhCN: 拉格纳罗斯是由黑铁矮人召唤出来的，而这些矮人最终也成为了炎魔之王的奴隶。所以召唤拉格纳罗斯往往得不到你想要的结果。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Taunt Battlecry: Destroy one of your Mana Crystals.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽，战吼：摧毁你的一个法力水晶。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Yes, he'll fight for you. BUT HE'S NOT GOING TO LIKE IT.
Tag.zhCN: 没错，他会为你而战，但并非心甘情愿。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $1 damage to a minion. If it dies, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$1点伤害。如果该随从死亡，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If your spells look like horrifying skulls, let's be honest, you should get to draw some cards.
Tag.zhCN: 很久以前，术士们发现只要在普通的法术中加入一点令人作呕的颜色，就能在伤害敌人的同时使其恐惧。真是一举两得。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy a friendly minion and deal its Attack damage to all enemy minions.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个友方随从，对所有敌方随从造成等同于其攻击力的伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Start with a powerful minion and stir in Shadowflame and you have a good time!
Tag.zhCN: 始于一个强大的随从，终于一场华丽的浩劫。多么有趣！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Destroy both adjacent minions and gain their Attack and Health.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：消灭两侧相邻的随从，并获得他们的攻击力和生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you put this into your deck, you WILL lose the trust of your other minions.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你把这张牌放到你的套牌中，你就会失去其他随从对你的信任。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This puppy chews up cards instead of shoes.
Tag.zhCN: 这个小家伙不咬鞋改咬卡牌了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 造成$4点伤害，随机弃一 张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Are you lighting a soul on fire? Or burning someone with your OWN soul? This seems like an important distinction.
Tag.zhCN: 是把别人的灵魂点燃？还是用自己的灵魂把别人点燃？这似乎是有很大区别的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy a minion. Restore #3 Health to_your hero.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个随从，为你的英雄恢复#3点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You probably should avoid siphoning your own soul. You might create some kind of weird infinite loop.
Tag.zhCN: 你最好避免虹吸自己的灵魂，这样会造成一些很奇怪的死循环。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summoning a doomguard is risky. Someone is going to die.
Tag.zhCN: 召唤末日守卫有很大的风险。总得有人付出生命的代价。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Twisting Nether is a formless place of magic and illusion and destroyed minions.
Tag.zhCN: 扭曲虚空浩渺无际，充满着魔法、幻象和被放逐的生命体。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：对你的英雄造成5点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Mannoroth, Magtheridon, and Brutallus may be dead, but it turns out there are a LOT of pit lords.
Tag.zhCN: 或许玛诺洛斯、玛瑟里顿和布鲁塔卢斯都已经死了，但其实深渊领主还有很多很多。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your minions cost (2) less, but not less than (1).
Tag.zhCN: 你的随从牌的法力值消耗减少（2）点，但不能少于（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: NOT LESS THAN 1! Don't get any ideas!
Tag.zhCN: 不能少于1点！你在想什么坏主意呢！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give a friendly minion +4/+4 until end of turn. Then, it dies. Horribly.
Tag.zhCN: 使一个友方随从获得+4/+4，该随从会在回合结束时死亡。死得很惨。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: We cannot even describe how horrible the death is. It's CRAZY bad! Maybe worse than that. Just don't do it.
Tag.zhCN: 别让那个随从知道他死后的样子。那惨象无可言状。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 从你的牌库中抽两张恶魔牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Generally demons are pretty obvious and you don’t need a spell to sense them.
Tag.zhCN: 一般说来，恶魔总是比较容易辨认的，不需要用一个法术来感知它们。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：对你的英雄造成3点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Imps like being on fire. They just do.
Tag.zhCN: 小鬼们喜欢引火上身。它们就是喜欢。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $3 damage to a character. If it dies, summon a random Demon.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个角色造成$3点伤害。如果该角色死亡，随机召唤一个恶魔。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: My advice to you is to avoid Doom, if possible.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Destroy your hero and replace it with Lord Jaraxxus.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：消灭你的英雄，并用加拉克苏斯大王替换之。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "TRIFLING GNOME! YOUR ARROGANCE WILL BE YOUR UNDOING!!!!"
Tag.zhCN: “渺小的侏儒！你的傲慢会招致灭亡！”

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Reserved for enemy spellcasters, evil liches from beyond the grave, and karaoke nights at the Grim Guzzler.
Tag.zhCN: 专为施法者设计。施法者包括从墓地里钻出来的邪恶巫妖，也包括在黑铁酒吧里唱卡拉OK的麦霸。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Gain control of an enemy minion with 3 or less Attack until end of turn.
Tag.zhCN: 直到回合结束，获得一个攻击力小于或等于3的敌方随从的控制权。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You can rationalize it all you want, it's still a mean thing to do.
Tag.zhCN: 随你如何让它恢复理智，这个过程本身仍是件卑劣的事。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: This minion's Attack is always equal to its Health.
Tag.zhCN: 本随从的攻击力始终等同于其生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Spawn of the Light? Or Pawn of the Lights?
Tag.zhCN: 光耀孕育之子嗣，吾等子嗣之光耀。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Copy 2 cards in your opponent's deck and add them to your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 复制你对手的牌库中的两张牌，并将其置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "What do you get when you cast Thoughtsteal on an Orc? Nothing!" - Tauren joke
Tag.zhCN: “人类喜欢说‘对牛弹琴’来形容白费功夫，哼，我们喜欢说‘对兽人使用思维窃取’！”——牛头人长者

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the start of your turn, restore #3 Health to a damaged friendly character.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合开始时，随机为一个受伤的 友方角色恢复#3点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It isn't clear if people ignore the Lightwell, or if it is just invisible.
Tag.zhCN: 以前有很多牧师都不明白，究竟是因为队友看不见光明之泉呢，还是他们故意不想点它呢？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Put a copy of a random minion from your opponent's deck into the battlefield.
Tag.zhCN: 随机将你对手的牌库中的一张随从牌的复制置入战场。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Sometimes it feels like this is all a game.
Tag.zhCN: 有时候你会觉得，一切不过是场游戏。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Mindgames whiffed! Your opponent had no minions!
Tag.zhCN: 控心术无效！你对手的牌库中没有 随从牌了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Draw cards until you have as many in hand as your opponent.
Tag.zhCN: 抽若干数量的牌，直到你的手牌数量等同于你对手的手牌数量。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This is not just a favor, but a divine one, like helping someone move a couch with a fold out bed!
Tag.zhCN: 这可是神的恩赐，就好像有人在关键时刻向你伸出援手。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Double the damage and healing of your spells and Hero Power.
Tag.zhCN: 使你的法术和英雄技能的伤害和治疗效果翻倍。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's been exiled from his home, and all his brothers turned evil, but otherwise he doesn't have a lot to complain about.
Tag.zhCN: 他被逐出了他的家园，他的兄弟们都变成了邪恶的主宰......但是除此之外，他好像也没有什么别的可以抱怨的了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 恢复#8点生命值，抽三张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 抓住最后一根救命稻草。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从的攻击力翻倍。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This card causes double the trouble AND double the fun.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使一个随从的攻击力变为1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This card makes something really damp. Oh wait. That's "Humidity."
Tag.zhCN: 这张牌真是会让人的心情很糟糕，就像潮湿阴冷的天气。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使一个其他友方随从获得圣盾。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I'm not saying you can dodge fireballs. I'm saying with this shield, you won't have to."
Tag.zhCN: “我没说你能够躲过火球。我是说有了这盾，你就不需要躲了。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Choose a minion. Whenever it attacks, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 选择一个随从，每当其进行攻击，便抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Apparently with wisdom comes the knowledge that you should probably be attacking every turn.
Tag.zhCN: 显然是智慧让他认清了这样一条真理：作为一个随从，每回合都要攻击才能体现其价值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Draw a card and deal_damage equal to_its Cost.
Tag.zhCN: 抽一张牌，并造成等同于其法力值消耗的伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: After you summon a minion, give it +1/+1 and this loses 1_Durability.
Tag.zhCN: 在你召唤一个随从后，使其获得+1/+1，这把武器失去1点耐久度。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I dub you Sir Loin of Beef!

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This spell has been renamed so many times, even paladins don’t know what it should be called anymore.
Tag.zhCN: 这个法术的名字已经被修改了太多次，导致连圣骑士们都不知道它应该叫什么了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, reduce its Health to 1.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘： 在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，使该随从的生命值降为1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Repentance often comes in the moment before obliteration. Curious.
Tag.zhCN: 忏悔总会在湮灭前一刻到来。多么奥妙。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使一个敌方随从的攻击力变为1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Aldor hate two things: the Scryers and smooth jazz.
Tag.zhCN: 奥尔多痛恨两样东西：占星者和湿鳞蜥蜴的眼睛。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 圣盾，嘲讽，亡语：装备一把5/3的 灰烬使者。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you haven't heard the Tirion Fordring theme song, it's because it doesn't exist.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你还没听过《提里奥·弗丁主题曲》，那是因为它还没被谱写出来。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $8 damage randomly split among all enemy characters.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$8点伤害，随机分配到所有敌方角色身上。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Wham! Wham! Wham! Wham! Wham! Wham! Wham! Wham!

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Tauren Warrior: Champion of Mulgore, Slayer of Quilboar, Rider of Thunderbluff Elevators.
Tag.zhCN: 牛头人战士：莫高雷勇士，野猪人杀手，雷霆崖电梯发明者。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $2 damage to a minion. If it survives, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$2点伤害，如果 它依然存活，则抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Dun da dun, dun da dun": if you've heard an ogre sing this, it's too late.
Tag.zhCN: “咚次哒次，咚次哒次”：如果你听到食人魔这样的“歌声”，那已经太晚了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Draw a card for each damaged friendly character.
Tag.zhCN: 每有一个受伤的友方角色，便抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "You won't like me when I'm angry."

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If an Amani berserker asks "Joo lookin' at me?!", the correct response is "Nah, mon".
Tag.zhCN: 如果阿曼尼狂战士问你：“你刚才看着我？！”正确的答案应该是：“没有，伙计。”

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: All these guys ever do is talk about the Thunder King. BOOOORRRINNG!
Tag.zhCN: 这些家伙们每天做的就是谈论雷神。真无聊！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: 50% off fist weapons, limited time only!
Tag.zhCN: 拳套武器限时特惠，第二把半价！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever this minion takes damage, gain +3_Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 每当本随从受到伤害，获得+3攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 如果那些伤痛没能让你死掉，它们就会让你更强大。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 对所有随从造成$1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The way to tell seasoned warriors from novice ones: the novices yell "wheeeee" while whirlwinding.
Tag.zhCN: 分辨资深战士和新手战士的最好办法：新手在用旋风斩时会喊“哇哇哇”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a friendly minion_takes damage, gain 1 Armor.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个友方随从受到伤害，便获得1点护甲值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: She accepts guild funds for repairs!

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Have you seen the size of the shields in this game?? This is no easy job.
Tag.zhCN: 你知道这个游戏里的盾牌都有多大吗？那可绝对不是轻松的差事。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy all minions except one. (chosen randomly)
Tag.zhCN: 随机选择一个随从，消灭除了该随从外的所有其他随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Do you know the first rule of Brawl Club?
Tag.zhCN: 你知道搏击俱乐部的第一守则吗？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $4 damage. If you have 12 or less Health, deal $6 instead.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$4点伤害；如果你的生命值小于或等于12点，则改为造成$6点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "If you only use one ability, use Mortal Strike." - The Warrior Code, Line 6
Tag.zhCN: “如果你只有一个技能可以用，就用致死打击。”——《战士信条》，第6行

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you have a weapon, give it +1/+1. Otherwise equip a 1/3 weapon.
Tag.zhCN: 如果你装备着武器，使其获得+1/+1。否则装备一把1/3的武器。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal 1 damage to a minion for each Armor you have.
Tag.zhCN: 你每有1点护甲值，便对一个随从造成1点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "What is a better weapon? The sharp one your enemies expect, or the blunt one they ignore?" - The Art of Warrior, Chapter 9
Tag.zhCN: “什么是更好的武器？是敌人预料之中的利斧，还是敌人意想不到的钝刀？”——《战士的艺术》，第9章

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Attacking a minion costs 1 Attack instead of 1 Durability.
Tag.zhCN: 攻击随从不会消耗耐久度，改为降低1点攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Grommash Hellscream's famous axe. Somehow this ended up in Prince Malchezaar's possession. Quite the mystery!
Tag.zhCN: 格罗玛什·地狱咆哮的著名战斧。然而它却在玛克扎尔王子的手中。这是怎么回事！

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If he's raging now, just wait until he gets nerfed.
Tag.zhCN: 如果他现在还是很愤怒，那就等到他平静下来。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Grommash drank the tainted blood of Mannoroth, dooming the orcs to green skin and red eyes! Maybe not his best decision.
Tag.zhCN: 灰谷南方，来自地狱的咆哮还在回响。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Do Murlocs ever get tired of making the same old sound? Nope! Mrglglrglglglglglglgl!
Tag.zhCN: 鱼人们老是发出一样的声音，难道不觉得厌烦吗？不！姆格拉咕嗯噜咕噜咕噜咕噜咕噜！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 所有其他鱼人拥有+1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: These are the brainy murlocs. It turns out that doesn’t mean much.
Tag.zhCN: 这些算是有头脑的鱼人。但仍然有些名不副实。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a Murloc is summoned, gain +1 Attack.
Tag.zhCN: 每当有玩家召唤一个鱼人，便获得 +1攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This guy gets crazy strong at family reunions.
Tag.zhCN: 每当他和他的家人团聚时，这个家伙会变得特别厉害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Stealth. Destroy any minion damaged by this minion.
Tag.zhCN: 潜行。消灭任何受到本随从伤害的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He’s not really that patient. It just takes a while for someone to walk by that he can actually reach.
Tag.zhCN: 其实他的耐性并不好。只是等待他的目标靠近需要花点时间。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a friendly Beast dies, gain +2/+1.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个友方野兽死亡，便获得+2/+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Hyenas prefer the bones of kodos or windserpents, but they'll eat pretty much anything. Even Brussels sprouts.
Tag.zhCN: 土狼偏爱科多兽和风蛇的骨头，但是其实他们什么都吃。甚至是抱子甘蓝。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When an enemy attacks your hero, instead it attacks another random character.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当一个敌人攻击你的英雄时，改为该敌人随机攻击另一个角色。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Sometimes it's as simple as putting on a fake mustache and pointing at someone else.
Tag.zhCN: 再狡猾的狐狸……也会被猎人误导。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: In the jungle, the mighty jungle, the lion gets slowly consumed by hyenas.
Tag.zhCN: 在偌大丛林的生存游戏中，即使是狮子也会被成群的土狼拖垮。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever a Secret is revealed, gain +1 Durability.
Tag.zhCN: 每当一个奥秘被揭示时，便获得+1耐久度。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: First Lesson: Put the pointy end in the other guy.
Tag.zhCN: 第一课：把尖的那头对准别人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $5 damage to a minion and $2 damage to adjacent ones.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$5点伤害，并对其相邻的随从造成 $2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Pull the pin, count to 5, then shoot. Then duck.
Tag.zhCN: 拉动保险销，数到5，再开火。然后躲起来。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: For each enemy minion, summon a 1/1 Hound with Charge.
Tag.zhCN: 战场上每有一个敌方随从，便召唤一个 1/1并具有冲锋的猎犬。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You must read the name of this card out loud each time you play it.
Tag.zhCN: 在你使用这张牌的时候，一定要喊出它的名字。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $3 damage. If you control a Beast, deal $5 damage instead.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$3点伤害。如果你控制一个野兽，则改为造成 $5点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The best defense against King Krush is to have someone you don’t like standing in front of you.
Tag.zhCN: 对付暴龙王克鲁什最好的办法就是让某个你讨厌的人站在你前面。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: All minions lose Stealth. Destroy all enemy Secrets. Draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 所有随从失去潜行，摧毁所有敌方奥秘，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Not only does it reveal your enemies, but it's also great for parties!
Tag.zhCN: 它不但能让你的敌人无处遁形，还能让整个晚会熠熠生辉！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give a Beast +2 Attack and Immune this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，使一个野兽获得+2攻击力和免疫。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The seething wrath is just beneath the surface. Beneath that is wild abandon, followed by slight annoyance.
Tag.zhCN: 盛燃的愤怒掩藏于表面之下，同时还伴随着野性的狂放不羁和些许傲慢。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Secret: When one of your minions is attacked, summon three 1/1 Snakes.
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当你的随从受到攻击时，召唤三条1/1的蛇。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Why did it have to be snakes?

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：召唤一个2/1的损坏的傀儡。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Overheat threshold exceeded. System failure. Wheat clog in port two. Shutting down."
Tag.zhCN: “温度过高。系统失灵。二号仓粮食堵塞。正在关闭。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the start of your turn, you have a 50% chance to draw an extra card.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合开始时，你有50%的几率额外抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Nat Pagle, Azeroth's premier fisherman! He invented the Auto-Angler 3000, the Extendo-Pole 3000, and the Lure-o-matic 2099 (still in testing).
Tag.zhCN: 纳特·帕格是艾泽拉斯最棒的钓手！他发明了自动鱼竿3000型，伸缩鱼竿3000型，以及电气自动诱捕器2099型（仍在测试中）。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Destroy your opponent's weapon and draw cards equal to its Durability.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：摧毁对手的武器，并抽数量等同于其耐久度的牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: “That belongs in the Hall of Explorers!”
Tag.zhCN: “这东西应该陈列在探险者大厅里！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Whenever you cast a spell, add a 'Fireball' spell to_your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 每当你施放一个法术，将一张“火球术”法术牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Antonidas was the Grand Magus of the Kirin Tor, and Jaina's mentor. This was a big step up from being Grand Magus of Jelly Donuts.
Tag.zhCN: 肯瑞托的首席法师，达拉然最伟大的子民，安东尼达斯在被巫妖王阿尔萨斯杀死之前，曾是吉安娜的导师。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Players only have 15 seconds to take their_turns.
Tag.zhCN: 玩家只有15秒的时间来进行他们的回合。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Time to write some flavor text.
Tag.zhCN: 没时间写什么卡牌趣文了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Set a hero's remaining Health to 15.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼： 将一方英雄的剩余生命值变为15。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Alexstrasza the Life-Binder brings life and hope to everyone. Except Deathwing. And Malygos. And Nekros.
Tag.zhCN: 生命的缚誓者阿莱克丝塔萨给所有人带来生命和希望。除了死亡之翼。除了玛里苟斯。除了耐克鲁斯。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Summon 1/1 Whelps until your side of the battlefield is full.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：召唤数条1/1的雏龙，直到你的随从数量达到上限。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Onyxia long manipulated the Stormwind Court by disguising herself as Lady Katrana Prestor. You would have thought that the giant wings and scales would have been a giveaway.
Tag.zhCN: 伪装成女伯爵卡特拉娜·普瑞斯托，奥妮克希亚长期控制着暴风城议会。你可能会想，一定是她的大翅膀和鳞片让她漏出了马脚。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Malygos hates it when mortals use magic. He gets so mad!
Tag.zhCN: 玛里苟斯憎恨凡人使用魔法。那会让他气急败坏！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Choose a minion and become a copy of it.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：选择一个随从，成为它的复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Faceless Ones are servants of Yogg-Saron, and they feed on fear. Right now they are feeding on your fear of accidentally disenchanting all your good cards.
Tag.zhCN: 作为尤格-萨隆的仆从，无面者们以人们的恐惧为食，而现在他们的菜谱中包括你对“不小心把好牌分解掉”的担心和忧虑。

Tag.name: TARGETING_ARROW_TEXT
Tag.enUS: Become a copy of a minion.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 相邻的随从拥有+2攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Totemsmiths like to use the rarest woods for their totems. There are even rumors of totems made of Ironbark Protectors.
Tag.zhCN: 图腾制造师喜欢用最稀有的木材来打造图腾。甚至有传言说，这些图腾是由埃隆巴克保护者身上的树皮做的。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Orgrim Doomhammer gave this legendary weapon to Thrall. His name is a total coincidence.
Tag.zhCN: 奥格瑞姆·毁灭之锤将他的传奇武器赠与了萨尔。他的名字只是纯属巧合。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Give your hero +4_Attack this turn. Gain 4 Armor.
Tag.zhCN: 使你的英雄获得4点护甲值，并在本回合中获得 +4攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 一般说来，你不把嘴里的肉嚼完，是不舍得变回人形态的。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Summon three 2/2 Treants with Charge that die at the end of the turn.
Tag.zhCN: 召唤三个2/2并具有冲锋的树人，在回合结束时，消灭这些树人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I think I'll just nap under these trees. Wait... AAAAAHHH!" - Blinkfizz, the Unfortunate Gnome
Tag.zhCN: “我想我可以在这片树荫下打个盹儿。等等...啊啊啊啊啊！”——不幸的侏儒布林克菲兹

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, add_a Dream Card to_your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，将一张梦境牌置入你的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Ysera rules the Emerald Dream. Which is some kind of green-mirror-version of the real world, or something?
Tag.zhCN: 伊瑟拉统治翡翠梦境。所谓翡翠梦境，究竟只是现实世界的绿色朦胧倒影，还是其他别的什么地方？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Choose One - Give your other minions +2/+2; or Summon two 2/2 Treants with Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 抉择：使你的所有其他随从获得+2/+2；或者召唤两个2/2并具有嘲讽的树人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Yes, he's a demigod. No, he doesn't need to wear a shirt.
Tag.zhCN: “当它们还是种子的时候，我便认识它们了……”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 使你的所有其他随从获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 召唤两个2/2并具有嘲讽的树人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It is said that some shaman can say "Floatin' totem" 10 times, fast.
Tag.zhCN: 据说，有些萨满能够以很快的速度连着说十遍“疼痛的图腾”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deathrattle: Summon a 3/3 Pip Quickwit for your opponent.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语： 为你的对手召唤一个3/3的皮普·急智。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He lives in Blackrock Mountain. He eats Gnomes. That's pretty much it.
Tag.zhCN: 他住在黑石山。他吃侏儒。基本上就是这样。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal damage equal to your hero's Attack to a minion.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成等同于你的英雄攻击力的伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It is true that some druids are savage, but others still enjoy a quiet moment and a spot of tea.
Tag.zhCN: 确实有些德鲁伊野性十足，但仍有些喜欢在恬静的时刻品上一壶好茶。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Return an enemy minion to your opponent's hand.
Tag.zhCN: 将一个敌方随从移回你对手的手牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: “潜行者”的闷棍技术比“盗贼”好很多，他们不用天赋支持，就可以保证百分之百闷棍命中。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You don't see a lot of Dalaran warriors.
Tag.zhCN: 你肯定没见过达拉然战士。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：为你的英雄恢复#4点生命值。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If she threatens to "moon" you, it's not what you think.
Tag.zhCN: 她是艾泽拉斯最早的“月光族”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使相邻的随从获得法术伤害+1。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Sometimes he forgets and just wanders into someone else's game.
Tag.zhCN: 有时候他会很健忘，甚至迷迷糊糊地走进别人的游戏中去。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Costs (1) less for each other minion on the battlefield.
Tag.zhCN: 战场上每有一个其他随从，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：使一个友方随从获得风怒。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Is there anything worse than a Windspeaker with halitosis?
Tag.zhCN: 患有口臭的风语者...还有什么比这更糟糕的吗？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: All minions lose Divine Shield. Gain +3/+3 for each Shield lost.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：所有随从失去圣盾。每有一个随从失去圣盾，便获得+3/+3。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The Blood Knights get their holy powers from the Sunwell, which you should NOT bathe in.
Tag.zhCN: 血骑士从太阳井中获得他们的神圣能量，所以你别把那里当成是洗太阳浴的地方。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your cards and powers that restore Health now deal damage instead.
Tag.zhCN: 你的恢复生命值的牌和技能改为造成等量的伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 伟大的狙击手总是能够正中目标。就像吃下一整块猪肋排。嗯，味道好极了。

Tag.zhCN: 很遗憾，哈里森·琼斯没能加入到探险者协会，但他的探险帽却成了会员的标配。

Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，每当你施放一个法术，随机获取一张 猎人卡牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 雷克萨唤醒米莎，拿起墙角的机关枪，眯着眼睛说道：“子弹上膛！是时候找点乐子了！”

Tag.zhCN: 有酸喉这个老伙计在，就没有嚼不烂的骑士。

Tag.zhCN: 永恒龙军团的刺客等候时机，要在萨尔成为大酋长之前把他干掉。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 大部分时间都沉迷在了《暗黑破坏神IV》里。

Tag.zhCN: 达拉然的骑士身上也散发着魔法的气息。

Tag.zhCN: 这些法力浮龙以奥术能量为食。所以尽管这些捣蛋鬼不会成为真正的威胁，你也不应该让它们接近任何法术力源。

Tag.zhCN: 如果你实在找不到炸弹了，那就随便找一个地精发明的东西，然后把它扔出去……

Tag.zhCN: 尤格-萨隆总是在抱怨自己的仆从太多，每天起床一想到还有那么多张嘴等着它喂就头疼。

Tag.zhCN: 抽到时施放 随机摧毁你的手牌，牌库和战场上的各一张牌（TNT炸药除外）。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Rush. Costs (1) less for each minion that died this game. Deathrattle: Take control of a random enemy minion.
Tag.zhCN: 突袭。在本局对战中每有一个随从死亡，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。亡语：随机夺取一个敌方随从的控制权。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Overseer of the Bloodrock Mine, Reska will work you to the bone. They'll then reanimate your bones and work THOSE bones to the bone.
Tag.zhCN: 雷斯卡是血石矿井的工头。他会先把人累死，再把尸体复活，最后再把尸体累死。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Spend up to 8 Corpses to summon a random minion of that Cost.
Tag.zhCN: 消耗最多 8份残骸，随机召唤一个法力值消耗相同的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: It ain't much, but it's dishonest work.
Tag.zhCN: 产量虽不大，例例皆心苦。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Rush, Taunt Dormant for 6 turns. (Excavate to awaken 2 turns sooner!)
Tag.zhCN: 突袭。嘲讽。休眠6回合。（发掘即可提前2回合唤醒！）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You delved too greedily and too deep. You know what they awoke in the darkness of the Badlands: Rush and Taunt.
Tag.zhCN: 你太贪了，挖得太深了。你知道你在荒芜之地唤醒了什么吗？突袭和嘲讽。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: What doesn't kill ya makes you deader.
Tag.zhCN: 那些杀不死你的事物，只会让你死得更惨。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal $2 damage to an enemy minion and its neighbors. Quickdraw: To all enemies instead.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个敌方随从及其相邻随从造成$2点伤害。快枪：改为对所有敌人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This is the hottest summer of your life so far.
Tag.zhCN: 这是你人生中迄今为止最热的一个夏天。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $1 damage to a minion. If it dies, Excavate a treasure.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$1点伤害。如果该随从死亡，发掘一个 宝藏。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 别怕，这列车烧的是绿色能源！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Get a random Quickdraw card. If you play it this turn, repeat this.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：随机获取一张快枪牌。如果你在本回合使用获取的牌，重复此效果。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: You'll never guess why they call him that.
Tag.zhCN: 你肯定猜不到大家为什么要叫他这个名字。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: If played this turn, get another Quickdraw card.
Tag.zhCN: 如果在本回合使用，获取另一张快枪牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Destroy a damaged enemy minion. Excavate a treasure.
Tag.zhCN: 消灭一个受伤的敌方随从。发掘一个宝藏。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的爆系法术拥有+1攻击力。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Deal 4 damage to this minion. Overheal: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：对本随从造成4点伤害。过量治疗：对所有敌方随从造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: With how many cacti are all over the Badlands, this job has to be some sort of sick joke.
Tag.zhCN: 荒芜之地到处都是仙人掌，这份工作一定很伤人。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The hills are alive with the sound of YEEEEHAAAWWWW!

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: The next time you draw a spell, get a copy of it.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：你下一次抽到一张法术牌时，获取一张它的复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: He's here to tip the scales in our favor… and moisturize them too.
Tag.zhCN: 这位干鳞警官……就是我们镇上的甘霖！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: The next spell you draw gives you an extra copy.
Tag.zhCN: 你抽到下一张法术牌时使你获得一张额外复制。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Discover a spell from your deck. Quickdraw: Enemy deck instead.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：从你的牌库中发现一张法术牌。快枪：改为从敌方牌库。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "Oh no, you've got me confused. I'm Ben, the evil ent banker. I only work with evil trees!"
Tag.zhCN: “呵，你想多了，我们银行的名字叫‘和善’。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Taunt Costs (1) less for each 1-Cost card you've played this game.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。在本局对战中，你每使用过一张法力值消耗为（1）的牌，本牌的法力值消耗便减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Quick! Someone bring her a Manathirst card!
Tag.zhCN: 快！给她拿一张法力渴求牌！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: At the end of your turn, draw a card.
Tag.zhCN: 在你的回合结束时，抽一张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I don't know why everyone's got their overalls in a jumble with Azerite minin' when there's all this GOLD for the takin'!"
Tag.zhCN: “我不明白，为什么大家都去抢着挖艾泽里特，这里明明有这么多的金子！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, summon 5/5 copies of 4 random minions in your deck.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你的套牌里没有相同的牌，随机召唤你牌库中4个随从的5/5的复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: From the library to the field, she's proved herself to be a leading intellectual.
Tag.zhCN: 从图书馆到荒野，她证明了自己的领导才能。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $10 damage to an enemy minion. Save any excess in a 1-Cost Bottle.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个敌方随从造成$10点伤害。将超过目标生命值的伤害存入法力值消耗为（1）的瓶子。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 不要让阴影四处蔓延，快瓶蔽掉！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal the excess damage to an enemy minion.@Deal ${0} damage to an enemy minion.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个敌方随从造成余下的伤害。@对一个敌方随从造成${0}点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Copy each 1-Cost card in your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：复制你手牌中法力值消耗为 （1）的牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: One time, I was trying to get Pip's attention to warn her that the dangerous outlaw Cheery Ollie, who also goes by just 'O', was headed her way. "Pip! Pip! Cheery O!", I shouted.
Tag.zhCN: 有一次，我发现危险的坏蛋切瑞·欧列就在皮普的身边，可我最终只喊出了“皮普！皮普！欧——”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Restore #8 Health to a damaged character. Save any excess in a 1-Cost Bottle.
Tag.zhCN: 为一个受伤的角色恢复#8点生命值。将超过目标生命值上限的治疗量存入法力值消耗为（1）的瓶子。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Issa bah oh auh woh ah!

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 恢复余下的生命值。@恢复#{0}点生命值。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Taunt Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all minions except friendly Elementals.
Tag.zhCN: 嘲讽。亡语：对除友方元素外的所有随从造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: We were told that "Dag-Nabbin' Dang-Blastin' Rootin'-Tootin' High-Falutin' Elemental" was too long.
Tag.zhCN: “可恶之极坏到炸裂的元素”这个名字太长了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw that many cards.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：将你的手牌洗入牌库，然后抽取相同数量的牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: This girl is such a boss.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deathrattle: Both players DRAW! Destroy the card that costs less.
Tag.zhCN: 亡语：双方玩家抽牌！摧毁其中法力值消耗较低的牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "My ultimate is rea- ah, errr, I mean, I have enough Mana."
Tag.zhCN: “终极技能准备——呃，我是说，我的法力值够了。”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Roll two dice, then Discover two cards of those Costs. (Doubles get an extra Discover!)
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：投两枚骰子，然后 发现法力值消耗分别对应点数的两张牌。（投出对子可以额外发现一张！）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Hey, put ALL of your hands on the table!
Tag.zhCN: 嘿！说你呢，把你所有的手全都放在桌面上！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 发现一张 法力值消耗为（1）的卡牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 发现一张 法力值消耗为（2）的卡牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 发现一张 法力值消耗为（3）的卡牌。

Tag.zhCN: 发现一张 法力值消耗为（4）的卡牌。

Tag.zhCN: 发现一张 法力值消耗为（5）的卡牌。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, fire six 2 damage shots at minions in the enemy's hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你的套牌里没有相同的牌，则对敌方手牌中的随从开六枪，每枪造成2点伤害。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I have given up (a single copy of) EVERYTHING! What have YOU sacrificed?"
Tag.zhCN: “我牺牲了一切（牌库中的复制）！你又付出了什么？”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]After you play a Naga, deal 2 damage to a random enemy and draw a spell. (Then switch!)@[x]After you cast a spell, deal 2 damage to a random enemy and draw a Naga. (Then switch!)
Tag.zhCN: 在你使用一张纳迦牌后，随机对一个敌人造成2点伤害，抽一张法术牌。 （然后切换！）@在你施放一个法术后，随机对一个敌人造成2点伤害，抽一张纳迦牌。 （然后切换！）

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $3 damage. Quickdraw: Your opponent's next card costs (1) more.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$3点伤害。快枪：你对手的下一张牌法力值消耗增加（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I was only trying to get it in your eyes, man. YOU didn't need to open your mouth like that!
Tag.zhCN: 我不过是想把沙子撒到你眼睛里，兄弟，你把嘴张得那么大干什么！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的下一张牌法力值消耗增加（1）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的下一张牌法力值消耗增加（1）点。

Tag.zhCN: 发现一张纳迦牌。如果你在本牌在你手中时使用过纳迦牌，发现的牌法力值消耗减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: With their oasis polluted by the Bloodrock Mining Company, Snake Eyes has set aside her differences with the outlaws of the Badlands to put an end to Bloodrock's operation.
Tag.zhCN: 血石矿业公司污染了绿洲，蛇眼因此放下了与荒芜之地各个帮派的恩怨，阻止血石的恶行。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $6 damage split among the lowest Health enemies.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$6点伤害，分配到生命值最低的敌人身上。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I thought Kurtrus was more of a fan of glaives.
Tag.zhCN: 我原本以为，库尔特鲁斯会更喜欢战刃。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 突袭。流放：召唤一个本随从的复制。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Three of these would make for an EPIC T-shirt.
Tag.zhCN: 集齐三只，就能凑成一件史诗级 T恤。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you've cast a spell while holding this, give your hero +3 Attack this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你在本牌在你手中时施放过法术，使你的英雄在本回合中获得+3攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I'm green And I'm about to die Da ba dee da ba di

Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Draw an Outcast card and slide it to the left side of your hand.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：抽一张流放牌并将其放在你手牌中的最左边。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Bartend-O-Bot! Make my Outcast card DO SOMETHING!
Tag.zhCN: 机器调酒师！调好我的流放牌，别傻愣着！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Deal $2 damage. Your next Naga, Fel spell, and weapon cost (1) less.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$2点伤害。你的下一张纳迦牌，邪能法术牌和武器牌法力值消耗减少（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Wait! Before we duel, I gotta install these shaders.
Tag.zhCN: 等等！决斗开始之前我需要先安装着色器。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的下一张纳迦牌法力值消耗减少（1）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Your next Fel Spell cost (1) less.
Tag.zhCN: 你的下一张邪能法术牌法力值消耗减少（1）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 你的下一张武器牌法力值消耗减少（1）点。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $7 damage to a minion. Draw 7 cards.
Tag.zhCN: 对一个随从造成$7点伤害。 抽7张牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: If you count the 'seven' in the name, there's actually four total 7s, not three. Huge oversight from the designers.
Tag.zhCN: 如果算上卡牌名里的“七”字，那总共就有四个7，而不是三个。设计师的巨大失误。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 发现一张另一职业的快枪牌。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Dude, Velarok, give me a minute to play my turn, the rope's burning!
Tag.zhCN: 威拉罗克，先让我把我的回合打完，都烧绳了！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: If you've Excavated twice, destroy an enemy minion.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你已经发掘过两次，消灭一个敌方随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: One man's treasure is another man's statue to the face.
Tag.zhCN: 是谁的雕像，是谁的宝藏，又给谁带来了创伤。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]After you play a Coin, get a random Legendary minion from another class and set its Cost to (1).
Tag.zhCN: 在你使用一张幸运币后，随机获取一张另一职业的传说随从牌并将其法力值消耗变为（1）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Wishing upon a star? Pssshhh, that's so childish. Anyways, let me throw all my Coins into this well.
Tag.zhCN: 对着星星许愿？切，幼稚。稍等，等我把幸运币都投进这座井里。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Get a random Epic, Rare, and Common card from other classes.
Tag.zhCN: 随机获取其他职业的史诗，稀有和普通卡牌各一张。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: I thiiink… It's under all three of 'em!

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼，快枪，亡语：发掘一个宝藏。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: "I HATE that nickname. Call me Drilliam!"
Tag.zhCN: “我讨厌这个绰号。 叫我钻先生！”

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Rush 50% chance to attack the wrong enemy.

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Why don't they just buy another hat?
Tag.zhCN: 再买一顶帽子不就好了？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Rush 50% chance to give your hero +3 Attack this turn instead of attacking.
Tag.zhCN: 突袭。攻击时有50%几率改为使你的英雄在本回合中获得+3攻击力。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Doesn't know his ride from his left.
Tag.zhCN: 下马难分左右，上马不识东西。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: You hero has +3 Attack this turn
Tag.zhCN: 在本回合中，你的英雄拥有+3攻击力。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 突袭。每当本随从攻击时，获得圣盾。（50%的几率改为获得 吸血。）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: 100% chance to not play by the rules.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：复活你的食人魔帮众，使其获得 风怒。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The good, the bad, and the ugly stats for the Cost.
Tag.zhCN: 好人，坏人，经典身材的带头人。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Secret: When the enemy plays a card on the turn that it entered their hand, get a copy that costs (0).
Tag.zhCN: 奥秘：当敌人使用一张在当回合进入手牌的牌时，获取一张它的复制，其法力值消耗为（0）点。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: When the ground trembles near it, are those earthquakes or heartbeats?
Tag.zhCN: 每当矿脉附近的大地颤动，那究竟是地震，还是这颗星球的心跳？

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Attack and Health broken in half.

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Battlecry: Return a friendly minion to your hand. Give it +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：将一个友方随从移回你的手牌，使其获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: Brewmaster Bru brought Barrelbrim bursting barrels of barely brewed barley brew. Barrelbrim bought Bru's barley brew, barring the barrels broken from the brazen brunch brawl.
Tag.zhCN: 桶沿赴酒店，旧店沽酒酽。酒筵谷酒鲜，酒仙复同宴。

Tag.enUS: Return a friendly minion to hand and give it +2/+2.
Tag.zhCN: 将一个友方随从移回手牌，并使其获得+2/+2。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT

Tag.zhCN: 战吼：每有一个你使用过元素牌的连续的回合，召唤一个本随从的复制。@（召唤@个）

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: The drip on this elemental is straight fire!
Tag.zhCN: 它身上流下来的“水滴”——其实是火！

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Draw a different Arcane spell. If you play it this turn, it casts twice.
Tag.zhCN: 抽一张不同的奥术法术牌。如果你在本回合中使用这张抽到的牌，则会施放两次。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: See those dots up there? Those are called "stars." Except for that one. That's called an "airplane."
Tag.zhCN: 看到天上的光点了吗？那就是“星星”。哦，你说那个，那个不是星星，那个叫“飞机”。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Casts twice if played this turn.
Tag.zhCN: 如果在本回合中使用，施放两次。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: Excavate a treasure. For each card in your hand, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：发掘一个宝藏。你每有一张手牌，便随机对一个敌人造成1点伤害。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: Deal $10 damage randomly split among all enemies. Summon a random 10-Cost minion.
Tag.zhCN: 造成$10点伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。随机召唤一个法力值消耗为（10）的随从。

Tag.name: FLAVORTEXT
Tag.enUS: When the light is just right during Golden Hour, that is when you take out the selfie stick and start casting.
Tag.zhCN: 当夕阳光线刚刚好的时候，你就可以拿出自拍杆狠狠地拍一通了。

Tag.name: CARDTEXT
Tag.enUS: [x]Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, Discover any Elemental from the past.
Tag.zhCN: 战吼：如果你在上个回合使用过元素牌，发现一张来自过去的任意元素牌。
